sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
PackLoader 负责 pointer/manifest/import/descriptor/policy phases；provider-local Layer/handler 负责 native resource/effect；permission evaluation 属于 UTA writer/runtime，不被 pack service 提供。历史 resolver 能加载旧 descriptor/observer/recovery，不向新 admission catalog 借 semantics。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-9AD9951502: effectBoundary=Composition only: main/effect-runtime loads this module and provides CredentialProvider, Clock, Scope, and JournalWriter-backed scheduler ports. No network occurs on import and no adapter object enters transaction state. Provider code may use any native SDK/protocol; only the validated UTA-facing descriptor and boundary codecs are shared. durability=The module descriptor is immutable code metadata; connection lifetime is Scope-managed. DispatchStarted and each Ack/RemoteObservation are written by durable-scheduler/journal, keyed by account scope plus DispatchIdentity. Prepared plan stores redacted/versioned native plan and CompensationAssessment, never the client or secret. Data handles/cache state are not order WAL; only a selected controlled effect receives transaction durability.

The loader may report `PackApiVersionMismatch` to application readiness while transaction code sees only capability unavailability. durability=The installed manifest/API and descriptor schema version are checked before cache insertion. A selected controlled-effect leaf may record its provider/schema version with intent or observation; public data leaves use their own cursor/cache version. The descriptor itself does not make provider-native idempotency, atomicity or recovery guarantees.

sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
Assembler/SecretResolver/PackLoader 是 resource effects；parsed config/translation and provider descriptor are pure construction-bound values；current principal/policy/scope evaluation is separate runtime authority; no module import or schema callback manufactures it。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-6367D87808: effectBoundary=The assembler is an Effect interpreter/composition boundary; parsing, preset translation, and policy decisions are pure inputs. It owns no SQL and must not mutate UTA state or instantiate SDKs before pack/evidence checks. durability=AccountId/legacy aliases, SecretRefs, environment/scope evidence, and readiness decisions are persisted through account storage/journal writers outside this module; connection cache is ephemeral and generation-tagged.
MAP-C3B978232C: effectBoundary=Requirement evaluation and conversion are pure. FX provider IO, rate freshness, and service lifecycle are effects; JournalWriter records the observation reference with the plan when it affects quantity/notional. durability=Persist only typed FX observation metadata/rate source and plan inputs, not provider internals. Missing FX never mutates order state; failure policy follows action semantics.
MAP-093F5766C9: effectBoundary=Parsing and translation are pure. Pack loading, secret resolution, adapter lifecycle, probing, and FX layer acquisition are effects; no broker is created before durable readiness/identity checks. durability=Persist parsed serializable config, SecretRefs, AccountId/aliases, scope/evidence generations, and migration state through account storage; factory does not write SQL and cannot discard durable identity.
MAP-E010E516DB: effectBoundary=Only layer acquisition and rate fetching are effects. The adapter boundary receives a typed service interface and cannot inspect arbitrary properties or mutate itself through a setter. durability=Persist capability/evidence and FX observation references as part of connection/plan metadata; no setter state is durable or authoritative.
MAP-D914E7F49F: effectBoundary=Barrel exports are pure module wiring. Importing broker-spi must not evaluate SDKs or access services; effects live in adapter implementations/runtime composition. durability=No persistence owner; exported records carry identity/scope and durable IDs but JournalWriter owns event/projection writes.
MAP-16D7FC3B84: effectBoundary=The barrel change itself is pure import wiring; connection acquisition remains an explicit effect boundary. durability=Connection construction has no direct persistence authority; AccountId/legacy migration and JournalWriter interaction belong to application/runtime orchestration.
MAP-4D0C34ED53: effectBoundary=Barrel wiring is pure; actual config parsing, pack loading, probing, and policy evaluation are separate effects/pure functions as appropriate. durability=Preset metadata is rebuildable; account config/identity/evidence persist elsewhere. Public exports must not expose SecretMaterial or mutable SDK objects.
MAP-E981F551DA: effectBoundary=Barrel remains pure/lazy. Dynamic import and pack manifest validation are effects owned by PackLoader; descriptors are decoded into SDK-free interfaces before use. durability=Pack definitions may be cached ephemerally, but active account/journal/connection generation and recovery state are durable elsewhere.

sections.title: 组合根、schema-bound 能力与外部适配器
currentBehavior: Main 直接 import/configure native SDK、EventLog、ToolCenter、UTAManager、FX、snapshot、polling；旧 IBroker/engine/pack 是带 mandatory unsupported stub、混合 read/write method 的 closed interface。
same-process pack registry 只检查 pack API/config/createBroker，没有 handshake、descriptor revision、schema fingerprint、correlation、stream cancel、crash semantics；AI/CLI projection 部分依赖手写 map。
abstractExpression: Main 是唯一 composition root：decode config、安装 JournalStore/ProjectionStore、registry/catalog、adapter、Scheduler、Supervisor/Guardian、transport，全部置于 root Scope；domain/application 只依赖 port/schema。

capability definition 构造时绑定 semantic unit、exact input/success/failure/delivery/effect schema、implementation、Effect R、resource、scope、permission 与 provider identity。`PermissionWitness` 由 principal + catalog binding + current policy/entitlement 单独求得，提供 Effect service 不能制造它。

dynamic foreign descriptor 以 provider instance + capability identity + declaration revision + full semantic/schema digest + schema slot 做 certification；constructor/eliminator 检查同一 binding/slot。validator/descriptor/digest 来自同一受限 declaration 和构造时绑定的 Constraint evaluator。
current admission catalog 与 historical interpretation resolver 分离：旧 leaf 可以保留 exact observer/recovery，但不能赋予新 call authority；CLI/AI/help/describe/invoke 从 catalog 投影，缺失 leaf 不生成命令。
preservedContract: 保留 provider-native order/instrument/candle/news richness、unsupported namespace absence、Public/Account scope，以及 read/stream/controlled effect 区分。
任意语言/process 的 provider 仍可工作于 trusted UTA execution tree；secret 不跨 descriptor/diagnostic。
CLI 是 outer interpreter，AI metadata 与 declaration 同源。
selectedChanges: 删除 IBroker mandatory/stub、宽泛 barrel reexport、dynamic Record escape hatch、手写 CLI map，改用 capability leaf 与 provider-local codec。
foreign bridge 实现 handshake/discover/bind/call/subscribe、correlation、credit/cancel、nonterminal item-error/snapshot-end、terminal `Completed|Failed|Cancelled`、bounds 与 typed failure。
query/stream invoker 不接 mutation recipe；controlled invocation 必须使用绑定 exact recipe/plan/attempt 的 writer-issued permission，AI/CLI 不接 native dispatch。
此 composition boundary 只容纳 cited provider/CLI protocol；不在现有 runtime/process-control owner 之外引入 generic lifecycle 或 Guardian engine。
effectAndStateOwnership: Main 通过 scoped layer 提供 Effect R；Catalog/Policy service 计算 current permission witness；JournalStore 只对显式 admitted command/capture 负责 durable authority；ProjectionStore 提供 persisted/captured derived data，而 live read capability 直接返回 observedAt/asOf/coverage；ProviderResource layer 拥有 handle。
schema certification/historical resolver 属于 runtime control state，不是业务 projection；SDK object/secret 只留在 native adapter。
failuresAndRecovery: descriptor load/schema mismatch、stale capability、unauthorized discovery、provider unavailable、output violation、foreign crash、cancel 都有不同 typed outcome；POST 后断开是 OutcomeUnknown。
stream failure 后不能 Completed；snapshot-end/item-error nonterminal；crash 不承诺 final wire frame，local terminal state 需 durable reconcile。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 same-process dynamic pack、closed IBroker/stub、native richness、局部 CLI/schema export；不证明 remote idempotency/replay/finality/credential separation/foreign transport guarantee。
migrationCutover: 构造 declaration/codec/catalog/bridge port 与 offline conformance fixture，验证 slot/digest/stream terminal；边界证据被接受后，一次性切换 AI/CLI projection，再删除 domain barrel 的 manager/tool/native import。

sections.category: 解释器、作用域与资源生命周期
sections.title: 连接健康、恢复、延迟观测与重新水合
currentBehavior: UTA health tests 建立 5 秒 retry、factor 2、5 分钟 cap、capability failure threshold、成功 reset、offline/read-only refusal 与 close cancel；这些是 constructor/fake-timer 下的 local behavior。
manager/poller 以 mutable counter/timer 维护 health；poller 只观察已经发送的 order，不是 durable event trigger/authorization。close-all swallow failure，无法返回完整 cleanup evidence。
abstractExpression: 以 exhaustive `RuntimeHealth` 表达 Configuring/Recovering/Ready/Degraded/Offline/Closing/Closed，并携带 scoped capability health、reason、attempt、observedAt；5 秒 retry policy 只属于 connection recovery，不能推广为 mutation retry。
root Scope 管 fiber/resource，recovery barrier 控制 account/data admission。connection success 不等 transaction success；trading permission 另行计算。

用 `Decision<State,Command,Event,ExternalEffect,Failure>` + `Evolution` 表达 durable lifecycle；send 先持久化 job/attempt，只有 fresh Start 才产生一次性 process-bound `DispatchGrant` 并进入 DispatchStarted。duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence；OutcomeUnknown 由 observation/reconciliation 解决，持久化 authorization 不是 grant。

每个 not-started intent revision 只有一个 activation owner；这些 lifecycle/recovery 关系只是 UTA runtime 的 source-owner protocol accommodation，不是新的 generic kernel lifecycle engine；`advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` pure 地产生 NoActivation/Candidate/Gap，writer 原子提交 checkpoint、event consumption、transition、一个 outbox；source fact 不是 dispatch authorization。

rehydration 使用 exact historical implementation/compiler/predicate binding；DispatchStarted 前不可用可 retire no-start plan 再以新 revision + 新授权 prepare，DispatchStarted/Unknown 后只能 RecoveryRequired，绝不 reprepare。no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 必须使用冻结的 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision` policy；timeout 与 response 在同一 control CAS 竞争，绝不 fallback auto-execute。
preservedContract: 保留 retry timing/threshold/reset、offline/read-only refusal、close cancellation、account-generation identity 与 external-order reconcile intent。
保留 remote uncertainty、durable recovery ownership、trigger source 与 authorizer/recipient 分离；ReturnToAgent 是配置策略而非 universal default。
selectedChanges: 删除 constructor side effect、manager health authority、timer-only poller、swallow close error、direct TradingGit dispatch，改用 scoped lifecycle service、typed scheduler job、durable writer、cleanup report。
分离 transport failure、private-read failure、data entitlement、trading readiness；public-only runtime 可 process-ready 但 trading unavailable。
effectAndStateOwnership: lifecycle projection/JournalStore 负责 durable authority；Effect Scope/Scheduler 负责 in-process fiber；adapter 负责 connection generation；Supervisor/Guardian 负责 process restart escalation。

currentBehavior: MAP-5CC2CA6EF1：registry module 以注释约定 defaultImpl + per-exchange override，顶层 import Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid objects；所有扩展通过同一 legacy CcxtBroker registry 组合。

MAP-ED742AC7B1：CcxtExchangeOverrides 是 optional method bag；hooks 接收 raw Exchange、string/number 与 Record params，返回 raw CCXT orders/positions/balances；strict flags、walletTypes 与 TP/SL support 都是 optional fields。defaultImpl convention 允许修改输入、后处理结果或完全替换。

MAP-663AADE476：defaultFetchBalance(params undefined) 调用 unscoped `exchange.fetchBalance()`，有 params 才原样传递；defaultFetchOrderById 先 regular fetchOrder，再 catch 后若 symbol 存在以 `stop:true` 再试，任一路失败都抛 generic `Order ... not found`。
MAP-5B4370AB4D：取消先调用 cancelOrder(id,symbol)，捕获任意错误后若有 symbol 再调用 stop:true；fallback 成功即返回，否则抛出第一次错误。没有记录两次尝试的 dispatch identity 或远端状态。

MAP-F032485592：defaultPlaceOrder 直接把 symbol、string type、buy/sell、number amount、optional price 与 Record params 传给 createOrder，返回 raw CcxtOrder；没有 durable intent/dispatch identity/ack versus observation distinction。
MAP-6AAB1AB711：defaultFetchPositions 没有参数/selector/schema，直接执行 exchange.fetchPositions() 并把 raw position rows 返回；没有 AccountScope、observation timestamp、完整性或 query failure。
MAP-A1AE3F307F：defaultFetchAllOpenOrders 只调用一次 exchange.fetchOpenOrders()；注释记录 live OKX pending endpoint 返回 spot+swap，但明确 CCXT 没有跨 venue completeness semantics，category-scoped venue 需 override。

MAP-AB05DEE8D4：registry 在 Binance override 中声明 spot 与 derivatives（walletTypes future+delivery，delivery 注释 tolerated-on-failure），并以四个 exchange key 注册 Binance、Bitget、Bybit、Hyperliquid；没有 SDK/account-family/jurisdiction/version/capability context。

MAP-F0A14EF839：ccxtTypeToSecType 对未知 market type 返回 CRYPTO；mapOrderStatus 将 closed/open/canceled/cancelled/expired/rejected 分别映射到 Filled/Submitted/Cancelled/Inactive，其余（含 undefined）也映射 Submitted；makeOrderState 只写 legacy `OrderState.status`。
abstractExpression: overrides.ts 的 optional hook bag 与 registry 是加载机制，不是 capability algebra。default lookup/create/positions/open-listing、cancel fallback、provider pack version 与 registered venue family 都各自声明 schema、availability、native error、permission 与 recovery policy；hook 存在不等于操作可用、安全、幂等或原子。

MAP-5CC2CA6EF1：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 default-plus-override 的扩展意图和 Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid 独立模块保留，但每个差异变成具名 typed handler。；未覆盖方法只有在 capability 明确声明默认语义时才可用，不能把 raw fallback 当 universal support。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：registry/pack loading 是 composition boundary，不应以 override object 或完整 handler 集合推断能力；target 只加载 declared provider leaves 并保留 manifest/version evidence。

sections.title: IBKR 直连 TWS/Gateway：连接代次、账户目录与外部进程边界
currentBehavior: IbkrBroker 持有可变的 EClient 和 RequestBridge。EClient 是连接 TWS/Gateway 的 TCP 客户端，RequestBridge 继承 DefaultEWrapper，将回调路由到 reqId/orderId Promise 注册表。
RequestBridge 的 allocReqId 从 10000 开始；nextValidId 覆盖下一个原生订单 ID 计数器并完成握手。managedAccounts 拆分逗号分隔的列表，但只保留 accounts[0]。随后 IbkrBroker 使用配置的 accountId 或该首个账户，在将 broker 标记为存活前启动 reqAccountUpdates。
waitForConnect 让 EClient.connect 与 nextValidId 等待器竞速，并清理失败的尝试。对端静默会超时；connectionClosed/502/504/1100 标记为失效，1101/1102 则只发出 restored。断连时，rejectAll 拒绝等待器并清空账户/订单缓存。本地 45 秒定时器发出 currentTime 探测。
配置默认值为 host 127.0.0.1、port 7497、clientId 0 和 paper=true，但源码不观测 paper/live 环境、司法辖区或子账户语义。同一个公开 broker 对象同时暴露读取和直接原生写入。
abstractExpression: 该包分别声明连接和各项能力。连接标识为 {providerInstanceId, connectionId, generation, clientId, endpointEvidence}；即使 TCP 端点/clientId 不变，重连也会递增 generation。每次握手包含 {attemptId, phase, deadline, transportEvidence, protocolEvidence}，可结束于 HandshakeTimeout、TransportClosed、ProtocolMismatch 或 NativeReady。

nextValidId 仅是 NativeReady 观测。AccountDirectory 是独立的带修订版本记录，包含所有不透明的托管账户 token，以及观测到的 accountName、存在时的司法辖区/子账户字段、覆盖范围和来源。必须显式选择 AccountScope；不允许默认选择首个账户。账户读取/效应保持 AccountScoped；公开的合约/报价/会话叶节点保持 Public。

RequestCorrelation 为 {connectionId,generation,capabilityId,requestFamily,nativeRequestId,attemptId}；nativeRequestId 绝不是持久化 DispatchId。订单标识单独表示为 NativeOrderIdentityEvidence（broker order id、client id、permId、account、parent ids、存在/缺失原因）。旧 generation 的回调属于 StaleCallback 证据。
宿主声明绑定于构造过程：受限的结构化 schema 代数共同构造 input/success/failure/delivery 槽位、具名 Constraint<Value,Configuration,Failure>（标识符/版本/配置/错误 schema/确定性求值器制品/摘要）、描述符及完整语义/schema 摘要。任意 Zod 回调加上单独编辑的元数据，不是可移植的 IBKR 契约。
本地定义将 Effect 服务需求（作用域化的 socket/clock/codec）与当前 principal/capability/scope/entitlement 权限凭证分开记录。提供 EClient 服务绝不产生下单权限。
外部绑定携带 provider 实例、能力标识、声明修订版本、完整摘要和精确 schema 槽位（input、success、failure、prepared、acknowledgement、observation 或 recovery）。新调用使用的准入目录与历史观测/恢复解析分离；修订后的路径不能重新解释已启动的旧效应。

对于独立运行的 Java/Python/native gateway，面向 UTA 的协议采用版本化的 handshake → discover → bind(capabilityId,revision,schemaFingerprint) → call/subscribe/cancel/terminal。它携带关联信息、有界的载荷/资源大小、类型化的 load/input/domain/transport/output 失败，不携带凭证值。TWS/EClient 线协议和 SDK 类留在进程边界之后。
就绪状态是有限 ADT：Dead、RestoredHint(dataMaintained|dataLost)、NativeReady、AccountReachPending、AccountBaselineCommitted、Degraded、Closed 和 StaleCallback。没有所选账户的基线和恢复屏障，RestoredHint 绝不重新开放私有读取或变更准入。
preservedContract: 保留握手顺序、静默对端的截止时间行为、connectionClosed 清理、1100 与 1101/1102 的区别、写入路径的 currentTime 探测、正常账户读取前的账户基线，以及心跳意图。
保留不透明的 provider 账户代码及所有回调/错误证据；账户作用域未确定时，保留公开数据的可用性。
保留 TWS/Gateway 对登录凭证的所有权；持久化计划仅包含 CredentialRef/配置指纹。
selectedChanges: 用完整 AccountDirectory 和显式选择器替代首账户选择；账户/司法辖区证据缺失或冲突时，产生 ScopeDiscoveryPending、UnknownScope 或 EnvironmentMismatch。
用绑定 generation 的作用域资源替代可变布尔值/setter。释放操作幂等且有序：停止准入、中断读取器、完成本地等待器、分类已持久化的已启动效应、排空写入器、取消账户订阅、断连。
分离端点可达性、原生协议就绪、账户基线、能力可用性、授权和执行就绪。端口和 paper 标签仅作提示。
将重连/退避保留在监督机制中。重连可重新获取 generation 并重建基线；绝不重试可能已发出的受控效应。
effectAndStateOwnership: Adapter/bridge 负责 EClient 回调、generation 隔离、请求关联和原生 codec 状态。
数据 ProjectionWriter 负责账户检查点/新鲜度；它不为每次回调写入订单 WAL。
共享受控效应写入器负责 DispatchId/StepId、授权、CAS、DispatchStarted 和 OutcomeUnknown。Alice 负责供审查的 agent/session 交付。
failuresAndRecovery: 握手超时/关闭属于 ConnectionFailure，附带 attempt/generation 证据；迟到的 nextValidId 不能使已关闭的尝试恢复。
1100/502/504 转为 Dead；1101/1102 仅转为 RestoredHint。基线缺失时保持 AccountReachPending。SDK 发送抛出异常不能证明没有字节发出。
DispatchStarted 之后，超时/断连/进程丢失/畸形 ack 转为 OutcomeUnknown + ObserveRequired。DispatchStarted 之前，写入器 CAS 可终止未发送的工作；清理绝不抹除已启动记录。
未注册错误、版本不匹配、畸形回调或作用域缺失属于 UnknownNativeError/ProtocolViolation/CapabilityUnavailable，而非空成功或盲目重试。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码不能证明 TWS paper/live 回调、托管账户 token 顺序、子账户/司法辖区映射、关闭后的回调顺序、原生 ID 复用时限或 EClient 发送字节边界。
心跳/超时是 provider 策略，不是远端保证。CurrentTime 单位/时钟偏差和 1101 的 data-maintained 语义需要一致性验证。
健康的 socket/nextValidId 不是账户就绪、订单接受、幂等性或持久化恢复的证据。
migrationCutover: 通过离线等价验证/导入，引入版本化 IBKR 连接 Layer/native codec，再以单一权威切换到 generation 作用域句柄；不采用推测性双读/shim。
单一权威生效后，删除首账户/环境推断、公开 setter 接口、原始 SDK 导出和一刀切的 rejectAll。
持久化绑定修订版本/指纹/账户选择器；重启时解析精确解释器，或进入不可用/恢复状态，而非按当前代码解释。

sections.category: 解释器、作用域与资源生命周期
sections.title: IBKR callback bridge：请求关联、快照 end marker 与错误路由
currentBehavior: RequestBridge 使用仅以 number 为键的通用 pending/collector 映射、以 reqId 为键的快照累加器、以 orderId 为键的 orderPending、单例 open/completed 收集器、一个 currentTime promise 和持久账户缓存。Pending 默认为 unknown，回调族共享数字 ID。
requestSnapshot 可在 bid/ask 到达时完成；普通快照仅在 tickSnapshotEnd 时完成。tickPrice 映射实时/延迟的 BID/ASK/LAST/HIGH/LOW，tickSize 映射 VOLUME，tickString 解析 type 45 的秒数。未知 tick/无效值被静默略去。currentTime 合并调用方，并在超时/发送抛出异常时清除。
open/completed 请求覆盖唯一的收集器槽位。openOrder 完成等待方并追加批次；orderStatus 缓存成交数据，但丢弃 permId/clientId，cancel 则合成空 Contract/OrderState。错误处理忽略 2100-2199，并按 reqId/orderId 路由请求错误。
abstractExpression: 每个叶节点声明回调族编解码器和终止策略。CorrelationKey={connectionId,generation,capabilityId,requestFamily,nativeId,attemptId}；注册拒绝重复、族不匹配、终态复用和格式错误的载荷。原生 ID 复用需要代际范围证据。
SnapshotLifecycle 为 Pending → CompletedByEnd(QuoteObservation) | CompletedEarly(BidAskOnly, configured) | TimedOut(evidence) | Cancelled。普通快照要求 tickSnapshotEnd；缺少结束标记时，不能凭 bid/ask 升级为完成。
对于未来的连续 reqMktData，tickSnapshotEnd 是非终止的 SnapshotEnd 控制信号；可恢复的条目解码错误是非终止的 ItemError。流在受持有期间仅以 Completed|Failed|Cancelled 终止；失败后不能再完成，崩溃也不能保证最后一个线路帧。有限的 getQuote 拉取具有独立生命周期。
CurrentTime 是代际范围内的共享读取资源；发送抛出异常时记录歧义并创建新关联，绝不赋予变更权限。
NativeErrorEnvelope 保留 code、脱敏文本、context、generation、connection/scope/phase。2100–2199 为信息类；10089 在已注册时表示请求能力失败；1100/502/504 表示失效；1101/1102 为提示；未知错误仍为 UnknownNativeError。
preservedContract: 保留 reqId 路由、10089 请求专属拒绝、21xx 不抛异常、普通结束完成、按配置的 bid/ask 提前完成，以及 currentTime 合并。
通过显式编解码器保留请求族区分。
保留数字错误码/脱敏消息证据，但不将消息文本作为领域契约。
selectedChanges: 用带类型的代际注册表替换 Map<number,unknown> 和单例收集器；对没有独立原生关联的同族操作串行执行。
要求快照上下文（instrument,currency,subject,quality,end policy）；拒绝无作用域的报价。
超时后，迟到的结束标记/tick 视为过期；结束标记仍作为证据保留。保留信息类健康事件，但不提升就绪状态。
effectAndStateOwnership: Bridge 负责原生回调解码、注册、定时器/取消及代际隔离。
纯 reducer 分类快照/错误；ProjectionWriter 持久化选定数据。
只有受控解释器将订单回调关联到 DispatchId；通用 openOrder 仅为观测。
failuresAndRecovery: 重复/不匹配/迟到的回调转为 ProtocolViolation/StaleCallback。
快照超时返回已累积字段，不返回零值报价；流断连返回 Gap/Unavailable。
未知 21xx 仍为信息类；未知请求错误为 ObservationFailure/UnknownNativeError。
发送后的回调缺口为 OutcomeUnknown，需要观测。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 原生 ID 复用范围、断连后回调顺序、21xx 的完整含义、tick 时间戳/币种以及发送字节后抛异常的行为仍未证实。
超时/currentTime 常量属于策略；SDK 定时器归属需要一致性验证。
未知原始回调值仅为有界诊断，不是完整的报价/订单/挂牌信息。
migrationCutover: 通过离线等价性验证/导入引入逐叶节点请求描述符/编解码器，再从通用请求/单例收集器切换为单一权威；不设垫片阶段。
让回调感知代际，并暴露取消/终结端口；在作用域化组合持有客户端后移除可变 setter。
保留纯 reducer 测试夹具；新增迟到回调/格式错误/结束标记/确认前已接受的进程一致性验证。

sections.category: 解释器、作用域与资源生命周期
sections.title: Longbridge Rust-NAPI/HTTP-WebSocket：连接与 foreign-process 边界
currentBehavior: LongbridgeBroker 校验原始凭据，默认 paper=false，接受可选 endpoint URLs，在进程内构建 Rust-NAPI Config/TradeContext/QuoteContext，然后仅探测 accountBalance，重试五次，并通过消息正则处理认证。
Config 尚无经证实的 sandbox endpoint/account 一致性；context 句柄可变且使用确定赋值，FxService 是 setter。
close 是异步空操作，因为源码称 Rust websocket 池由 GC 回收；未发现 native release hook。Barrel 导出旧版 Broker/config。
测试用数字枚举和 promises 替换 SDK；已兑现的 promise 不是 remote ack、response version、accepted-before-ack、stream identity 或重启证据。
abstractExpression: 连接配置不含秘密，结构为 {providerInstance,connection,generation,scope,declared Paper|Live|Unknown,endpoint fingerprint,CredentialRef,SDK/protocol revision,resource policy}。秘密仅在可信 Layer 内解析。

Native 边界校验 Rust-NAPI getters/response version，并用 connection/generation/capability/request/attempt 关联 HTTP/WebSocket 调用。外部进程使用 handshake/discover/bind/call/subscribe/cancel/terminal；native transport 保持 provider 私有。
Rust 句柄/HTTP 客户端的 Effect service R 与主体权限、entitlement 和 account grant 分离。仅当意图、凭据、endpoint 和 account 证据一致时，Paper/Live 才可执行；否则为 EnvironmentUnknown/Mismatch。
Scoped Layer 拥有一个封闭的 generation 和幂等 finalizer。没有 release hook 意味着 CleanupEvidenceUnavailable；GC/空操作不具确定性。
每个动态 slot 绑定 provider/capability/revision/full digest/slot；实时准入 catalog 不同于历史 observer/recovery。attempt 启动后，新 catalog 不能重新准备。
未来的 stream 必须区分非终态 SnapshotEnd/可恢复 ItemError 与 Completed|Failed|Cancelled；崩溃/管道断裂可能缺失最终帧，持久化 checkpoint 负责恢复。
preservedContract: 保留凭据校验、有界重试与认证区分、endpoint 声明和 Rust-NAPI 句柄。
保留可信凭据边界；不声称提供恶意插件 sandbox。
保留源码中无 release hook 的事实，mocks 仅作为纯映射证据。
selectedChanges: 用 CredentialRef/环境证据替换原始秘密配置；计划/日志/descriptors 绝不包含秘密。
用逐叶 ProbeFacts 和版本化 error/status codecs 替换单一 accountBalance 探测/正则错误处理；未探测的叶节点不可用。
用 scoped 组合/generation 替换 setters；仅在具备生命周期证据后声明支持 push。
以精确 schemas/availability 注册 capability tree，而非封闭的 IBroker。
effectAndStateOwnership: Adapter 负责 Rust/HTTP/WebSocket 成帧和解码；kernel 只看到记录。
Connection Layer 负责凭据/生命周期；projection 负责读取；writer 拥有效应权限。
受监督的外部进程是可信执行树代码，而非任意代码 sandbox。
failuresAndRecovery: 缺少凭据为 InputRejected；endpoint/account 冲突为 EnvironmentMismatch；缺少证据为 EnvironmentUnknown/禁止写入。
未知 error/status/version/probe coverage 为 UnclassifiedNativeFailure/ProtocolViolation/ProbeCoverageUnknown。
仅关闭一次并进入 Closed，隔离回调；进程断连为 ProcessFailure/Gap，受控操作启动后为 Unknown/Observe。
重启时重新绑定精确 capability，否则保持需要恢复；mock 中不存在不代表远端不存在。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码未证实 native envelope/version、独立账本、endpoint/account 的 paper 语义、完整错误映射或 release API。
Mocks 无法证明 accepted-before-ack/idempotency/崩溃恢复。
凭据分离和 stream replay/backpressure/cancel 尚未验证。
migrationCutover: 通过离线对等验证/导入创建 pack descriptor/scoped Layer/native codecs，然后切换为单一权威；不采用推测性双读/shim。
添加 envelope、probes、environment、close/release 和独立账本的一致性测试；保留 enum mapper 测试，但不声称其证明 ack。
仅在有证据后发布受控叶节点；否则读取叶节点须有明确命名的 availability，且不提供交易命令。

sections.category: 解释器、作用域与资源生命周期
sections.title: Alpaca：连接、配置与运行资源边界
sections.currentBehavior: Alpaca 当前以 legacy IBroker class 承载 SDK client、配置、catalog cache、订单转换与健康状态；测试通过 any 替换私有 client，配置直接携带 apiKey/secretKey，init 用账户探针和进程内重试，close 不释放任何可观察资源。
sections.abstractExpression: 将连接声明建模为 construction-bound provider definition：non-secret Config 只包含 `ConnectionId`、paper/live intent、label 与 `CredentialRef`/`SecretReference`；`Connection`、SDK client、supervision 和 rate-limit resource 属于 Effect service requirement R。当前 permission witness（principal、AccountScope、policy revision、expiry）是独立的 invocation admission 输入，provide resource 不得制造授权。公开 capability descriptor 只发布已绑定 capability identity、declaration revision、semantic/schema digest 与每个 schema slot 的 certified binding；动态或 foreign 文档不能 cast 成 TS action。
preservedContract: 继续支持 Alpaca 的 narrow US-equity/STK 适配范围以及 Alpaca ticker native key。
保留 paper/live 与 label 等非秘密连接意图；secret bytes 仍只由受信任执行树读取。
连接代际、账户身份、授权主体和 provider instance 分开记录。
selectedChanges: 把 `fromConfig` 的 raw record 解析为结构化配置；不再把 `apiKey`/`secretKey` 或 SDK account object 穿过 UTA 边界。
以 scoped Layer 构造/释放 client；init health probe 只产生具名 availability evidence，不把一次 `getAccount` 证明成完整写就绪。
把重试、lease、reconnect policy 置于 supervised resource；close 负责释放本次拥有的资源，不能声称取消已提交 effect。
legacy class/compatibility barrel 迁移到 v2 provider descriptor 与 declared leaves，旧实现不保留第二个 authority。
effectAndStateOwnership: 仅对 controlled mutation leaves，UTA durable writer 拥有 admission、DispatchPlanned/Started、command identity、lease/CAS 与 recovery；Alpaca adapter 只提供私有 interpreter。连接、catalog 与普通 data Pull 不因此进入 trading transaction。
AccountScope 仅加在账户、持仓、订单事实及受控 effect；Public instrument/market-data 不伪造账户。
健康/连接缓存是 data/resource state，不写订单 WAL；当前服务 R 与 permission witness 始终分开。
failuresAndRecovery: 配置、schema、credential、connection、authorization、transport、output-violation 各有 typed failure；SDK 错误正文只作为 bounded/redacted evidence。
DispatchStarted 前可在 CAS/权限检查后 reclaim；之后 response loss/断连只能进入 Unknown 并按原 capability revision 观察，不生成新 salt/新请求。
旧 interpretation 缺失时，未开始的 plan 可 durable retire 后重新准备；已开始或未知必须 RecoveryRequired，不能切到另一版本。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: SDK endpoint 存在不证明 idempotency、retention、atomicity、absence 或 finality；health probe interval、rate limit 与 reconnect readiness 需 conformance。
Alpaca 没有本地 sub-account API；不推导默认子账户，只有 discovery 的显式 scope 才能授权账户叶子。
migrationCutover: 先实现 non-secret config/credential adapter、scoped client Layer 和 typed availability，再逐个迁移查询与 effect leaf。
若已有 shipped boundary 仍要求 legacy projection，只允许离线 parity/import 或只读边界投影；完成后一次切换并删除其 execution authority，index 只暴露 descriptor/configuration/declared leaves。

sections.category: 解释器、作用域与资源生命周期
sections.title: Leverup：网络、账户与分层连接
sections.currentBehavior: Leverup test/source 以 global fetch、viem PublicClient、raw private key、mutable schemaVariant、in-memory orderTracking 和 legacy IBroker class 串起 RPC、reader、Pyth、relayer。init 只 probe chainId；testnet 仍共用 production reader/relayer URL；close/modify/cancel 与 generic ensureInit 不能表达真实 lifecycle/permission。
sections.abstractExpression: Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。
preservedContract: live/testnet intent、RPC/contract/token/reader/relayer identifiers 继续在 adapter edge 可见，但不因 label 自动互信。
public data 可不带 wallet；cash/positions/order/effects 需要显式 AccountId + SubAccountId（若 native schema account-bound）。
trusted native process/viem/REST 内部可任意实现，UTA 仍是唯一授权与 durable coordination owner。
selectedChanges: 用 `CredentialRef` 替代 config raw privateKey；signer capability 只在 trusted execution tree 内，public identity 只输出 derived trader address evidence。
RPC、reader、Hermes、relayer 以独立 scoped resource Layers 获取与关闭，记录 generation/health/availability；不让 RPC probe 授权 write。

sections.title: 订单同步、持仓估值与模拟状态
sections.currentBehavior: 旧 sync 读取 Git pending order，优先 getOpenOrders，缺失时按 getOrder/localSymbol 回退或按 firstSeen/age 冷却轮询；空结果可能表示未列出、已完成或 provider 不支持。持仓 reconciliation 会将 broker quantity 与 order-log cost basis、mark price 和固定 dust 条件混合；legacy UTA 仅在 `abs(drift) > 1e-8` 时记录 reconcile，因而 `abs(drift) <= 1e-8`（含等于）不记录；getAccount 还可能以仓位重算同币种 PnL；Mock 的价格/fill/transfer 直接改变内存状态。
sections.abstractExpression: 读取统一为带 scope/as-of/freshness/cursor/coverage 的 Pull Result 或 resource-scoped Push Stream。Stream 的 item-error、gap、snapshot-end 是非 terminal；Completed/Failed/Cancelled 互斥且失败后不可完成。PositionObservation、valuation estimate、FillObservation、order lifecycle 和 simulated state 分开建模；ReconcileBalance 是 valuationOnly/accounting estimate，不是 synthetic FillObservation 或 remote execution claim。 Coverage 只取 Complete|Partial|Unavailable；未知值/quality 放在 payload/reason，不增加全局 variant。普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 读取，不需把全部 frame 写入 journal；仅持久化显式 capture、control evidence 与 predicate checkpoint。保留已验证的 same-currency FX identity，并允许显式 policy-approved Estimated display value；删除 unknown=1 或类似伪造，不删除有证据的 1:1/default。
preservedContract: 保留 listing 与 per-order fallback、pending/filled/partial/cancelled 的可观察演进、external-order observation、history/trade projections、同币种 PnL 的一致性目标和 broker avgCost 优先/mark fallback 的来源优先级。 同币种 FX identity 仍是已验证事实；跨币种只有带 FxObservation/provenance 的转换才可形成 Derived 或 policy-approved Estimated display。
保留 legacy UTA 的 inclusive `abs(drift) <= 1e-8` 不记录 reconcile 边界作为 evidence；Spec 的 `1e-9` BTC 只是在该边界内的测试示例，不是独立阈值。未知/缺失/空结果与模拟注入的边界继续作为 evidence；不得把旧常数升级为普适精度或 venue 保证。

sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
查询可以读取带 bound scope、source identity、asOf 与 provenance 的 live data，也可以读取 projection；仅 observation/reconciliation owner 才能 journal append，且事件负载携带真实观测事实，不能靠递归 broker read 伪造 stateAfter。FX 是 leaf-declared FxRequirement/FxObservation；无 FX 的读取仍可用。模拟 venue state 可 ephemeral，但 SimulatorInstanceId/scope、jobs、receipts 和 recovery evidence durable。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-81E9BDAC4E: effectBoundary=Broker-spi performs three typed reads; an observation worker may persist each envelope and projection checkpoint, while a query only reads the projection and never writes reconciliation. No SDK Contract mutation is allowed; ProjectionReader can serve cached state with explicit freshness. durability=RemoteObservation envelopes and projection checkpoints are written by the observation/writer path with source sequence and scope; a query cannot erase durable intent/outcome or manufacture an empty source when one read fails. Realized PnL defaults only when the broker observation explicitly omits it, with a named MissingRealizedPnL compatibility provenance.
MAP-FE83587457: effectBoundary=Broker account/position and FX reads are Effects; currency arithmetic and valuation selection are pure. A refresh/observation command may write through JournalWriter, but the account query itself only reads projections and cannot append reconcile events. durability=Persist account/position/FX observations and derived valuation evidence in the observation/projection writer path with as-of and source sequence; do not overwrite broker data without recording the derivation. Missing FX retains BrokerReported plus DerivedUnavailable.
MAP-D4F5440582: effectBoundary=Broker observation is an Effect; fill fold, status evolution, and weighted-average calculation are pure. Scheduler persists observation before projection update. durability=RemoteObservations are unique by broker execution/order identity plus revision; events and fill/accounting projection update commit atomically. Restart replays the same fill once.
MAP-58E656CE5A: effectBoundary=Scheduler and broker-spi perform listing/getOrder effects under leases; pure classification decides candidate and outcome. Query projections never issue ad hoc polling. durability=Persist job dedup key, notBefore, attempt, lease epoch, listing snapshot identity, and observation outcome. Repeated listing passes do not create duplicate confirm jobs for the same order.
MAP-B3655A0EA7: effectBoundary=Time/clock is an explicit Effect input; Scheduler persists schedules and leases. Broker-spi per-order observe receives native identity/local hint. durability=EFFECT_JOBS stores next attempt/notBefore, attempt number, lease epoch/deadline, and outcome. Restart reads Ready/Leased and reclaims only according to recovery policy, never assumes old sender dead.
MAP-C735359708: effectBoundary=Adapter owns use of localSymbol; scheduler persists request and response. Application query consumes typed OrderSnapshot projections. durability=Persist observation identity, request hint, response evidence, and next schedule. Unknown/StillWorking retain pending projection and create durable follow-up.
MAP-D4AEAAD74E: effectBoundary=Broker positions and order statuses are effects; pure accounting classification consumes snapshots and durable dispatch facts. Reconciliation worker writes JournalWriter events, not query methods. durability=Persist observed/projected quantities, in-flight DispatchIdentity set, tolerance policy/version, and classification. A unique reconciliation key prevents duplicate estimates on retry; projection checkpoint includes source sequence. RecoveryRequired retains execution locks.
MAP-FFFCA4765D: effectBoundary=Policy evaluation is pure; facts (symbol catalog, equity, cooldown, exposure) come from explicit application queries. Reservation submission/release is a durable writer Effect keyed by transaction/revision, and broker dispatch receives only an admitted prepared step. durability=Persist guard policy/version and decision evidence in PreparedPlan/receipt; if a reservation is needed, reserve and its release/expiry are durable idempotent events. Rejected plans have no DispatchPlanned, EffectJob, or lock; unknown guard facts block rather than consume a reservation.
MAP-4189A98E6F: effectBoundary=Broker adapter decodes native Position to typed observation; accounting/projection service performs reconstruction. Query returns immutable view objects rather than mutating SDK positions. durability=Persist source/provenance and observation sequence; an Unknown source remains visible in the projection so future reconciliation can be deterministic.
MAP-5B98644210: effectBoundary=Position observation and order history are effects; pure WAC/accounting functions receive typed facts. JournalWriter appends reconciliation event; query only reads projection. durability=Unique reconciliation identity includes observation/source sequence and scope/instrument. The event stores unit price, provenance, valuationOnly flag, reason, and schema version; projection checkpoint makes restart deterministic.
MAP-E991350693: effectBoundary=Market/position reads are effects; accounting functions are pure. A reconciliation worker performs durable event writes after observing broker state and pending dispatch identities. durability=Event identities, observedAt, price provenance, tolerance, and projection checkpoint are persisted; restart replays mark and residual events exactly once.
MAP-EE6C7F95C5: effectBoundary=Adapter boundary may derive native identity; accounting never mutates SDK contracts. Quarantine/diagnostic recording is an explicit journal/projection effect. durability=Persist tolerance policy/version and identity evidence with reconciliation event; duplicate quarantine observations are deduped by broker observation id.
MAP-C11719131D: effectBoundary=Broker-spi performs listing/order observations; Scheduler controls timing/leases; JournalWriter records observation and projection events; query facade only reads projections. durability=EFFECT_JOBS stores notBefore/attempt/lease/conflict; RemoteObservations dedupe identity; fill events and projection checkpoint append atomically. Unknown suspends remaining forward steps under FailurePolicy.
MAP-6E4258767C: effectBoundary=ProjectionReader/Scheduler are Effects; clients receive stable summaries; no broker/Git call in query. durability=Order projections checkpoint from journal; jobs have independent dedup/lease state and can be rebuilt/recovered.
MAP-80F3D97161: effectBoundary=ProjectionReader performs IO; pure projectors transform journal/projection records and preserve limit ordering. durability=History reports projection checkpoint/freshness; Git commit hash may be an audit column, never transaction key or recovery source.
MAP-CBFF2224B1: effectBoundary=Scheduler uses Clock/Effect; pure timing function is separately tested. Broker observation is invoked only by leased worker. durability=Persist schedule and attempt; restart scans Ready/Leased/Unknown; lease expiry never proves sender dead and cannot QueueUnsent blindly.
MAP-5C48EEF269: effectBoundary=Broker listing is an Effect; identity comparison and classification pure. Scheduler and JournalWriter own persistence. durability=Persist observation identity/dedup, listing coverage/cursor, scope, and event schema. Partial/Unavailable listing must not be interpreted as no external orders.
MAP-1EF01B52AD: effectBoundary=Test harness may use an Effect service/TestClock; production UTA/application never calls Git simulation methods. durability=Test observations can be stored in isolated test journal namespace; production journal rejects simulation commands unless an explicit environment/policy variant exists.
MAP-E8B780DC9D: effectBoundary=Broker account/position reads and observation/reconciliation persistence are Effects outside pure valuation folding. A query reads the latest projection only; a refresh worker records timestamped evidence before the next projection fold. durability=Persist broker-reported/derived provenance, FX evidence identifiers, asOf, and projection checkpoint separately. Missing FX keeps BrokerReported plus DerivedUnavailable so restart cannot manufacture a mixed-currency value.
MAP-D19FB60347: effectBoundary=Broker read and JournalWriter are Effects; source tagging and cost-basis calculations pure. durability=Position observation, reconciliation event, and projection checkpoint are separate versioned records; no query-side write without idempotency.
MAP-044AE7B4DD: effectBoundary=Broker position/order reads and journal append are Effects; pure WAC/PnL/reconciliation classification receives explicit now/observations. durability=ReconcileBalance stores valuationOnly:true, observed/projected quantity, price provenance, tolerance/policy version, in-flight identities, and checkpoint. Unique identity prevents duplicate estimate events; RecoveryRequired preserves locks.
MAP-0AF3B67931: effectBoundary=Pure event constructor has no broker IO; JournalWriter/ProjectionStore persist/evolve real views. durability=Event/projection write includes actual source sequence and checkpoint; replay never sees fake balances/pending arrays.

sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
数据 reader/stream owned resource 负责读取和 delivery；query 可使用 live bound data 或 projection，并保留 scope/asOf/provenance；history/accounting projection 由观察者和 writer 更新。管理层聚合不得生成交易 reservation、job 或 compensation；schema-derived CLI/HTTP 只做 projection。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-FC2ABFBF22: effectBoundary=Pure validation/translation. Adapter performs native mapping and reports actual stream; protocol codec encodes requested and observed stream. durability=Persist request stream and observed stream in historical-bar query evidence when used for analytics/preconditions; a response must not claim TRADES if MIDPOINT was requested.
MAP-BFD66E07FA: effectBoundary=Application supplies clock and catalog facts; adapter performs history IO; protocol encodes Instants/cursors and completeness. durability=Persist request parameters/cursor only for audit; observations carry page identity, asOf, and completeness. A truncated page cannot satisfy a full-range analysis unless policy permits.
MAP-8C79F4D559: effectBoundary=Adapter decodes native rows; BarService performs ordering/gap classification; protocol/API encodes normalized observations. durability=Persist bars only in market-data cache/projection keyed by instrument+interval+stream; no bar is an execution authority. Include source/asOf and schema version for replay.
MAP-3EEBF25E8D: effectBoundary=RuntimeComposition/manager supplies the timestamped RuntimeHealth observation and process-generation facts; broker connection service emits subject-tagged health events; transaction writer owns execution admission. Protocol only encodes views. durability=Persist journal verification/recovery checkpoints and broker health evidence separately. RuntimeHealthObservation.readiness is evidence only; the writer rechecks the current admissionEpoch/authority in SQL before dispatch.
MAP-98D887D066: effectBoundary=Adapter emits typed event; connection service/application writes health event and schedules readiness observation; journal/recovery service owns transaction state separately. durability=Persist event generation/source identity and health transition. DispatchStarted and Unknown remain durable through dead/restored events; no event may erase them.
MAP-609FF636E8: effectBoundary=Adapter discovers entitlement; capability service stores/reads snapshot; request validator is pure. No boolean fallback in protocol. durability=Persist capability fingerprint/version and evidence timestamps. Prepared plans bind capability fingerprint; changes force ReprepareRequired.
MAP-46669371C2: effectBoundary=Capability service performs discovery/refresh effects; protocol codec serializes capability view; transaction kernel only receives an immutable snapshot. durability=Persist capability revision/fingerprint with prepared plan and action evidence; stale capabilities cannot authorize dispatch.
MAP-0647BF0194: effectBoundary=Protocol/config codec is pure. Application loads config and CredentialProvider injects secrets only into adapter scope; UI sees schema/redacted values. durability=Persist schema version, non-secret config, and secret reference ID; never include `default: unknown` or secret material in journal/plan/digest.
MAP-AE61B1C6B0: effectBoundary=Pure relation compiler/validator; adapter owns native request and child dispatch; journal stores protected plan and resulting child identities. durability=Persist full protection variant, group/mechanism, and policy. If runtime-managed, child steps are separate durable jobs with dependency; native atomicity requires actual evidence, not shape.
MAP-29B08BE41B: effectBoundary=Journal/projection reader supplies normalized identities; protocol codec encodes read-only history. Adapter-native Contract mapping ends before this boundary. durability=Persist history row with scoped identity, source event sequence, descriptor schema version, and provenance; history is rebuildable projection, not execution input.
MAP-8CE1592385: effectBoundary=Pure projection reducer; journal reader supplies events and sequence. Protocol encoder exposes safe status/provenance variants. durability=Persist lifecycle/source variant, source event identities and sequence; do not cast unknown strings into status or erase observation evidence.
MAP-732B845474: effectBoundary=Projection store reads journal/observation facts; no direct Git array/SDK. Protocol exports safe row/page views with cursor/freshness. durability=Persist source event ranges, scoped order identity, fill/evidence, and unresolved command refs. Projection checkpoint supports rebuild; no row mutation without source event.
MAP-56C6192DB1: effectBoundary=Broker observation adapter supplies fill identities; journal/accounting projection computes values; protocol encodes read projection. No native Contract/Decimal. durability=Persist fill/adjustment source identity, scope, instrument, units, observation time, event sequence, and correction lineage. Rebuild is deterministic and distinguishes virtual adjustment from execution.
MAP-33B2356199: effectBoundary=Barrel composition is module wiring, not domain IO. Native SDK augmentation is removed; adapters import their own codecs explicitly. durability=Public schemas have versioned encoders and redaction; journal codecs are separate from HTTP views. Export additions require schema/compatibility review and cannot expose runtime functions/SDK instances.
MAP-864224E5A6: effectBoundary=UTAManager/application performs concurrent account/catalog queries and FX IO; protocol only encodes normalized query responses. durability=Persist manager projections/checkpoints from journal/account observations; no native ContractDescription in manager rows. ProviderSubject and capability fingerprint are required in identity.
MAP-75E0ED8B2B: effectBoundary=Manager query service reads runtime/broker projections; process health source supplies observation. No manager row grants dispatch permission. durability=Persist account/projection sequence and subject; RuntimeHealth bootId/generation is observation metadata. Transaction writer separately owns admission epoch/authority checks.
MAP-02219D5749: effectBoundary=Application queries account/FX services; pure Money/FX fold; protocol encodes projection. Missing info is not fabricated. durability=Persist per-account valuation and FX observation identities/validity windows; aggregate checkpoint records completeness and source sequence. Total is unavailable/partial when evidence insufficient.
MAP-6EAA6A8F74: effectBoundary=Manager/application performs concurrent fan-out; adapter decodes catalog descriptions; protocol encodes grouped response. durability=Persist catalog page/source revision and coverage only if cached; no search response authorizes execution without InstrumentId/catalog revision.
MAP-6BAF8CB0BF: effectBoundary=Adapter/catalog decoder maps native descriptions; manager/search service fans out and protocol encodes normalized hit. sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: 审计、accounting、simulation 与 data projection 边界
sections.currentBehavior: TradingGit.log/show/status/export 直接读取内存 commit array，short hash 同时作为 display key 与 pending authority；summary builder 使用 parallel operations/results 与 operation[0] fallback。sync/external/reconcile 将 broker observations 合成为 synthetic Git commits；recordReconcile 以 mark/quantity 写入 success=true/filled。simulation 与 execution/history 共用 class、IBKR Contract/Decimal 和 success/error bag；derivative exclusion/multiplier math 虽然正确但隐含在 class 内。
sections.abstractExpression: GitAuditProjectionRow、OrderProjection、AccountingObservation、SimulationResult、DataPage/DataFrame 是独立的 read semantic values，均由 exact codec/identity/asOf/freshness/coverage 构造。每个 observation/fill row 自带 scope、event/observation identity、native order/execution identity、instrument identity 和 optional transaction/step/dispatch reference；不再以 parallel-array position 归属。reconcile 是 accounting observation/evidence conversion，不是 TradeAction fill。simulation 是基于已验证 PriceChange ADT + PositionSnapshot/valuation assumptions 的 pure Decimal calculation，不能取得 transaction capability。
preservedContract: log reverse chronology、limit、symbol/instrument filter、structured order terms 与 human text summary 继续可查询，但通过 journal sequence cursor、asOf/freshness/ProjectionUnavailable 明确语义。
sync 的多 update、bracket legs、filled-at-push exclusion、external observed rows、exact Decimal strings 和 sentinel omission 继续对用户可见。
underlying symbol change 排除 derivative；`all` 按每一行自身 mark/multiplier 计算 long/short PnL；输入 invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite 明确拒绝。

wallet/account drift 保留 quantity/identity/currency/multiplier/mark provenance；保留已验证的 same-currency FX Identity 和 policy-approved Estimated display value（带 evidence/provenance），只禁止把 unknown/missing 伪造为 1、USD 或 0；合法且有证据的 1:1/default 不被一概删除。
selectedChanges: 在同一 JournalStore committed sequence 上提供明确的 `GitAuditReader` 与 `TransactionReader` read surfaces；short hash 仅作 display alias，audit/transaction identity、sequence、revision 和 effect authority 分开。
把 sync/external/open-order facts 以 ObservationBatch/ObservationJob 写入独立 observation rows；与 started dispatch 关联时保存 dispatchId，但不让 data row 生成 approval/reservation。
将 `getOperationSymbol`、SDK `OrderHelper.toWire`、sentinel/Decimal normalization 限制在 adapter/projection codec；public view 采用 immutable exact schema，禁止 cast 后 spread 任意 native object。
把 simulation 从 TradingGit execution interface 提取为 pure projection service；输入 selector/instrument/currency/multiplier explicit，结果带 assumptions/evidence。
effectAndStateOwnership: Journal event/remote observation 是 authority facts；GitAudit/order/accounting/simulation projection 只读并可重建，projection checkpoint lag 不影响 effect receipt。
Accounting 持有 balance/position/valuation evidence 与 unit conversion；可以发出由 effect 消费的 typed evidence conversion，但不能自行授权 mutation。
Data service 可在 asOf/coverage 下读取 ordinary live data，不必把全部事实写入交易 journal；只有 effect 明确捕获的 selected evidence、control evidence 或 data-owner checkpoint 持久化。
Formatter/log/export sink 仅用于 presentation 且须 redacted；不能把任意输入解析为 execution state，也不能触发 compensation/retry。
failuresAndRecovery: Parallel-array mismatch、unknown operation tag、bad Decimal/sentinel、ambiguous short hash、stale projection、missing scope/instrument/valuation 产生 typed projection/codec errors，不能用 guessed symbol/number/default；coverage 仍只为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，unknown value/quality 留在 payload reason。
reconcile mark-only drift 仍是带 residual uncertainty 的 observed adjustment；不能结算 fill criterion 或制造 compensation。Data projection failure 永不回滚 remote ack。
Data stream 的 item-error/snapshot-end 是 nonterminal frame/control state；terminal Completed|Failed|Cancelled 分立，且不保证 crash 后发出最后 wire frame。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: TradingGit tests 证明当前 formatting、Decimal rehydration、bracket legs、multi-update attribution 与 simulation arithmetic；不证明 durable projection checkpoints、provider observation completeness 或 accounting truth。
Data investigation 尚未验证 source finality、correction/retraction、coverage、replay、feed entitlement 与 unit/FX evidence。不能仅因把 read result 命名为 “fresh” 就提升为 transaction authorization。
migrationCutover: 先依据 committed journal/observation sequence 重建 projections，验证每行 identity/scope/attribution，再切换 log/show/status/export callers；不把旧 commit.json 直接当作新的 transaction rows。
sync/external/reconcile synthetic operations 只作为离线 parity/export projection；新 writer 只记录 typed observations/evidence，删除其作为 effect authority 的路径，禁止 runtime compatibility view/shim。
simulation/market-data route 迁移至 read/data capability leaves，保留 old output wording 仅作 projection；任何 effect consumption 都显式携带 selected evidence revision 与 permission。

sections.title: 精确会计单位、来源与缺失语义
currentBehavior: `cost-basis.ts` 与 `position-math.ts` 已使用 Decimal 计算，但旧边界仍允许 SDK 对象、sentinel 和未限定字符串进入会计辅助函数。
manager/adapter 边界可能把 provider 不可用、缺失集合误读为数值零；负数量、负 PnL 与带符号 decimal 文本都具有业务意义。
账户、子账户、Instrument、provider instance、connection generation、source observation、principal 是不同身份；复合 `aliceId/nativeKey` 不能证明可逆的 `AccountScope`。
abstractExpression: 以不可变、带品牌的 schema-bound 单位表达 `DecimalString`、`Quantity<Unit>`、`Price<Instrument>`、`Money<Currency>`，显式携带 scale/rounding；只有需要账户语义的事实才带 `AccountScope(AccountId, SubAccountId)`。

每个 read projection 携带 `SourceObservation`、`asOf/receivedAt`、adapter/capability revision，以及 `Coverage = Complete | Partial | Unavailable`；unknown value quality 通过独立的 typed quality/reason 表达，缺失不编码为零或空数组。

portable declaration 使用受限 structural schema algebra；命名 `Constraint<Value, Configuration, Failure>` 在构造时绑定 identifier/version、配置与错误 schema、确定性 evaluator artifact 和 digest，validator/descriptor/digest 必须由同一声明派生。
preservedContract: 保留 decimal 文本与精度、正负号、负 exposure、显式零、provider-native quantity/price 字段；未知、缺失、非法值绝不转成零。
保留账户/子账户、Instrument scope、来源、时间、修正关系和 provider extension，但 domain value 不携带 SDK class。
公共数据保持 `PublicSource`，不得为 public source 伪造 funded account。
selectedChanges: 用 schema-decoded constructor 替代裸 number/string/sentinel，返回 `Invalid | Missing | Present` 等精确结果。
删除默认 currency、multiplier、price、side 分支；unknown quality/reason 与 Unavailable 必须阻断或缩窄 valuation/dispatch，而非放行。
native Contract/Order/SDK 解码移到 adapter codec；开放 `Record` 或 index signature 不能作为 portable extension contract。
effectAndStateOwnership: 纯 accounting reducer 拥有单位与确定性 transition；adapter 拥有 native 解码与 wire error；ProjectionStore 拥有派生投影；JournalStore 拥有 durable event 与选定 evidence。
Effect service 只提供 Clock/provider read port/scoped layer 等资源；当前 invocation 的 `PermissionWitness` 是独立 policy 值，不能由提供 Effect service 自动生成。
failuresAndRecovery: decimal 格式错误、unit mismatch、身份缺失、陈旧 observation、未支持 extension 都产生 typed failure/coverage；不得静默走默认值。
correction/retraction 只改变已识别 observation 或 projection revision；没有新来源证据时不能改写历史，也不能把 Unknown 变 Known。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 Decimal 运算、native sentinel import 与当前 SDK/Git 耦合；没有证明 FIFO/lot、short exposure、provider completeness 或 native guarantee。
host law 已在本章落实：foreign certified document 按完整 capability/revision/digest/schema slot 绑定；fill/correction/completeness 仍是 provider empirical evidence。
migrationCutover: 先引入 domain constructor 与 exact codec；导入旧行必须有 scope/Instrument/source manifest，无法还原的历史身份保持 `Unavailable`，不得从 `nativeKey` 推导 `SubAccountId`。
迁移调用者到 typed coverage/provenance，再删除 SDK/Git fixture factory 与 sentinel/default 分支。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: 账户事实、成本基础与估值聚合
currentBehavior: manager 通过 live UTA 调用聚合账户数据、对 unhealthy account 做 recovery nudge、捕获异常，并可能为缺失 USD 行填入零值；position valuation/PnL 来自异构 broker facts。
`cost-basis.ts` 的本地重建是 **LONG-only spot WAC**：支持的 long close 减少数量并保留平均成本；源码没有证明 local short-close、FIFO/lot 或 split reconstruction。旧 replay 仍可能漏记录、推断 relevance，或因 Git 记录不完整丢失 sub-account provenance。
`PositionExposure`/PnL 可保留 broker-reported short facts，但这不等于 `CostBasisState` 已支持 local short-close；guard/source experiment 仍证明 Unknown valuation、非正 equity、无法解析 Instrument 不能变成 permission。
abstractExpression: 定义带 scope/provenance 的 `AccountFacts`、`CashBuckets`、`MarginBuckets`、`FeeBuckets`、`PositionExposure`、`CostBasisState`、`AccountValuation`，每个 component 都有 common Coverage（Complete、Partial、Unavailable）。

`CostBasisState` 是带 policy identity/version 的 pure long-spot-WAC reducer；unsupported short-direction close 或未选择的 accounting policy 返回 `UnsupportedCloseDirection` / `UnsupportedAccountingPolicy`，绝不把 close 默认成 sell。估值携带 common Coverage（Complete、Partial、Unavailable）以及独立 quality/reason payload（包括 Unknown），不能是可空 aggregate。

`PositionExposure` 单独保留正 magnitude + 显式 `Side`；long/short 的 sign（包括 short subtraction）只在 exposure valuation 中穷举处理，不从 unknown side 推断 long。broker-reported short facts 与另行声明的 native short-close capability 作为 exact provider evidence 保留，不伪装成本地 WAC 能力。
不同 scope 独立聚合为 named contribution；空 registry 是 `NoAccounts`，健康 scope 无匹配是 `Complete(empty)`，失败/遗漏 scope 保持 Partial/Unavailable；Coverage 不增加 Unknown 变体。
preservedContract: 选定 local long-spot-WAC policy 时保留其加权平均与 supported long-close 语义；没有显式 policy/evidence 时不宣称 FIFO/lot、split 或 local short-close。realized/unrealized/fees/cash/positions 仍是独立字段和精确 signed 结果。
保留 `PositionExposure` 的正 magnitude + 显式 `Side` 及其 short subtraction；同时保留 broker-reported short facts 和独立声明的 native short-close capability。
健康相关读取保留为 coverage state，不伪造全零账户；keyless/public row 永不计入 funded equity。
估值是 read-only query，不获取 order transaction，也不把数据失败当 compensation。
selectedChanges: 用 typed、policy-tagged `CostBasisState`/result ADT 取代 `CostBasisResult`/raw AggregateInput/Output，并保持 `CostBasisState`、`PositionExposure`、`AccountValuation` 为分离关系；所有调用者显式带 AccountScope + InstrumentId。

cost-basis boundary 只接受已声明的 long-WAC policy；unsupported short direction/unsupported policy 返回 `UnsupportedCloseDirection` / `UnsupportedAccountingPolicy`。PositionExposure boundary 要求 positive magnitude + exhaustive `Side`；unknown side、missing price、missing FX 产生显式 quality/reason 或 Unavailable，而不是 default long/sell。

持久化 AccountFacts/projection 只作为显式 capture、rebuild、selected decision evidence 的 authority；普通 live account query 可通过 typed provider port 直接返回 observedAt/asOf/coverage，manager class、mutable UTA 和 live SDK 都不再是 accounting authority。
effectAndStateOwnership: `CostBasisState` reducer 与 `PositionExposure`/valuation projection 是 pure；provider account/position/fill reads 是 Effect port；writer 持久化 facts/events/projections。FX lookup 是独立 read dependency。
被 guard 消费的 valuation 只是 evidence；controlled invocation 仍需 application 独立计算当前 `PermissionWitness`。
failuresAndRecovery: 账户行缺失、provider listing partial、multiplier/currency 缺失、fill 冲突、stale FX 以及 unsupported close/policy 保持 typed incompleteness/failure；风险决策只能阻断或缩窄，不能变成 zero 或 default-sell。
导入歧义只能进入 authorized reconciliation 或 Unavailable；不能从 snapshot、array position 或 Git message 合成 FillEvent，也不能以 broker-reported short fact 伪造 local WAC close。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 Decimal formula 与 **LONG-only spot WAC** local reconstruction；没有证明 FIFO/lot、split、local short-close policy 或 provider listing completeness。broker short facts/native short-close capability 仍需 adapter evidence。
source experiment 只是本地 callback 证据，不证明 remote broker atomicity、idempotency 或 transaction guarantee。
migrationCutover: 添加 per-source observation decoder 与 policy-versioned reducer；先完成 long-WAC parity，再迁移 guard/route 到显式 valuation ADT，删除 raw aggregate 与 manager-owned accounting effects。

用 manifest 做旧 Git/SDK 记录的 offline parity/import；未解析记录保留 reconciliation evidence，broker-reported short facts 保留原生证据。完成 clean cutover 后，persisted capture/evidence 使用单一 projection authority；普通 live query 仍按 typed provider read 返回 observedAt/asOf/coverage。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: 外汇观测与换算
currentBehavior: `FxService` 是 mutable SDK/cache service，带 fallback/warning；它可以选择 fallback rate，却没有把 freshness、source identity、estimate 状态放进值。
账户/position aggregation 使用换算，因此 missing/stale rate 可能伪装成可用 USD valuation；warning flag 不是 durable accounting state。
abstractExpression: 用 `FxObservation{pair, rate, quoteUnit, provider/source, observedAt, receivedAt, asOf, quality, coverage, revision}` 与 `Result<FxLookupValue,FxSchemaFailure>`。成功值 `FxLookupValue` 的 variants 是 `Identity | Confirmed | Estimated | Stale | UnknownFx | Unavailable`；malformed pair/rate 进入 `FxSchemaFailure` error channel，不是未声明的 Invalid success variant。
CurrencyCode、pair orientation、decimal scale、conversion path 都是 refined schema；lookup 返回带 evidence 的 typed value/error，不暴露 mutable cache。
preservedContract: 保留精确 rate/换算、pair direction、source/as-of、非 USD 账户 currency，以及同币种 `Identity`（例如 USD = 1）这一 value-level identity。
FX 继续是 read-only valuation 输入，不进入 trading transaction，不创建 order lock/compensation。
selectedChanges: 删除 unsupported unknown-code numeric 1:1/default 与 warning-only fallback；保留精确 same-currency `Identity`，配置的 dated rate 可作为显式 `Estimated` display value，但没有适用 policy 时不得授权 conversion/guard。缺失 provider observation time 保持 explicit unknown-time quality，绝不得用 receipt time 改写为 `Confirmed`；stale/estimated 在结果中可见。
network/cache policy 移入 FxPort interpreter，透过 scoped Effect layer 注入；cache entry 不可变，Clock 由 application boundary 提供。
effectAndStateOwnership: FX reducer/projection 拥有 immutable observation；FxPort 拥有 external IO/cache；valuation projection 持久化所选 FX evidence；permission policy 仍是独立 channel。
failuresAndRecovery: malformed pair/rate 在 error channel 产生 `FxSchemaFailure`；missing source timestamp 是 value 上的 explicit unknown-time quality；unsupported currency、source gap、stale observation 保持显式 `FxLookupValue` outcome，provider 失败使 valuation Partial/Unavailable。`Estimated`/identity quality 不得静默提升，unknown-code 1:1 保持 `UnknownFx`/`Unavailable`。
cache hit 不是当前 entitlement 或 provider finality 的证明；refresh/reconciliation 是 observation policy，不是 controlled effect 的自动 retry。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码与测试证明 mutable SDK/cache/fallback；不证明 provider freshness、跨 provider parity 或 universal USD policy。
migrationCutover: 以 schema-bound observation 与 `Result<FxLookupValue,FxSchemaFailure>` 替代 FxRate/FxRateTable/ConvertResult 与 manager setter，迁移 valuation/route，再移除 domain/main 中 FxService construction。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: 订单/成交历史投影与原生丰富度
currentBehavior: `order-history.ts` 同时承担 domain helper、Git projection、SDK/protocol translation 以及 UI/MCP/CLI source，并直接 import Decimal、IBKR Contract/Order、sentinel 和 protocol history record。
TradingGit/poller 观察已发送订单，也会合成 external-order record；send 后抛异常仍可能被转换为看似 rejected 的结果，而远端真实状态其实 Unknown。
abstractExpression: 定义 pure `OrderObservation`、`FillEvent`、`ReconciliationEvent`、`OrderHistoryPage` 与 source-native extension schema，稳定保存 opaque ID、AccountScope、InstrumentId、status transition。
以 journal/projection reducer 提供 history；native order ID、child/leg/group、status、correction 留在精确 extension，公共 query 不 cast SDK instance。
preservedContract: 保留稳定 order/fill identity、broker-native bucket、Decimal 字段、transition 顺序、external-order 可见性和 read-only history。
区分 acknowledgement、working/fill/cancel/replacement 与 Unknown；dispatch 返回不能直接证明 fill。
selectedChanges: 拆分 pure projection 与 native decoding/protocol mapping，移除 Git execution authority 和 query-time Git scan。

持久化 selected execution evidence 与 reconciliation job；snapshot/FX read 不得生成 synthetic transaction event。`Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 保留 receipt/control-result/stage-error association，admission R/P 与 installed execution R/P 分离；fresh Start 只产生一次性 process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，持久化 authorization 不是 grant。
历史 interpretation 按 exact implementation/compiler/version 解析；DispatchStarted 前不可用可 retire 并以新 revision 重新 prepare，DispatchStarted/Unknown 后只能 RecoveryRequired，绝不 reprepare。
effectAndStateOwnership: JournalStore 是 command/event/receipt/job single writer；ProjectionStore 提供 history query；adapter 负责 native codec 与 recovery observer。
Effect R（provider reader、Clock、scoped resource）与当前授权 witness 分离，资源健康不能替代 dispatch permission。
failuresAndRecovery: send 后进程丢失、坏响应、stale capability、provider ambiguity 进入 OutcomeUnknown/RecoveryRequired 并安排 observation，不得 KnownRejected 或 blind resend。
旧记录冲突/不完整保留为 reconciliation candidate/Unavailable，后续 observation 可以解析但不能改写原 evidence。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 Git projection 与 polling；source experiment 证明 snapshot/persist 可能发生在可能 send 之后；不证明 native idempotency 或 venue atomicity。
migrationCutover: 构造 codec/reducer，离线完成带 exact provenance 的 Git row parity/import，再把 UI/MCP/CLI 切到 projection query 作为唯一 history read/write authority；保留未解析历史行，完成 clean cutover 后移除 order-history 的 Git/SDK 耦合。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Snapshot 语义模型与纯捕获
currentBehavior: builder 从 mutable live UTA 组装 nullable snapshot，并 import IBKR sentinel；missing data 由 null/partial fixture 与 provider identity 假设表达。
snapshot type 已用 string 保存财务值且概念上独立于 TradingGit commit，但 completeness、finality、source identity 仍不足。
abstractExpression: pure `buildSnapshot` 消费 immutable AccountFacts/PositionExposure/OrderHistory projection 与 SnapshotCause、capturedAt/asOf、source observation、local received sequence、projection checkpoint、component Freshness/Coherence。
返回 `SnapshotCaptureResult = Captured | Partial | Unavailable | Invalid`；`SnapshotViewEnvelope` 带 AccountScope、schema version/digest、Complete/Partial/Unavailable coverage。

Snapshot 是 query projection，不是 execution authority；Git head/pending 独立为 GitAudit component，provider metadata 由 exact extension 保留。普通 live data query 可经 typed reader 直接返回 observedAt/asOf/coverage；只有显式 capture、rebuild 或 decision-evidence request 才要求 JournalStore 持久化 proof，不把所有 query/Push frame journal 化。
preservedContract: 保留 string decimal、时间范围/read API、source evidence、cause、account/position/order 字段与 no-fabrication。
保留 provider extension richness 和 unknown/partial；空或缺失 source 不是零账户或 synthetic order。
selectedChanges: 调用者迁移后删除 SDK import、live UTA assembly、nullable catch-all 与 monolithic UTASnapshot。
native sentinel/identity 在 provider codec 解码；不以 timestamp、array position、chunk name、未验证 revision 充当 cursor。
push 中的 snapshot-end/item-error 是 nonterminal；只有本地 stream lifecycle 产生 `Completed|Failed|Cancelled`，crash 不承诺最后 wire frame。
effectAndStateOwnership: pure assembly 不做 IO；reader/observer 是 Effect port；durable capture request/job 属于 JournalStore；view/metadata 属于 ProjectionStore；snapshot read 不拿 order lock。
failuresAndRecovery: component 读取失败产生 Partial/Unavailable 与 typed redacted reason；malformed native field 是 invalid evidence，不是 null success。
durable request 后 capture 失败时 request/receipt 仍可查询和 reconcile；callback failure 不删除 source event，也不表示 transaction failure。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 nullable live assembly、string financial value、Git separation；native stream finality/replay/completeness 仍需 provider evidence。
migrationCutover: 添加 pure builder/schema decoder，再把 route/consumer 迁到 SnapshotProjectionQuery；所有 caller 迁完且 durable result query 覆盖后，删除 createSnapshotStore/direct builder/null protocol。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: 持久化 Snapshot 接入、调度与流生命周期
currentBehavior: 旧 Pump 使用 in-process timer 和 direct `takeAllSnapshots` fan-out；SnapshotService 装 post hook 并调用 callback。Main 启动 worker 却没有为每个 worker 保存 durable owner/lifecycle handle。
scheduled 与 commit-triggered 工作可能在 restart 丢失或被错误 coalesce；listener 没有 durable cursor、ack、lease、receipt、retry。
abstractExpression: 使用可序列化 `SnapshotRequest{scope,cause,sourceSequence,priority,coalescePolicy}` 与 DurableScheduler job，具备 queue capacity、lease、attempt、backoff、cancel、receipt；source-event request 不可丢，periodic/telemetry 可按显式 policy coalesce。
Schedule/Scope 拥有 fiber 与 cancel。request 等待 recovery/cursor barrier，读取 typed data ports，提交 capture/projection result 并产生 durable receipt；不暗中 broker mutation。
push 的 item-error、gap、correction、snapshot-end 都是 nonterminal；owner 存活时只产生一个 `Completed|Failed|Cancelled`，crash/restart 通过 durable reconcile，不承诺最终 wire frame。
preservedContract: 保留 scheduled/manual/commit cause、ordering/coalescing policy、cancel 和 snapshot 的 read-only side effect。
保留 post-commit observation intent，但 callback 不是 transaction commit，也不是 order authority。
selectedChanges: 用 durable per-scope admission/job 替代 Pump、setSnapshotHooks、callback 与 void fire-and-forget；区分 periodic 与 source-event priority。
在打开新 read boundary 前持久化 cursor/checkpoint/receipt；禁止从 timestamp、array position、chunk name 推断 cursor，restart 恢复 exact request identity。
failed item 不得后续变 Completed；native snapshot-end 不终止持续订阅；transport crash 留下 durable job/cursor reconcile。
effectAndStateOwnership: JournalStore 负责 request admission/event consumption；DurableScheduler 负责 lease/fiber；ProjectionStore 负责 view；provider stream 只拥有自己的 scoped resource handle。
Clock/Sleep/AbortSignal 属于 Effect R；source entitlement/current permission 是独立 witness。
failuresAndRecovery: queue full、lease expiry、source gap、malformed data、provider disconnect、writer failure 都有 typed outcome；lease expiry 不授权可能已发送的 controlled effect 重放。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 in-process timer/callback 与局部故障实验；不证明生产 journal cursor、provider replay 或 remote finality。
migrationCutover: 构造 durable request/job 与 scheduler interpreter；对已捕获的旧 hook fixture 离线比较 receipt，再将 source-event/periodic caller 切到新的唯一 scheduler authority，之后删除 Pump、direct hook、无 owner timer。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Snapshot 持久化、投影查询与保留策略
currentBehavior: SnapshotStore 是 per-account JSONL file store，提供 append/delete/readRange/getRecent 与 chunk metadata；旧 chain 可能使用 temp+rename、raw JSON scan，普通 delete 可能抹掉 rebuild 所需记录。
service 同时拥有 path、persistence、fan-out，使 query、retention、capture、lifecycle failure 混在 mutable live UTA composition。
abstractExpression: ProjectionStore 提供 typed `SnapshotProjectionQuery(AccountScope, Instant/sequence bounds, limit, schema/revision filter)` 与 immutable view metadata；JournalStore 保留 source event、request receipt、selected evidence。
retention/compaction 是对 data identity/sequence/checkpoint/unresolved evidence 的 authorized policy，不是普通 delete，不能抹掉 rebuild 或 RecoveryRequired 所需 source observation。
SnapshotId/range/cursor 是 schema-bound identity；count/chunk name 不是 domain cursor，raw JSON cast/scan 不得越过 boundary。
preservedContract: 保留 offline-readable history、range/recent query、decimal string、cause/source metadata 与可 rebuild projection。
retention 时保留 unresolved/uncertain capture evidence 与 stable ID；删除/compaction 必须显式授权。
selectedChanges: 用 typed writer command/query 替代 per-account store、writeChain、doAppend/doDelete、chunk type、raw scan；snapshot history 只读，不是 execution authority。
capture 在所选 data-writer policy 内原子提交 source evidence + projection metadata，但不把所有 IO/provider call 宣称成 financial transaction。
effectAndStateOwnership: JournalStore 负责 durable authority；ProjectionStore 负责 derived snapshot；RetentionPolicy/CompactionJob 负责 authorized cleanup；Runtime Scope 只持有并一次释放资源。
failuresAndRecovery: write/read corruption、schema mismatch、cursor gap、compaction/writer failure 都是 typed error + recovery record；writer failure 不得报告 admission 成功。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码证明 JSONL/path/append/delete/range；不证明 production DB、跨进程 atomicity 或 monotonic source sequence。
migrationCutover: 先构造 typed writer/query port，带 digest/source metadata 导入旧 row；只有 runtime inventory 证明 cursor 后才写 migration cursor。所有 reader/retention 切换后删除 file-specific API。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: AccountScope、wallet valuation、position 与 risk observation
currentBehavior: MAP-96DFCD8720：getAccount returns a zeroed USD AccountInfo in keyless mode. Funded reads iterate balance entries, ignore reserved keys and every `total <= 0`, value the hard-coded stablecoin set at 1 USD, price only positive assets, omit unpriced assets, add no derivative notional, and optionally sum derivative PnL/margin.

MAP-D0D258423E：resolveSubAccounts returns override metadata or one implicit `{default, unified, walletTypes:[]}` descriptor. Omitted reads aggregate all declared wallet types (or call fetchBalance() unscoped for unified), contract routing chooses derivatives/spot and falls back to the first descriptor, and unknown selectors throw a CONFIG message listing ids.

MAP-13B4870B11：Derivative rows are converted directly to legacy Position. Quantity is `abs(contracts) * contractSize`, side is long only for native `long` and otherwise short, mark/entry/unrealized/realized values become Decimal from native values or zero defaults, and leverage/liquidation/cross-or-isolated risk is optionally stringified.

MAP-941D4989E1：Zero-size rows are silently omitted as if no exposure; a nonzero row with an unknown market is also omitted before conversion. Negative contracts lose sign through abs, and no suppression/completeness evidence reaches callers.

MAP-13B0841BEB：Spot synthesis aggregates positive `entry.total` values by coin, excludes the stablecoin set, chooses the first active spot market in USDT/USDC/USD preference, and drops holdings lacking a ticker or market. It emits a long Position with Decimal quantity, mark-derived marketValue, zero PnL, multiplier 1, and `avgCostSource:"wallet"`; spot/perp local symbols remain distinct.

MAP-35AC3BA580：The method combines wallet decode, quote effects, and projection: it sums only positive reported totals across balances, excludes the stablecoin set, drops unpriced assets, and emits long holdings with `marketValue=quantity*last`, `avgCost=last`, `unrealizedPnl=0`, `realizedPnl=0`, multiplier 1.

MAP-6455883050：The helper returns only `{balances, initMargin}`. A permissive typed-wallet failure is warned/skipped; strict failure rejects; a unified unscoped failure always rejects; successful but empty/partial balances have no completeness marker or source namespace in the result.

MAP-7A96BC3C72：Keyless is represented as `{baseCurrency:"USD", netLiquidation:"0", ...}` rather than no-account. Funded aggregation reads positive `entry.total` only, excludes reserved keys, treats the hard-coded stablecoin set as USD cash, drops unpriced assets, and leaves source wallet/completeness/freshness out of AccountInfo.

MAP-452BD82D18：The method skips all keyless position reads, suppresses zero-size and unknown-market rows, fabricates zero mark/entry/PnL for missing fields, and combines derivative plus spot Positions without scope/catalog/source-time/completeness evidence.

MAP-D41146E23D：Subaccount discovery is in-memory and has no network/evidence state. Omitted selector means all descriptors for wallet reads (or one unscoped call for unified); contract routing can silently choose the first descriptor when kind is missing, and unknown explicit ids throw a CONFIG string.

MAP-6E4BF40E6B：The helper is an effectful selector over a mutable exchange and yields unscoped native rows. It does not identify wallet/position namespace, attach observedAt/scope, validate row shape, or classify partial/unavailable results.

MAP-56273A243C：Unified venues are represented as one in-memory default subaccount. Risk fields use JS number comparisons/stringification; zero/missing leverage or liquidation is omitted, unknown marginMode is ignored, and the result is attached directly to a legacy Position.

currentBehavior: MAP-EFA3DC1861：For funded accounts getOpenOrders converts a single override/default listing; conversion failures are skipped. Strict override errors propagate, but permissive errors are warned once and returned as an empty array. Keyless mode also returns empty despite having no account namespace.

MAP-BD94311C25：Funded getOrders performs sequential nullable per-id lookups and silently omits cache-missing, not-found, malformed, and transport-failed orders. Keyless returns [] without account evidence; empty input is a no-op.

MAP-68984949FD：The method has no explicit account scope or per-id outcome. Public/keyless and funded-not-found/unknown all appear as empty lists or omitted ids, so callers cannot distinguish no account, not found, transport failure or malformed response.

MAP-43A1221FB0：Order lookup depends on a process Map or unverified caller hint; no durable namespace/scope descriptor is required. Any missing symbol returns null before a call, and any endpoint/decoder/transport exception also becomes null.

MAP-B1984D4EF6：The method returns a bare array. Keyless returns [] without an account listing; successful rows whose market conversion fails are skipped; a Binance/default listing failure returns [] after a warning, while strict Bitget/Bybit namespace failure throws. No coverage/cursor/source time is retained.

currentBehavior: MAP-84ED65764F：The quote adapter reads mutable catalog state, returns a legacy Quote with zero defaults for missing last/bid/ask/volume, leaves high/low optional, and treats local now as the timestamp when the ticker has no source timestamp.

MAP-E1440798A9：getHistorical maps the CCXT timeframe token, optionally checks the exchange timeframes map, computes a local trailing since bound, fetches one page, filters rows by start/end timestamps, takes the last limit rows, and stringifies OHLCV values without validating row shape/order.

MAP-A6AEF5E71C：getMarketClock always returns `{isOpen:true,timestamp:new Date()}` for any broker state, including before init. It carries no scope, session policy, maintenance evidence or timestamp provenance.

MAP-23A28BDB57：The adapter advertises account-wide static security/order types and realtime bars even when no catalog, credential, subaccount, endpoint or current runtime health evidence is attached. Search can map FUT/OPT rows, but this capability method does not advertise them.

MAP-1FEC8E666F：Capabilities are available pre-init and account-wide; they do not vary by instrument/catalog, wallet scope, sandbox/demo, credential authority or runtime health. The method advertises no TP/SL/trailing/TIF/relation/future/option support.
MAP-4107F398E7：Any broker state yields the same open boolean and local timestamp. No venue maintenance/session endpoint, scope, policy or timestamp provenance is included.

MAP-4193D2ACAC：The method returns a legacy Quote tied to a mutable market lookup. Missing last/bid/ask/volume become "0"; high/low remain optional; missing ticker timestamp is replaced by local now, and any fetch/resolve failure becomes BrokerError.

MAP-724573CD02：The adapter fetches one page anchored near the trailing upper bound, filters timestamps, returns latest requested rows, and wraps all exceptions as BrokerError. It does not validate row arity/numeric finiteness/order or carry source/query completeness; absent timeframes means no support check.

MAP-611040E552：These provider DTOs force binary-number rates/levels and legacy Contract identity; they cannot represent scope, native namespace, source-versus-observed time, freshness, malformed/missing fields or completeness. Adapter methods fill some missing values before constructing them.

MAP-DD2E55D8B2：Funding returns legacy FundingRate with an IBKR Contract and JS number rate; missing required rate appears as zero, missing source timestamp appears as a local Date, and scope/canonical identity/freshness are omitted.

MAP-C20A19F881：The orderbook adapter returns legacy numeric tuples, fake `[0,0]` for null fields, and a local timestamp when source timestamp is absent. It does not validate limit, level finiteness/order, scope, identity or completeness.
abstractExpression: quote、historical bars、funding、order book、clock 与 capability observation 当前均按有限 Pull leaf 处理。每个 leaf 自己声明 exact schema、freshness/quality、source timestamp、asOf 与 Kernel Coverage（Complete|Partial|Unavailable）及 failure；unknown value/quality 不能用 zero 或 local now 伪造，但 source-provided legitimate zero、verified same-currency FxIdentity 与明确 policy-approved Estimated display value 仍可保留。未来 push 必须使用 Start、Update/Correction/Retraction/Gap、SnapshotEnd、recoverable item error 与单一 terminal outcome 的 foreign boundary；ordinary live data 不是 order transaction，也不需要把每帧写入 full-feed WAL。

MAP-84ED65764F：把 quote、bars、funding、orderbook、clock 与 capability observation 作为独立 finite Pull leaf，保留 source/observed time、asOf、精确数值与 Coverage 三值；unknown value/quality 是 payload/reason，普通 live read 不写 full-feed WAL。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep valid string/Decimal fields and unresolved-identity refusal.；Keep local Date.now only as local observedAt evidence, not venue time.；Remove numeric zero fabrication for absent fields.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Quote field mapping and unresolved-identity refusal remain a finite pull leaf; the host contract separate source time, local observation time, and missing fields so quote data cannot silently authorize sizing.

currentBehavior: MAP-DD9535B452：源码注释记录 Hyperliquid 没有 native market order、需 reference ticker 的 slippage-bounded IOC-limit 仿真及 80% server deviation cap；同一文件的 parsePosition 不填 markPrice、把 positionValue 映射为 notional。注释本身不证明当前 override 已执行 bound/cap 校验。
