sections.title: IBKR 账户回调：Decimal 持仓、币种桶与可选估值 enrichment
currentBehavior: updatePortfolio 接收 Contract、Decimal position、string prices/values/PnL 和 accountName，但忽略 accountName。以 conId 为键，移除零数量，去重重复更新，将期权 averageCost 从已计入 multiplier 的值转为每单位值，并将增量应用到 pending/live 缓冲区。
updateAccountValue 存储 key:currency 和普通 key；BASE 或首行占用普通槽位。accountDownloadEnd 交换 pending/live 并确认就绪。无原生序号/时间戳。AccountSummary 使用不安全的 Map 强制转换。
getAccount 在 broker NetLiquidation 不可用时回退到重建值，BaseCurrency 缺失时假定为 USD。FX 行为 Decimal/null，未验证正值。getPositions 叠加 OPT/FOP 标记价（成功 15s，不可用 60s）。投资组合标记价可能隔夜冻结，而快照包含隔夜数据。
getQuote 将缺失值转为 "0"，将缺失时间戳替换为本地 Date；getMarketClock 使用 currentTime/本地回退值及硬编码的 NYSE 工作日时段。
abstractExpression: AccountValueObservation={AccountScope,key,kind,Money{DecimalString,currency},source,observedAt,generation,receiveSequence,quality,consolidation}；保留每条分币种行和 BASE 行。

PositionObservation={AccountScope,InstrumentId,accountName 证据,带符号 Quantity,Side,每单位 avgCost,mark,marketValue,PnL,multiplier,currency,observedAt,source,generation,closureEvidence}；零值仅在有来源质量依据时才可为 Closed。receiveSequence 为适配器本地序号；generation 缺口需要重新建立基线。
QuoteObservation 为 Public 或显式 AccountScoped，具有逐字段的 Present/Absent/Invalid、Decimal 单位、来源通道、observedAt、Live/Delayed/Stale 和 Complete/Partial/Unavailable。OptionMarkEvidence 可选，不构成许可。
账户推送在唯一的 Completed|Failed|Cancelled 生命周期终态之前，使用非终止条目错误和快照/基线结束控制。失败不能标记为完成；崩溃可能不留最终帧，因此 ProjectionCheckpoint/Gap 是恢复证据。
纯账户 reducer 推进持久化基线/增量检查点，绝不写入全帧订单 WAL；缺失基线/存在缺口时，不得凭空生成激活或执行许可。
普通行情/账户读取可返回 asOf、coverage 和 quality，无需逐帧记日志。仅持久化选定的采集/控制证据，以及投影/恢复所需的最小基线/增量检查点。同币种 FX 恒等关系是有效的纯事实；跨币种 Estimated 展示仅在显式策略下允许，且始终与 Exact 区分。
preservedContract: 保留即时增量、pending/live 交换、BASE 优先级/延迟修正、去重、有证据的零值平仓、Decimal 精度和期权 multiplier 归一化。
保留公共快照覆盖范围/延迟模式/期权叠加，同时保留来源质量差异。
保留有限值 broker NetLiquidation 的优先级，以及所有带币种限定的观测。
selectedChanges: 用 schema、reducer 和持久化 ProjectionCheckpoint 替换 Map/string/可变 Position[]；仅在基线提交后就绪。
验证有限 Decimal、正值 FX 和 multiplier；缺失/负值/NaN/Infinity 均为 UnknownFx。
用字段可用性/来源信息替换行情零值/默认时间戳；普通快照遵循结束标记。
保持数据补充可选；预期的不可用可保留陈旧标记价，格式错误的回调仍须可见。
不得将未知 FX 伪造为 1；保留同币种恒等关系，以及策略批准且带来源信息的 Estimated 展示值，而精确副作用的前置条件要求质量获准。
effectAndStateOwnership: Bridge 解码回调和 generation 证据；纯 reducer 应用增量/BASE。
ProjectionWriter 提交观测/检查点/新鲜度，不是订单 WAL。
Accounting 使用符合条件的 Money/FX/标记价；受控副作用仅存储选定证据的标识/策略。
failuresAndRecovery: 缺失基线、不匹配、无效 Decimal、未知标签族或序号缺口会使投影降级/安排重建基线。
不可信的零值仍属不确定；墓碑防止旧完整行复活。
显式表示缺失/延迟/陈旧/无效行情状态。
FX 不可用会产生 Incomplete/Unknown 并阻止精确前置条件成立，但不清除持仓。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: DownloadEnd/增量顺序、零值终局性、标签完整性、accountName 匹配、回调时间戳/序号及 multiplier 变体均未经证实。
README 证明投资组合冻结/隔夜差异，不证明普遍市场保证。
时钟回退不能证明 tradingHours/节假日语义。
migrationCutover: 对账户观测执行离线一致性校验/导入，再切换到质量感知的单一权威投影读取器；不采用推测性的双读/兼容层。
普通实时读取保持为 asOf/coverage/quality，不逐帧记日志；持久化显式选定的采集/控制证据和检查点。
添加增量、BASE、缺口、延迟/缺失 tick、隔夜、FX 恒等/估算/未知及数据补充失败的一致性测试。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Longbridge balance/position/quote/depth/session/FX 数据
currentBehavior: AccountBalance 包含 currency 和类似 Decimal 的 totalCash/netAssets/buyPower/initMargin/maintenanceMargin。无 FX 时，foldBalancesToBase 选择 HKD 或最大分桶；有 FX 时汇总为 HKD；空结果变为零，unrealizedPnL 常为零。
stockPositions 丢弃零值，展平符号并去重，再补充 quote/static/option/warrant。失败时回退到 cost、equity 或 multiplier 1。
Quote 合并 quote/depth；depth 被拒绝时变为空/零。Session 含数字 market 和时分秒边界，但 getMarketClock 使用本地 Date 的分钟，空 sessions 变为 false。getOrder 捕获所有异常并丢弃 null 行；未知 status 映射为 Submitted。
abstractExpression: AccountBalanceObservation 保留每个 currency 分桶及全部五个 Decimal 字段，并附带 scope/source/version/time。Valuation 为 Exact|Stale|Estimated|Unknown，并带显式 FxObservation；无 FX 的选择无法满足精确副作用前置条件。
ExposureObservation 保留 channel、InstrumentId、带符号 quantity、cost/currency/market、零值平仓记录及补充信息引用。EquityLike|OptionLike|WarrantLike|Unresolved 是结构分类。
Quote/Depth 区分 Present、EmptyBook、BidOnly、AskOnly、Unavailable，并附带 source/time/freshness。当前调用为有限拉取；未来推送必须声明生命周期。
SessionObservation 保留原始枚举和精确边界；纯求值接收交易场所时区/日历/日期/节假日，返回 Open|Closed|Unknown/下一边界。
每个数据叶节点在构造时绑定确切的 schema/constraint 槽位；getter codec/descriptor 指纹不得漂移。副作用服务 R 与账户权限分离。
未来账户/quote 推送使用非终止的逐项错误/snapshot-end，以及唯一的 Completed|Failed|Cancelled；失败/崩溃的所有者不得宣称完成。选定证据可供后续副作用使用，但实时绑定变化不得重新解释已启动的计划。
Coverage 保持 Complete|Partial|Unavailable；EmptyBook、EmptyObserved 和 Unknown session/valuation 是载荷/原因状态。同币种 FX 是精确恒等；策略批准的 Estimated 显示值保留 source/freshness，绝不静默升级为执行质量。普通实时读取使用 asOf/coverage，不逐帧记日志。
preservedContract: 保留原生余额分桶、带符号数量、Decimal 运算、补充信息调用、quote 时间戳和 session 值。
保留有效的非零/mark 投影及兼容映射，作为展示。
保留逐行可选的信息补充。
selectedChanges: 将 HKD/最大分桶/零总额替换为逐币种事实/质量；未知 FX 阻止精确前置条件成立，同时保留余额。
保留 channel/零值行；按 scope+identity+channel 去重。衍生品信息缺失时安排恢复，而非使用 multiplier 1。
移除以 cost 代替 mark 及 depth 置零；保留缺失/单边/不可用状态。
用显式时区/日历求值器替换本地分钟 bool；空/失败为 Unknown。
将捕获所有异常后返回 order null 改为逐项 coverage/failure。
移除 unknown=1 的编造值，同时保留同币种恒等和策略显式批准的 Estimated 显示值；精确执行前置条件要求允许的质量。
effectAndStateOwnership: 原生 codec 校验 getter/Decimal/枚举；纯 reducer 计算敞口/估值。
读取投影/缓存与订单 WAL/CAS 分离。
副作用仅持久化选定观测的 identity/as-of/quality。
failuresAndRecovery: 空响应为 EmptyObserved，而非零。无效字段使该行/先前投影降级。
未知 FX/过期/默认值/缺失 multiplier/quote 为 Unknown/Incomplete；不以 1/0 替代。
Depth 失败为 Unavailable；空盘口要求已证实的 coverage。
未知 status 为原始值/RecoveryRequired；缺失详情为 Partial/Unavailable；空 session 为 Unknown。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: Getter 接口不是 schema；envelope/version/status/error/quote/depth/multiplier/FX/session 事实需要一致性验证。
没有列表完整性、取消订阅/重放、幂等性或确认前已接受的证明。
fx-service 默认值/unknown 1:1 及分桶回退是观测到的回退行为，不是精确估值。
migrationCutover: 对分桶/channel/quote 观测执行离线一致性比对/导入，再切换到单一权威、质量感知的投影；不采用推测性的双读/兼容垫片。
持久化选定用于捕获/控制的原始观测/检查点；普通实时帧仍为查询数据，而非完整订单 WAL。
添加格式错误/缺失与零值区分/channel/depth/FX 恒等/estimated/unknown/时区/信息补充测试样例。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Alpaca：账户、持仓与账户级事实
sections.currentBehavior: account 与 positions 用 Promise.all 并发读取，raw string/number 直接转 Decimal/legacy Position；side 取值以 long/other 二分，market value 取 abs，realized PnL/units/currency/snapshot provenance 不全。getAccount 计算 cash/equity/buying power/unrealized sums，并把 response rows 当作同一一致快照。
sections.abstractExpression: 账户/持仓是 AccountScope-bound data units，不是交易 transaction。`AccountObservation`、`PositionObservation`、`ExecutionObservation` 使用 runtime schema 与 exact decimal strings；side、signed exposure、currency、multiplier、valuation completeness、source/as-of、connection generation 和 observation identity 分开。并发 Pull 的结果保留各自 timestamps/hash 与 consistency marker；`coverage` 仍只报告 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；未证明 common snapshot 时另附 `ConsistencyEvidence=Unknown|Inconsistent` payload/reason。
preservedContract: 保留 Alpaca raw account/position fields（cash、equity、buying_power、qty、avg_entry_price、current_price、market_value、unrealized_pl/plpc、cost_basis）及 Decimal 精度。
保留 long/short、zero、fractional quantity 和 provider-specific extensions；不因旧 Position 只支持一种 side 而丢弃数据。
账户资金、持仓与订单事实仍可供 place/close 的 prepare 使用，但仅通过选中 evidence 关联。
保留已验证同币种 `FxIdentity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display projection；只移除 unknown=1/伪造完整估值，不删除真实的一比一关系。
selectedChanges: 为 raw account/position 加 runtime schemas、scope、currency/asset identity、as-of/source 与 row completeness；未知 side/decimal/field 不转换成 short/zero。
将 valuation reducer 作为纯函数：缺失 FX/mark/multiplier/PnL 时返回 Incomplete/DerivedUnavailable，而不是 abs/1/0 fallback。
并发 reads 组合为独立 finite Pull results；不宣称 Promise.all 带来原子快照。
close partial 只消费 Complete scoped exposure observation，并把 before-image/version/hash 复制到 effect plan；账户读取本身不取得交易 lock。
估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated display；未知 FX/mark/multiplier 不用 1 或 0 冒充完整，但已验证的一比一关系可保留。
effectAndStateOwnership: Account/Position observation storage 归 data owner；账户读失败不会触发 order compensation。
withTransaction 仅冻结 selected exposure/precondition，writer 管理 reservation/CAS；provider account probe 不能代替 permission witness。
failuresAndRecovery: 账户/position row malformed、unknown currency/side、stale/partial observation、scope mismatch、transport failure 需逐项 typed result。
跨 DispatchStarted 的 close/place 仅按 durable order identity 和新 observation recovery；普通账户 Pull 的 timeout 不转为 order Unknown。
缺少完整 position listing 时阻止 full-close safety claim，但保留可查询原始/unknown rows。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 本地模型没有证明 base currency、market value sign、common snapshot、pagination、realized PnL 或 order activity completeness；USD 与 timestamp 只能来自显式 config/provider evidence。
`_assertCloseQuantityWithinPosition` 是本地 admission guard，不是 venue CAS/reduce-only/atomic guarantee。
migrationCutover: 先把 account/position raw interfaces 变成 adapter-private decode records，再由 query leaves 输出 typed observations。
迁移 account projection、close preparation 与 history/reconciliation caller；删除 `abs`、hardcoded USD/zero PnL/short fallback。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Alpaca：快照、Candle、Feed、Session 与能力发现
sections.currentBehavior: quote 将 snapshot 的 trade/quote/daily 数值压缩为 legacy Quote；bars generator 被 drain 后 tail-slice，固定 adjustment/feed 假设；clock 把账户级 boolean 当作 session；capabilities 为静态数组；SIP 403 通过 message regex fallback 到 IEX，其他错误以字符串传播。
sections.abstractExpression: Market data 使用 Public/provider/instrument scope 的 finite Pull：`MarketSnapshot`、`Candle<AlpacaExtension>`、`SessionObservation`、`FeedCapability` 各自有 input/success/failure/coverage/as-of schema。snapshot 保留 source、symbol、VWAP/trade count、sizes 和 quote shape；Candle 保留 interval、timezone/session、adjustment、provisional/closed/unknown finality、cursor；future Push 使用 owned Stream 的 item-error/snapshot-end 非terminal frames 与 `Completed|Failed|Cancelled` terminal sum。能力 descriptor 从叶子 schema 派生，不是静态 action map。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。
preservedContract: 保留 `ALPACA_TIMEFRAME` 的显式 interval mapping，以及 generator 的有限结果语义。
保留 SIP→IEX 的业务 fallback 意图，但把它变成版本化 FeedPolicy/typed entitlement denial，不靠 regex 猜错误。
保留 quote 单源/partial snapshot 与 provisional Candle，不合成 bid/ask/finality。
selectedChanges: raw Snapshot/Bar/Clock/FillActivity 用 runtime schema，精确保留 native optional fields；不以 `String(number)` 掩盖非有限/缺字段。
历史查询返回 per-source cursor/completeness、adjustment/feed、as-of；tail 是显式 query projection，不能把截断结果标为 Complete。
clock 绑定 venue/session/calendar/timezone evidence；`isOpen` 不是所有 instrument 的交易许可。
SIP/IEX entitlement availability 与 market data requirement 独立于 write capability；403/429/500 分为 typed provider errors。
fill activity 若声明为 Pull/Push，保留 order identity/qty/price/time/type；stream failure 不删除此前 ack/fill。
effectAndStateOwnership: quote/Candle/clock/catalog/listings 由 MarketData/Connection resources 提供，普通读取不使用 order WAL/approval/compensation。
只有被订单 prepare 选中的价格/session/feed evidence 进入 controlled effect plan；控制 journal 只保存最小证据与 predicate checkpoint，不保存整条行情流。
Stream owner 负责 backpressure/cancel/release；关闭 tail 不能取消另一个 durable waiting intent。
若数据触发 deferred invocation，使用纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` 与 durable checkpoint；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 activation owner，事件证据不能越级授权。
failuresAndRecovery: Pull coverage 为 Complete/Partial/Unavailable；Push item error 可恢复，snapshot-end 不等于 stream terminal，Failed 后不得 Completed。
断连、feed denial、schema violation、unknown finality 仍是 typed data outcomes；native ack 后的 stream failure 不抹掉 ack。
外部源身份/代际/顺序纳入 frame metadata；local receive counter 不推导 remote replay identity。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: installed SDK entity/pagination/feed docs 未证明 generator boundary、source atomicity、feed entitlement codes、session calendar、bar finality/replay 或 fill activity completeness。
静态 `getCapabilities` 数组不是当前账户/permission/catalog 的事实；未证实 order variant 留在 unavailable 或不发布。
migrationCutover: 先以离线 parity/import 对照 exact data leaves 与旧 Quote/Bar/MarketClock 结果；随后迁移 callers 并删除旧 shape，除非已验证 published external boundary 明确要求只读投影。
CLI/AI discover 直接消费最终 descriptor tree；删除静态 capabilities、unknown→day/status、账户级恒真 clock。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: Leverup：Pyth、账户、持仓与市场数据 Pull
sections.currentBehavior: Pyth number 被同时映射 bid/ask/last、volume=0；reader 只拉 page 0/OPEN rows，unknown pair 静默丢弃，entry price 充当 market price，margin/fees/PnL 直接近似；account balance 与 positions 并发但无 common snapshot，clock 恒定 open，capabilities 静态宣称 CRYPTO_PERP/MKT。
sections.abstractExpression: Public Pyth/Instrument/quote/session 是 finite Pull；account balance/positions/order facts 是 AccountScope-bound Pull。`PriceObservation` 保留 feed、exact integer/exponent/Decimal、confidence、publish/fetch、freshness、`quoteShape: SingleSourceMid` 与 update evidence；`PositionListing` 保留 all statuses/pages/coverage/cursor；`CashObservation` 使用 CurrencyMetadata/Money。所有 data leaves 只需要 Connection/Reader/Hermes R，不取得 transaction permission。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。
preservedContract: 保留 Pyth publish time 与 binary update 作为不同 evidence；mark-only quote 不伪造独立 bid/ask。
保留 REST fields（qty、entryPrice、margin、fee strings、status、closeInfo）及 10/18/6 scales where verified。
OPEN view 仍可由 Complete listing 的纯 projection 得出；CLOSED/unknown/partial 记录不会消失。
保留已验证同币种 `FxIdentity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display projection；只移除 unknown=1/伪造完整估值，不删除真实的一比一关系。
selectedChanges: Pyth update 与 parsed price 分叶，feed identity/hex/schema/completeness/freshness 校验；Number/Math.pow、parsed[0] assumption 删除。
reader 用 bounded page iterator/runtime codec 返回 Complete/Partial/Unavailable；保留 CLOSED/unknown rows 与 page counters，不把 page0 视作 absence。
account balance 绑定 AccountId/SubAccountId、token metadata、block/as-of/generation；fee/PnL 未知则保留 FeeEvidence/Incomplete。
session clock 返回 evidence-backed `MarketSession`，无 calendar 时 Unknown；static capabilities 改为 descriptor-derived availability。
估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated display；未知 FX/mark/multiplier 不用 1 或 0 冒充完整，但已验证的一比一关系可保留。
effectAndStateOwnership: Hermes/REST/RPC Pull 的 transport/backoff/cancellation 属于独立 data resources；只把 selected price/position evidence 复制进 effect plan。
data observation checkpoint 可持久化但不进入 order WAL；close effect 另行记录 position hash/revision。
若数据触发 deferred invocation，使用纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` 与 durable checkpoint；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 activation owner，事件证据不能越级授权。
failuresAndRecovery: bad feed, stale/negative/future price, page gap, malformed row, unknown unit, missing block, session unknown 都是 typed data outcomes。
普通 reader timeout 不生成 RecoveryCase；只有 close/open 已 DispatchStarted 后的 status/position ambiguity 进入 effect recovery。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: fee currency/scale、Pyth confidence/finality、reader pagination consistency/retention、calendar/session、balance snapshot 与 net liquidation 仍需 provider evidence。
mocked booleans/always-open clock/entry-as-market 不构成 native guarantee。
migrationCutover: 先实现 Pull schemas/coverage and observations，再迁移 account/position/quote/clock projections。
删除 silent continue、zero volume/PnL、synthetic bid/ask、page0-only and always-open authority。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: LeverupProtocols：Hermes Pyth updates 与 exact price observation
sections.currentBehavior: pyth.ts 用固定 Hermes URL、global fetch 与 optional interface；只检查 binary.data 非空，parsed[0] 被当作 requested feed；Number(price)*Math.pow(expo) 丢失 exact precision，confidence/age/sign/future/exponent policy 未校验。
sections.abstractExpression: 分别声明 `market-data.pyth.updates` 与 `market-data.pyth.price` leaves。Updates 返回 bounded `HermesV2Envelope`/binary evidence、FeedSet、hash、coverage；Price 返回 `PriceObservation {InstrumentId,FeedId,QuoteCurrency,integer,exponent,exactDecimal,confidence,publishAt,fetchAt,source,freshness,quoteShape}`。Both are Public finite Pull; open effect 只消费 frozen observation/update digest。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。
preservedContract: 支持多 feed 请求、binary.data 作为 native request evidence 与 publish_time 作为 source timestamp。
single-source Pyth mark 继续可用于 quote，但明确 `quoteShape: SingleSourceMid`，不伪造 bid/ask/volume。
confidence/exponent/publish/fetch fields 作为 evidence 保留，即使 policy result unavailable。
selectedChanges: runtime decode JSON/hex/feed equality、parsed data、integer/exponent/confidence/timestamps；normalize/dedupe/sort FeedSet。
加入 timeout/cancel/size bound/rate and freshness policy；result coverage 是 Complete/Partial/Unavailable。
exact decimal codec 取代 Number/Math.pow；选入 controlled effect 时 pin update hash、price observation、policy revision、catalog/schema revision。
market data failure 不启动 compensation/approval；future Push 若增加，按 owned stream item-error/snapshot-end/terminal law 独立实现。
effectAndStateOwnership: Hermes HTTP/cancellation/resource quota 是 MarketData Effect R；decode/policy/freshness/feed binding pure。
observation storage 只持有 source/as-of/hash；prepared effect 持有 bounded sealed bytes reference，不把每次 quote 做 WAL。
failuresAndRecovery: empty/invalid feed、non-2xx、size/timeouts、feed mismatch、malformed parsed、stale/future/low-confidence 是 typed data/policy failures。
effect dispatch 后不重新获取“latest” price/update 来补救；Unknown 只由该 effect 的 durable observer 解决。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: Hermes response version、payload bounds、rate limits、confidence/age thresholds、binary on-chain semantics 和 feed freshness SLA 需 adapter policy/native evidence。
migrationCutover: 把 pyth helpers 改为 private codecs + public typed Pull leaves；迁移 quote/open callers 使用 exact observations。
删除 optional raw interface/cast、global fetch authority、parsed[0] assumption 与 zero/default quote fields。

sections.category: Pull、Push 与财务数据投影
sections.title: LeverupProtocols：REST/RPC reader、分页与资金事实
sections.currentBehavior: reader-client.ts 暴露 PublicClient，ERC20 balance/decimals、REST positions 使用 casts；`fetchOpenPositions` 固定 page=0 并过滤 OPEN，raw fee/status/timestamp/addresses 未验证；balance 返回 bare bigint，metadata 与 broker 的 hardcoded six decimals 脱节。
sections.abstractExpression: Reader 只暴露 typed data leaves：`observePositions(AccountScope)`、`observeCash(AccountScope)`、`observeCurrencyMetadata`、chain health。REST envelope/records 通过 runtime schema decode 成 `PositionObservation`/`CashObservation`；paginated result 使用 `ListingResult<...> = Complete|Partial|Unavailable`，保留 cursor/page counters、source/as-of/generation。RPC/REST/Hermes resource R 与 account permission witness 分离。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。
preservedContract: 保留 OPEN/CLOSED、closeInfo、qty/entry/margin/fee fields、balance/decimals native facts。
保留 pageNumber/pageSize/totalPages/totalElements 作为 coverage evidence。
USDC six-decimal only when chain/token metadata verifies it；unknown fee/PnL 不被丢弃。
selectedChanges: raw JSON 在 adapter edge parse；address/decimal/timestamp/status/pair-token-feed relation 不通过 cast。
迭代 all pages until provider boundary，保留 unknown rows；OPEN 是 pure projection，不是 fetch contract。
cash observations 绑定 AccountId/SubAccountId、CurrencyMetadata、token/block/as-of；effect plan 需一致 metadata revision。
隐藏 PublicClient/ABI/global fetch，transport timeout/cancel/limits/reconnect 归 scoped Layer；reader checkpoint 与 effect recovery 分开。
effectAndStateOwnership: REST/RPC read data owner 只持有 observations/checkpoints；不获取 reservation/approval。
close effect 只有在 Complete scoped positions 选中 hash/revision 后才建立 controlled association。
failuresAndRecovery: malformed response、HTTP error、page gap/counter conflict、unknown pair/token/unit、missing block、stale generation typed。
page omission 不产生 NotFound/no-position；普通 read timeout 不变成 RecoveryCase。
已发出 close 的 status/position observation 使用原 effect identity；不能因 reader reconnect 改 scope/network。

sections.title: Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界
sections.currentBehavior: TradingGit 在内存中 staged/pending，以短 hash 形成 commit；push 先逐项执行 remote operation，再 snapshot/persist/clear。UnifiedTradingAccount 以 message tag 写入 subaccount，order-entry 直接串 stage→commit→push，失败多以字符串或 rejected list 表示。
sections.abstractExpression: 把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。
preservedContract: 保留可审阅的 stage/commit/reject、hash/head/parent/message、order history/log/status/export 和 operation ordering；这些是 durable journal/history projection，不是 universal broker object。
保留 read-only review 与 ReturnToAgent 的 unsent review branch；它只产生 durable request/control/outbox，不等同 broker dispatch 或 AI 已送达。

sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
JournalWriter、CAS/WAL、outbox、scheduler lease、dispatch identity、receipt 和 recovery owner 是受控效果的 authority；Git/历史视图是可重建 projection。数据 cache、market stream 和普通查询不共用 order lock，也不使用 prepare/approve/compensate。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-6089771399: effectBoundary=TransactionApplication and scheduler are effects; pure decide/evolve determine legal transitions. Tests use a crashable JournalWriter/Scheduler, not timers or Git callbacks. durability=One writer transaction records events, jobs, locks, and command receipt. A crash after any barrier is recovered by journal replay; no “clear staging” mutation occurs until the durable state transition is committed.
MAP-92B40EBFD5: effectBoundary=Restart/rebuild uses JournalReader/ProjectionStore effects under composition root. No UTA constructor callback or SDK object restoration. durability=Events and projection checkpoints commit atomically; event schema version and aggregate version are checked before replay. Saved Git imports without dispatch identity become audit-only/operator-owned.
MAP-DBBD7BE69C: effectBoundary=JournalWriter is the only persistence effect and returns post-commit receipt; no callback or Git object is needed for pure prepare. durability=Prepared event, steps, locks, command receipt, and projection update commit atomically; no partial preparation.
MAP-7C856D1CDF: effectBoundary=Pure audit renderer needs no IO; writer stores structured scope; scheduler/interpreter consume scope fields. durability=Scope participates in plan digest, dispatch identity, conflict key, approval grant, and projection; rendered tag is non-authoritative.
MAP-E59A917F82: effectBoundary=Scheduler and BrokerInterpreter are Effects; JournalWriter persists barriers and outcomes. Application returns receipt, not immediate remote success. durability=DispatchStarted before mutation; jobs Ready/Leased/Completed/Failed with epoch/deadline; Unknown keeps transaction in Reconciling/RecoveryRequired and locks held.
MAP-152865F791: effectBoundary=Application sends command to JournalWriter; callback/notifications consume committed event through an effect subscription. durability=Writer atomically records receipt/event, invalidates approval/jobs, and releases only unexecuted locks; no compensation job for never-dispatched plan.
MAP-502614A0DB: effectBoundary=ProjectionReader reads journal-backed views; no Git mutation or broker calls. durability=Query results include projection sequence/schema version; audit view can lag and reports checkpoint/freshness.
failuresAndRecovery: Persistence-before-send failure、post-send snapshot failure、lost response、duplicate identity、rejected operation、unknown outcome 和 recovery unavailable 必须分别记录；remote side effect 后本地失败永远不能被重试逻辑当作未发送。 no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 必须预先冻结为 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision`（含 retention/recipient）；timeout 与 response 在同一 control CAS 下竞争，不能自动 fallback 到 execution。 旧 Git row 的 DispatchStarted/marker 缺失不是 NoStart 证据：TradingGit 可能已经先执行 remote side effect，再在 snapshot/commit/persist 失败。NoStartRetirement 只有在 durable record 中存在明确的 positive no-callback provenance/classification 时才允许；legacy completed/ambiguous post-push 若缺 native identity 或 attempt identity，必须成为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，不能按未发送处理、不能 native replay。只有 positive terminal evidence 才能 resolve historical outcome。
MAP-6089771399: EmptyDraft; InvalidState; PolicyAdmissionFailed; OutcomeUnknown{step}.
MAP-92B40EBFD5: ReplayViolation; SnapshotHashMismatch; UnsupportedEventVersion; RecoveryRequired.
MAP-92B40EBFD5: LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous, LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing, and MigrationRequired block dispatch while retaining source provenance.
MAP-DBBD7BE69C: VersionConflict, EmptyDraft, PlanNotRecoverable, UnsupportedAtomicity.
MAP-7C856D1CDF: ScopeMissing, ScopeMismatch, AuditProjectionError.
MAP-E59A917F82: AuthorizationDenied, CapabilityUnavailable, LeaseConflict, DispatchFailure, OutcomeUnknown, RecoveryRequired.
MAP-152865F791: InvalidState, RevisionConflict, AuthorizationDenied, AlreadyTerminal.
MAP-502614A0DB: TransactionNotFound, ProjectionStale, UnsupportedAuditFormat.
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: native idempotency、absence/deduplication、atomic group、retention horizon 和 compensation grade 只由 provider evidence 证明；Mock counter、短 hash、Git commit 或 Effect sequencing 都不是这些保证。

MAP-6089771399 future falsifiers: Two independent orders yield two steps/jobs and per-step results; the transaction reaches a terminal state only after each criterion is evaluated. | Crash after one step is Acknowledged leaves the other step queued/unknown according to the explicit policy; restart does not rerun the acknowledged dispatch. | An empty draft is rejected without creating a prepared event, job, or lock.

MAP-92B40EBFD5 open questions: A pre-implementation inventory must determine historical Git export account mixing, scope mapping, schema versions, and dispatch identities; until verified, affected records remain read-only LegacyEvidence/OperatorRequired and no execution recovery is opened.

MAP-92B40EBFD5 future falsifiers: Restart after a durable DispatchStarted restores the same attempt and schedules ObserveUnknown; no second dispatch. | Corrupt snapshot hash refuses startup rather than serving stale orders. | A mixed-account or identity-less historical file reopens as read-only evidence with a migration receipt; it cannot be interpreted as a pending executable transaction.
MAP-DBBD7BE69C future falsifiers: Prepare success returns receipt after commit; duplicate command returns same receipt; crash before commit leaves no prepared state.
MAP-7C856D1CDF future falsifiers: Audit tag says spot because event scope is spot; changing text cannot cause dispatch to derivatives.
MAP-E59A917F82 future falsifiers: Crash immediately after DispatchStarted yields one Unknown attempt and observe job; readOnly approval creates no job.
MAP-152865F791 future falsifiers: Reject Prepared with no dispatch records PlanRetired and releases reservation; reject after DispatchStarted yields Aborting/RecoveryRequired, not no-effects.
MAP-502614A0DB future falsifiers: Projection query after restart returns same transaction state/checkpoint; stale projection is marked, not silently empty.
migrationCutover: 将 Git commit/push caller、HTTP route、scheduler 与 journal store 一起切到 Draft/Prepare/Approve/Queue/Dispatch/Observe；把 subaccount 从 message parsing 移入 operation/plan scope；为已存在 commit 保留 legacy import marker。对 not-started revision 可在 durable retire 后新 prepare；任一 DispatchStarted 后只走历史 resolver/recovery。 旧 Git row 的 DispatchStarted/marker 缺失不是 NoStart 证据：TradingGit 可能已经先执行 remote side effect，再在 snapshot/commit/persist 失败。NoStartRetirement 只有在 durable record 中存在明确的 positive no-callback provenance/classification 时才允许；legacy completed/ambiguous post-push 若缺 native identity 或 attempt identity，必须成为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，不能按未发送处理、不能 native replay。只有 positive terminal evidence 才能 resolve historical outcome。

sections.effectAndStateOwnership:
Decision/Evolution 是纯逻辑；JournalWriter 才负责 CAS/dedup/outbox/receipt。Native request、SDK object、Scope、functions、secret 不进 plan；ambiguous generated request identity 必须从 sealed representation 或 exact encoded form 恢复。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-D32AED6801: effectBoundary=Protocol/domain codecs are pure. Adapter interpreter creates/consumes native SDK values at the dispatch boundary; projection/application services perform IO and journal reads. durability=Journal stores versioned action/event payloads, dispatch identities, scope, and sequence; Git export stores a safe projection with source sequence/hash, not executable operations or native snapshots.
MAP-89E53C0637: effectBoundary=Pure canonical encoder/digest/chain verifier; journal/export reader performs file/DB IO. No random/time hidden in hash. durability=Persist full digest, encoding/schema version, parent digest, and source journal sequence. Existing 8-char hashes import as LegacyEvidence and are not used as dispatch/idempotency identity.
MAP-298D6BB247: effectBoundary=Domain constructors/evolution are pure. Application obtains broker facts and journal writer persists actions/facts; adapter compiles only resolved actions into native plans. durability=Persist action tag, scope, normalized payload, revision, policy/digest, and provenance. Reconcile facts persist quantity delta, mark observation identity/time, and distinction from real fill. External observations persist broker order identity and listing evidence.
MAP-4B40267FF6: effectBoundary=Adapter maps native state; pure transaction evolution/projection maps statuses. Protocol encodes discriminated variants. durability=Persist lifecycle/dispatch/transaction transitions with source sequence and recovery-case ownership; duplicate observations are idempotent by broker identity and Unknown never becomes Rejected.
MAP-DE16B51F52: effectBoundary=Adapter decoder owns unknown native data; writer records typed outcome after durable send boundary; protocol encodes outcome schemas. durability=Persist outcome type, action/step/dispatch IDs, scope, evidence version, and redaction status. Execution projection updates atomically with event; raw native diagnostic stays in bounded logs.
MAP-FEF9B7F5AE: effectBoundary=Projection store reads/writes snapshots; journal is authority. migrationCutover: 拆成 domain journal schema、public query schema、provider-native codec；将 stage/commit/push caller 迁到 declarative transaction entry and durable scheduler，不保留 global Git-as-broker facade。 旧 Git row 的 DispatchStarted/marker 缺失不是 NoStart 证据：TradingGit 可能已经先执行 remote side effect，再在 snapshot/commit/persist 失败。NoStartRetirement 只有在 durable record 中存在明确的 positive no-callback provenance/classification 时才允许；legacy completed/ambiguous post-push 若缺 native identity 或 attempt identity，必须成为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，不能按未发送处理、不能 native replay。只有 positive terminal evidence 才能 resolve historical outcome。

sections.abstractExpression: CLI/HTTP/UI 只投影 capability tree 的 Draft/Prepare/Approve/Queue/Observe/Recover routes；它们不能直接执行 mutation recipe、拓宽 schema 或以 schema parse 当作 readiness/authorization。one-shot helper 是 typed command submission projection，返回 durable receipt/control handle，而非 broker success boolean。 route projection 只能提交 command/读 control handle，不能直接获得或重放 process-bound `DispatchGrant`；timeout 也不能从 decision control 自动跳到执行。
preservedContract: 保留旧 one-shot 调用的阶段可观察性、read-only review、错误位置和最终 receipt/history projection；将 route-specific status mapping 仅作为离线 parity 对照；单一 authority cutover 后移除旧 phase union。
保留取消 CLI/读取资源只释放 owned resource，不取消已接受或 unknown 的 trading effect。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: Journal authority、迁移与可重建审计
sections.currentBehavior: 旧边界通过 accountId 选择 commit.json；JSON.parse 失败统一转为 undefined。TradingGit 在同一进程对象中同时持有 staging、pending hash、completed commits、onCommit callback 和 broker callback。push 先逐个 operation 调用 broker callback，再执行 snapshot、内存 append 和文件 callback；reject 不会调用远程 broker callback，而是生成 user-rejected results，读取 getGitState 后追加 synthetic commit 并调用 onCommit，因此文件、内存 history 与实际 effect 的时序可能分裂。staging/pending 残留也不能证明 no-start：E01 表明 push 可能已经调用 broker，随后 snapshot/persistence 失败而留下 pending 供 retry。export/restore 只覆盖 completed commits；prepared、approval、lease、job、unknown 与 recovery 都没有可重放记录。
sections.abstractExpression: JournalStore 是 controlled-effect 的本地 authority：只接收 schema-bound WriteCommand，由 single writer 在一个 SQLite transaction 中依据已接受的 progressive state 写入 versioned EventEnvelope、Transaction/Step/EffectJob、DispatchAttempt、remote observation、lock/reservation、CommandReceipt 和 decision-bearing projection。LegacyImportRecord 保留 sourcePath、sourceDigest、entry provenance、decoder/version 和原始 bytes；GitAuditProjection/Git export 只是依据 committed sequence 可重建的 reader。动态定义的 certified document 仍绑定完整 provider instance/capability identity、revision、semantic/schema digest 与具体 schema slot，不能把历史记录交给当前闭包解释。
preservedContract: 保留按提交/交易顺序查询的人类可读 history、精确 Decimal/order terms、parent/leg 关系和已观测的 external order provenance。
保留 primary/legacy 文件的迁移入口作为只读证据，但文件不再构成第二执行入口；未知版本、混合账户、损坏或权限错误都保持具名 MigrationRequired/OperatorRequired，而不是新建空 history。
GitAuditReader 仍提供 log/show/status 类查询的 legacy-shaped read projection；ProjectionLag/ExportFailure 不回滚已提交 receipt、ack 或 remote observation。
重放以事件 sequence、aggregate revision、schema version、checkpoint hash 和 typed codec 校验，不以数组长度、短 hash 或缺省 multiplier 修补非法状态。
selectedChanges: 以 versioned JSON Schema/codec 构造 JournalEvent、PreparedPlan、RemoteObservation、RecoveryCase 和 projection checkpoint；拒绝 unknown tag、错误 payload/slot、sequence/revision 断裂。
把 loadGitState/createGitPersister 拆为启动 migration/replay importer 与 post-commit GitAudit projector；importer 只能写 LegacyEvidence 或 typed migration failure，不能产生 dispatch identity。
将 short CommitHash 映射成 display-only audit alias；TransactionId、revision、journalSequence、dispatchId、commandId 各自独立且使用 domain-specific digest。
在 writer barrier 后再开放受控效果 admission；公共 data pull/stream 与 Alice 非交易功能按自身 store/availability 独立运行。
effectAndStateOwnership: UTA composition root 持有 SQLite JournalStore、migration/replay、single-writer queue 和 transaction authority；runtime Scope/STM/TRef 只可服务未 prepare 的 draft/cache，不代替 journal。
Provider adapter/foreign bridge 持有 native DTO/SDK/credential process；adapter 在边界做 decode 与 evidence mapping，不把 SDK object/function/secret 写入计划或公共 view。
GitAuditReader、order/accounting projection、simulation 和 file export 只读 committed event/observation，通过 checkpoint 幂等重建；projection sink 没有 dispatch 权限。
公共 Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup、账户观察和 stream cursor 拥有各自 data owner；只有被交易决定选中的 evidence 进入 journal，不把每个 frame 事务化。
failuresAndRecovery: StorageFailure/CorruptJournal/ReplayViolation/RelationalInvariantFailure 会阻断受控 authority 或对应 projection，并保留诊断/原始证据；绝不 fallback 为 undefined、空 history 或成功 receipt。

Legacy import 不得将缺少 DispatchStarted 视为 no-start 证据：旧 TradingGit 只有在 executeOperation 之后才产生/持久化 completed push state，且 persistence 位于 broker callback 之后。staging/pending 残留同样不是 no-start 证据：E01 表明 push 可能调用 broker 后再因 snapshot/persistence 失败而留下 pending 供 retry。缺少 native/attempt identity 的 completed 或 ambiguous post-push record，只有在 positive terminal evidence 解析出历史记录时才可解决；仅在明确的 source/evidence classification 证明未进入 broker callback 时，才可产生 NoEffectsApplied/no-start retirement。此类 legacy record 永不 native replay。
Git projection/export 失败只留下 ProjectionLag/ExportFailure；重启 projector 从 lastSequence/checkpoint 补齐，不重新调用 broker。
restore/clone 与 crash restart 分开：旧 home 先进入 RestoreQuarantine/ObservationOnly，确认唯一 authority 与 remote facts 后才允许显式 cutover。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码和 E01 仅证明当前 JSON fallback、callback-after-mutation、snapshot/persistence retry 与 Decimal repair 行为；不证明 SQLite/native ABI、跨进程 fencing、provider idempotency 或历史 commit version 集合。
SQLite driver/version/ABI、已发布 commit.json inventory、混合账户归属、backup/restore/corruption 以及实际 ownership 仍是 implementation/provider evidence gate；设计阶段不将其写成已验证事实。
Legacy source 没有 DispatchStarted marker：TradingGit.ts:119-249 与 E01 证明 callback-before-persistence 和 post-callback retry 行为，但缺少 marker 不能证明没有 callback 发生；仍需 positive no-callback source/evidence。
migrationCutover: 先扫描每个 legacy path/file，保存 digest/path/entry/decoder provenance；只有 positive source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback，才可将记录归类为 NoEffectsApplied/no-start retirement；其他缺少 scope、native identity、version、criterion 或 dispatch boundary 的记录保留 read-only。

冻结相应 account/effect admission，完成 journal migration/replay 与未结 attempt 分类；旧 completed/ambiguous post-push record 若缺 native/attempt identity，必须标记 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，不能因没有新 DispatchStarted marker 退休；随后一次性启用 JournalWriter/reader/scheduler 单一 authority，再移除旧 onCommit/direct callback/fallback。
旧 Git API 只作为离线 parity/import/export tooling 使用；完成 provenance/parity 检查后一次性切换到 JournalStore，禁止在未有已发布 boundary 的前提下引入 dual-read、runtime shim 或双写。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: Schema-bound recipe/compiler 与开放的 provider capability 边界
sections.currentBehavior: UnifiedTradingAccount 用 `switch (op.action)` 将 SDK-shaped Operation 直接转换为 IBroker mutation；TradingGit 再用 unknown callback/result parser 解释 success/orderState/legs。IBroker 将交易、账户查询、quote、clock、optional listing/history 放入 monolithic interface，能力缺失时被迫返回空数组、失败字符串或兼容 stub。TradingGit 同时耦合 IBKR Contract/Order、sentinel、derivative 类型、日志和 simulation。
sections.abstractExpression: 每个 provider capability 都是 construction-bound schema-bound definition：它把 semantic unit、exact input/success/failure/prepared/ack/observation/recovery/criterion schemas、portable semantic Constraint/evaluator artifact 及其 version/digest、descriptor metadata、Effect service requirements 和当前 permission requirements 关联在同一声明中。对于 controlled leaf，完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 以及每个 stage failure schema 都与 recipe 绑定；admission 的 services/permissions 与 installed native services/执行 permission 分离。`withNativeExtension`/`withLimit`/`withProtection` 等小型 HOF 形成精确 schema product/sum 与 total base projection；`withTransaction` 只把需要 mutation 的 leaf 包成 public intent/receipt handle，native recipe/compiler 留在可信解释器中。provider vocabulary 可开放，kernel control ADTs 有限；没有能力 leaf 就不发布命令，临时不可用仍保留 descriptor+availability。
preservedContract: 保留 IBKR/Alpaca/CCXT/Longbridge/LeverUp 的 native fields、order terms、notional/quantity、TIF、parent/OCA、TP/SL、session、native protection 和 provider-specific response，而不是裁成 global Order Cartesian union。

保留 provider 自由选择 SDK/REST/OpenAPI/foreign process；UTA-facing handshake/describe/invoke/stream/cancel 只固定外层 envelope、schema slot、identity、revision/fingerprint、scope、effect/delivery/resource/permission/availability。
保留结构缺失与暂时 unavailable 的差别：无 cancel/option/历史等 capability 时叶子不存在；已装载但断连、限流、未授权时 descriptor 存在并携带具名 availability。
保留公共 data capability 的 Public scope；AccountScope 只进入账户、订单、持仓、交易效果及其 account-scoped observation，不能因为复用连接就给公共 Candle/News/Instrument 造 wallet。
Kernel 的 coverage 只使用 Complete|Partial|Unavailable；值/质量未知是该 payload 的具名 reason，不扩张成新的全局 coverage variant。
selectedChanges: 以 declaration-backed schema 解码 guards/config 与 provider leaves；unknown/malformed/duplicate rule 使 composition 产生 typed failure；不再 warning-and-skip、global registry mutation 或从历史 candidate 文档盲继承 schema enum。

静态定义在构造时同时生成 schema、descriptor、validator、evaluator identity/version/digest 与 typed handler；动态 foreign document 在 discover/bind 时校验完整 capability+provider instance+revision+semantic/schema digest，并按 input/success/failure/prepared/ack/observation 等 slot 分别认证。
把 `unknown` 限定在反序列化入口；调用前后均按同一 certified slot 解码，StaleCapability/OutputSchemaViolation/DeclaredDomainError 等不再经 unknown cast/`{}`/`any` fallback。
把 CLI/help/AI metadata/HTTP projection 从最终 capability tree 计算；不要复制 global BrokerActionTypeMap、固定四动作 handler 或手写 command table。

将 target digest 固定为 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、full digest、domain-separated/versioned projection；分别覆盖 capability schema slots/constraints/interpretation、plan、command 与 order terms，拒绝 duplicate keys/nonfinite/invalid Unicode。

固定 PlanDigest approval cycle：Prepare 后 PRE-approval terms 与 required constraints immutable；实际 `ApprovalBinding(planDigest, actor, policy, expiry)` 是独立 durable control record，使用 separate digest，且 ApprovalBinding digest NEVER 进入 PlanDigest；任何编辑都产生新 intent/revision/plan。
effectAndStateOwnership: 声明/codec/evaluator/descriptor 与 provider capability identity 在 composition root 构造并版本化；Effect service R 由 Effect Layer 提供，不能把其存在当作 permission witness，且 admission R/P 与 installed native R、执行 P 分开。
当前 principal、capability binding、AccountScope、policy/permission witness 在每次 admission 单独解析；resource provisioning 不制造授权、native guarantee 或 schema compatibility。

native compiler/observer/compensator 只在 trusted provider interpreter 内运行；prepared recipe 只保存可编码 payload、compiler identity/version、selected evidence 与 requirements，不保存函数、Scope、SDK object、credential 或 closure。
外层 CLI/AI/HTTP 只获得 opaque controlled handle，可 submit intent/read receipt/observation，绝不取得 raw dispatch function、SQL handle 或 broker object。
failuresAndRecovery: DescriptorLoadFailure、InputRejected、StaleCapability、AuthorizationDenied、AvailabilityChanged、ProcessFailure、ProtocolViolation、OutputSchemaViolation 和 OutcomeUnknown 分开；结构缺失不能伪造成 Unsupported method，断连不能变成 capability absence。
完整 dynamic certification 缺任一 identity/revision/digest/slot 时拒绝绑定；历史已 started/unknown 的计划解析 exact historical compiler/observer/recovery，不能用 live catalog 新定义 reprepare。
provider handler 的 schema/domain errors 保留 leaf-specific identity；不能把 HTTP/network error、native rejection、effect unknown 和 data delivery failure 压成 string/boolean。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 当前 IBroker/registry/AI tool/CLI 只证明 in-process dynamic import、Zod input 与 generic Promise paths；不证明 foreign wire protocol、schema vocabulary compatibility、native idempotency、atomicity、credential isolation 或 native finality。
provider 的 exact TIF/order extension、lookup/absence、foreign process transport、native ABI 和 runtime conformance 仍由 provider/effect-specific evidence 提供；开放的 business vocabulary 不等于默认支持。
migrationCutover: 先为每个现有 provider/fixture 建 declaration-derived leaves，保留现有 UTA adapter 作为 source evidence；新 leaf 的 descriptor/validator/metadata/CLI projection 同步生成后再接入 writer。
将 UnifiedTradingAccount dispatcher switch 和 global IBroker compatibility re-export 收窄为 adapter bridge；移除 public raw Operation/unknown parser 作为新 authority，不在 core 增加 provider-name switch。
对缺失能力移除命令叶子；对参数变体仅收窄该叶子的 input schema。断连/expired credential 只更新 availability，不重写 schema 或偷偷显示为 executable。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: 纯 decision/evolution、渐进 writer state 与原子写集
sections.currentBehavior: 旧 stagingArea/pendingMessage/pendingHash/inflightWrite 是对象内 mutable state；commit 仅把 operations/message/time/parentHash 截成八字符 hash，push 按顺序执行每个 operation 后再获取 account snapshot、追加 commit、调用 onCommit。reject 也依赖 getGitState/onCommit，即便不调用 broker；同一对象的一个 in-flight flag 会阻塞无关写入。Guard 在 broker snapshot 上逐个执行，且可能先改变自身状态再被后续 guard 拒绝。
sections.abstractExpression: 采用纯 `Decision<State, Command, Event, ExternalEffect, Failure>` 与 `Evolution<State, Event>`。Prepare/approval/dispatch 的 kernel 函数只接收已构造的 facts、显式 now 和 durable current state，返回 accepted events 与 external work description，不执行 Promise。Single writer 每次先读取 transaction 的最新 progressive state，校验 authenticated principal、commandId/digest、expected revision、scope、policy、prepared binding 和 reservations，再原子追加 events、更新决定性 projection、创建 job/outbox/receipt；后续 step 必须在同一 writer transaction 的新状态上继续，不能基于旧快照预先计算后批量落盘。受控定义遵守 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：admission 的 R/P 仅负责准入和资源/权限证明，installed native R 由 Layer 提供，execution P 必须由 writer-issued grant 证明。
preservedContract: 旧 add/commit 的 reviewable draft UX 映射为 DraftRecord/CapabilityDraftView；stale reviewed payload 仍拒绝，新的 edit 产生新 revision 并使旧 approval/job 无效。
Approve/Reject 的 CAS 仍要求期待的 revision/digest；Reject/Discard 在未 DispatchStarted 时是本地 NoEffectsApplied，不依赖 broker snapshot，也不伪装已发生 compensation。
每个 step 的 exact input/output/error、before-image、criterion、scope 和 dependency order 被独立保留；ContinueOnKnownRejection 只由显式 IndependentBatch policy 选择，Unknown 不被 catch 行为决定。
AccountScope、InstrumentId、provider order reference、policy version、expiry 和 selected observation 继续作为受控效果事实；公共读/流不会因此获取 order lock/WAL。
Prepare 冻结 PRE-approval terms 与 required constraints 到 PlanDigest；实际 `ApprovalBinding(planDigest, actor, policy, expiry)` 是独立 control witness，拥有 separate digest，且该 digest NEVER 进入 PlanDigest。
selectedChanges: 把 schema-bound recipe 编译为 PreparedPlanRecord：exact encoded terms、compiler/semantic/predicate versions、plan digest、AccountScope、intent revision、before-image、preconditions、criterion、recovery assessment、expiry、conflict keys；不产生 broker call。
Prepare 的 write set 只写 PreparationStarted/Prepared、revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks 和 plan/audit rows；不写 ExecutionReservation、EffectJob 或 DispatchStarted。

Approve/RequestSubmission 的 write set 以当前状态重读并原子写入 approval binding（`planDigest, actor, policy, expiry`）、ExecutionReservation、EffectJob/DispatchPlanned、decision projection、CommandReceipt/outbox；ApprovalBinding digest 与 PlanDigest 分离，提交成功后才返回 receipt。
所有 expected version/command identity/permission witness 在 writer 内验证；相同 principal-scope + commandId 且 canonical payload 相同则返回原 receipt，不同 digest 则返回 IdempotencyConflict。
将 canonical digest 统一为 RFC 8785 JCS over UTF-8 + SHA-256 full hex，并使用 domain/schema version 分离 capability、plan、command、order terms；receipt identity 不与 transport request id 或 execution grant 混用。
effectAndStateOwnership: 纯 compiler/decision/evolution 只产出 events/work descriptions；Clock/Scope/Queue/STM 由 Effect runtime 管理资源与顺序，但不承担 durable authority。
JournalWriter 独占 transaction state、approval、locks/reservations、jobs、receipts 与 controlled-effect projections；scheduler lease 只是 JobRunPermit，不是 effect authority。
guard facts、account/position/quote reads 和 policy/permission resolution 在 writer 外收集，并带 observation/version/evidence；writer 重新检查失效条件，不能让 stale snapshot 直接授权。
data query/stream 自己的 cursor/checkpoint 由其 data owner 持有；被 effect 选取的数据只以 evidence reference 进入 prepared plan。
failuresAndRecovery: Expected domain rejection 不修改此前 accepted state；StorageFailure 回滚整次 write set，不执行 fallback dispatch、不产生成功 receipt。
ReplayViolation/UnexpectedInterpreterDefect/RelationalInvariantFailure 作为 defect 记录并阻断相应 authority；不要用 catch-all `default` 或 string error 隐藏缺失 variant。
Writer re-entry 使用 expected revision 与 command dedup；late worker 只可写匹配 epoch 的状态或独立 observation，不能覆盖新 revision。
progressive state 使同一 batch 的后续 step 看到前一步已接受的状态；跨 provider 的财务原子性仍由 IndependentBatch/AllOrCompensate/ProviderDeclaredAtomic 单独声明，不由 writer 事务声称。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: E01 证明旧 snapshot/onCommit failure 会保留 pending 或造成重复 mutation；但不证明目标 writer 已实现。Guard E02 证明先消费 cooldown 会改变后续评价；不证明任何 database transaction。
single-process SQLite transaction、concurrency/CAS/lease fencing、commit response loss 与 cross-process recovery 都需通过 executable effect slice 实证。
migrationCutover: 先对旧 add/commit/status/reject 产出离线 parity/draft projection，确认旧展示可读但不让旧 hash 成为 authority；完成认证边界后一次性启用新 draft/prepare/approval commands，由其产生 commandId/principal/digest，不保留 runtime command adapter。
禁用旧 TradingGit.push 作为 broker entry；每个旧 batch 明确映射 IndependentBatch policy，并在已知拒绝与 Unknown 处分叉。
迁移期间禁止新旧 writer 双写；完成 per-account migration/replay 与 unresolved attempt classification 后，才删除 in-memory pending/inflight authority。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: Claim、DispatchStarted、观察、部分失败与补偿
sections.currentBehavior: TradingGit.push 逐个 operation 直接调用 callback；异常与 false success 都压成 rejected OperationResult，之后才追加 memory commit 并调用 onCommit。success=true 与 OrderState=Inactive 可同时产生 submitted array/rejected status；cancel NotFound 没有 absence/fill/dispatch identity。没有 durable claim/attempt boundary，因此无法区分 callback timeout、进程退出或 persistence failure 对应的未发送、已拒绝、可能已发送或仍在工作。
sections.abstractExpression: 受控效果的局部状态只覆盖 declared mutation leaf。Job 初始为 Ready(notBefore)，claim 以 owner/epoch/deadline 和全部 ConflictKeys CAS 转为 Leased；只有 fresh successful `Start` writer transition 才能产生 process-bound one-use `DispatchGrant`，private dispatch 恰好消费一次。重复或查询 Start 只返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，永不重新产生 grant；持久 authorization evidence 也不是 grant。provider ack、known rejection、working/fill/cancel/amend/criterion observation 和 OutcomeUnknown 分别解码。OutcomeUnknown/started lease expiry 进入 observation/recovery，不能根据 retry count、空 listing、timeout 或错误字符串判为 rejection。Compensation 是新的声明效果，必须保留 applied evidence、target、risk budget、dependency order 与 owner，绝不自动使用旧函数的 inverse。
preservedContract: 旧 ContinueOnKnownRejection 的顺序和 per-step result 可作为 IndependentBatch policy；已知 rejection 后是否继续由冻结 policy 决定。
ack/submitted、working、filled、cancelled、rejected、criteria met 分开；远端 accepted 不等于 fill/cancel/amend/flat。
bracket parent/TP/SL、provider order identity、symbol/localSymbol lookup hint 和 partial-close before-image 保留；缺 child/listing evidence 时不宣称 absence。
已发送/unknown 的 effect 不允许 draft Discard/Rearm；只有有 positive source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback 的 no-start classification 才可释放 effect reservation，单凭 missing DispatchStarted marker 永不满足。
selectedChanges: Claim write set：读取 progressive state，校验 job kind/plan revision/approval/expiry/availability/conflict owner，原子转为 Leased 并递增 leaseEpoch；旧 worker late result 被 CAS 拒绝。

Dispatch/Start write set：保存 immutable attempt identity、prepared payload reference、owner/epoch/start sequence、direction 和 native lookup requirements；只有匹配当前 approval binding 的 fresh Start transition 才签发 process-bound one-use DispatchGrant，private handler 消费后不可复用；duplicate/query Start 只返回 AlreadyStarted evidence/receipt，NEVER grant。
Result write set：ack/rejection/unknown 进入 typed attempt/projection；ack 后单独创建 observation job，绝不把 native response truthy 当作 criterion settlement。
Recovery/compensation write set：Unknown 建立 RecoveryCase 并保留 conflict ownership；只有 conformance evidence/授权 risk policy 满足时才创建 compensation attempt，且 forward/compensation outcome 都先观测。
effectAndStateOwnership: JournalWriter 持有 attempt/job/recovery state、conflict owner 和 effect receipts；scheduler 只持有 ephemeral lease/fiber。
Provider adapter 持有 native request/ack/lookup/observation implementation；其 declared identity/retention/absence/fencing evidence 进入 plan metadata。
Accounting/position observations 是独立 remote facts；它们可满足已声明 criterion，但不能改写 prepared terms/digest 或直接创建 inverse trade。
普通 data streams、polling cursor 和 telemetry 不进入 compensation/WAL；它们的 cancellation/terminal state 不表示交易未知。
failuresAndRecovery: Pre-Start failure = typed admission/known rejection/no-effects；Start 重复或查询 = AlreadyStarted evidence/no grant；post-Start 的 process EOF、timeout、malformed response 或不确定的 send = OutcomeUnknown + ObserveBeforeRetry/RecoveryRequired。
Provider complete absence/duplicate/native idempotency/atomicity 只有 NativeConformanceRecord 证实才可改变 retry/recovery policy；MockBroker 的 mock-ord ids 不能升级为 native guarantee。
旧 worker 的 late ack/observation 可按 native identity/revision 独立幂等入库，但不能以旧 epoch 覆盖新 state；compensation 未确认前不释放 exposure lock。
Known rejection 的 batch continue/stop 与 AllOrCompensate、ProviderDeclaredAtomic 明确分开；不为数据分页、NewsGroup 或 Promise.all 复用财务政策。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: E01 仅证明旧 callback 后 snapshot/persistence failure 会导致重复 callback；provider investigation 未证明任一 venue 的 idempotency horizon、absence completeness、native atomicity、restoration 或 post-timeout send semantics。
MockBroker 的 in-memory fills/mark control 和 test-owned DurableMockVenue 只能证明 fixture seam；不能作为真实 venue persistence、freshness 或 native execution identity。
migrationCutover: 将旧 `push` 入口转为 Submit/Approve/Queue adapter；先持久化 permission+DispatchStarted，再调用 selected leaf。无 cancel leaf 时不生成 cancel/recovery command。
对每个已有 in-flight/committed legacy record 建立 native lookup/recovery classification；无法确定 boundary 的记录进入 Unknown/RecoveryRequired，不能靠重试或空列表收口。
补偿策略按 provider capability/effect variant 单独迁移；没有 evidence 的旧“undo”逻辑不得作为默认 fallback。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: 纯风险规则与原子 guard 准入
sections.currentBehavior: Cooldown 以 raw number 60_000、Date.now 和 mutable symbol Map 在 check 中写入状态；后续 guard 拒绝后 cooldown 仍被消费。MaxPositionSize 使用 Number()、raw symbol、existing marketPrice 和 Decimal，但新标的无法估值、zero equity、missing multiplier/FX 会计算为 0/放行。Whitelist 使用 getOperationSymbol；modify/cancel 的 unknown symbol 可绕过检查。registry 以 process-global Map 接受 arbitrary Record options，unknown type 采用 warning-and-skip，guard pipeline 每次从 broker 读取 mutable DTO，并以 string/null short-circuit。
sections.abstractExpression: RuleDeclaration 是 construction-bound schema/semantic constraint：拥有 versioned config、GuardEvaluationInput/required-fact、PassFact、RuleDecision/typed Issue、applicability 与 evaluator artifact/digest。`withGuard(providerEffect, rule)` 只给 exact controlled leaf 增加 issue/resource/precondition，不改变其 input/output/error 或发明缺失 provider field。Cooldown 纯读取 committed accepted-activity facts 与 explicit now；MaxExposure 需要 scoped valuation Complete；Whitelist 需要 canonical InstrumentId/AccountScope。只有 writer 接受 effect intent 时原子消费 reservation；Public data read/stream 永不调用 guard。
preservedContract: 缺少 cooldown option 仍表示 60_000ms；zero 是显式 no-cooldown；负数、非 finite、错误单位和 schema drift 拒绝而非静默默认。
25% default、Decimal 精度、per-symbol rapid-repeat、AAPL/TSLA membership、配置顺序 first issue 作为旧可见语义保留，但改成 typed policy/evidence。
MaxExposure 对 cashQty/units/notional、currency、multiplier、FX、equity 和 unsettled reservation 使用明确单位；未知/歧义/非正净值不是 0% 放行。
Whitelist target-bearing effect 解析失败/ambiguous identity fail closed；Cancel/Modify/Close 的风险豁免只能由 effect risk policy 声明，不由 unknown symbol 绕过。
selectedChanges: 以 declaration-backed schema 解码 guards config；unknown/malformed/duplicate rule 使整个 controlled policy composition 产生 typed failure；不再 warning-and-skip 或 global registry mutation。
Rule evaluator 只接收 immutable semantic input、before-image、scoped observations、policy version、capability availability 和 explicit now，返回 NotApplicable/Pass/Issue 的 finite ADT。
Prepare 可写 revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks/guard candidate；Approve/queue 才在同一 writer transaction 中消费 cooldown/exposure reservation 与 job、approval-bound receipt。
把 native sentinel/Contract/Order DTO 解码放在 provider adapter；guard 只看 refined Order/Instrument/Valuation facts，不依赖 `getOperationSymbol` 或 raw SDK casts。
effectAndStateOwnership: Rule evaluator/Constraint 是纯函数；Clock、journal activity read、valuation query 和 identity resolution 是边界服务，结果带 version/asOf/evidence。
JournalWriter 承担 reservation/approval/transaction CAS；guard 本身不得持有 mutable Date.now map、broker handle 或 transaction lock。
provider leaf 保持自身 exact native extension/error；guard HOF 只添加该 rule 的 schema/issue/requirement。
Public Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup pull/push 使用自己的 resource/permission/availability，不取得 AccountScope/economic lock。
failuresAndRecovery: InvalidDuration/UnknownRuleType/SchemaViolation/InstrumentResolutionRequired/ValuationUnavailable/PolicyConfigurationInvalid 在 controlled admission 前拒绝，不能变成 allow/null。
Rule issue 不等于 provider rejection；writer 返回 typed eligibility failure，原 draft/revision 仍可按 policy reprepare。
宣称 cooldown/valuation reservation 后若 storage commit 失败，reservation 与 job 一并回滚；未被接受的评估不会改变后续评价。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 源码和 E02 仅证明当前 Date.now mutation、raw defaults、unknown-symbol bypass、unpriced/zero-equity allow；不证明目标 declaration compiler 或 durable reservation。
native pricing/FX/multiplier/lot/fee、account completeness、risk semantics 和 provider order guarantees 仍需 adapter/accounting evidence；缺证据时保留 unavailable/unknown。
migrationCutover: 将 guards barrel/registry/legacy classes 标为实现迁移对象，保留三条内建规则的用户语义，通过 composition root 声明构造；未来 extension 走 versioned RuleDeclaration/Layers，不 reopening untyped registry。
迁移 UTA construction-time options 到 versioned config codecs 与 capability-specific HOF；同一 policy snapshot/fingerprint 绑定 PreparedPlan，reload 后旧 plan 必须 reprepare。
guard pipeline 的直接 broker dispatcher 仅作 source evidence；新 admission 先做 identity/required capability/evidence，再按声明顺序纯评估，最后由 writer 决定是否 queue。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: 持久订单观察、外部订单与 scheduler 生命周期
sections.currentBehavior: order-sync-poller 以 process-local running/tickCount/timer 运行 fast pending lane 与 slow external listing lane；main 丢弃 stop handle。只有健康且非 keyless 的 UTA 才同步；listing 中仍存在的 order 不调用 getOrder，消失的才确认；no-listing broker 使用 fresh/1m/5m in-memory backoff。external open orders 被压缩成 `[observed]` Git commit，再进入 pending scanner。单账户错误只写日志后继续，in-flight stop 不可 await。MockBroker 是 in-memory simulator，IBKR reqOpenOrders 只覆盖当前 clientId。
sections.abstractExpression: Polling 是 provider-declared account observation capability 的 scheduler projection，不是 broker SDK 或 controlled dispatch authority。已知订单状态、external listing、lookup、account snapshot 各有精确 input/output/error/completeness/freshness/identity schema；`ObserveOrderJob`/`ExternalListingJob` 持久化 scope、OrderRef、source revision、notBefore、dedup key、lease owner/epoch/deadline 和 checkpoint。scheduler 使用有限 ADT `Accepted|CoalescedExisting|Deferred|Rejected`，同 scope/schedule 只合并未 claim 的 wake；pure `classifyRecovery`/observation fold 不读取旧 running flag。交易效果 job 与普通 data pull/push 仍完全分离。
preservedContract: fast lane 只追踪已知 pending parent/legs；slow lane 发现 Alice 外部订单并保留 External provenance；listing present 不浪费 per-order lookup，missing 才按 provider evidence 进一步确认。
保留 10s/15m 产品意图、off、fixed-delay/no-jitter、fresh/1m/5m backoff 的成本安全目标，但改为有限/可版本化 schedule policy，不再用 tick modulo 作为 authority；listing coverage 只用 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，值/质量 Unknown 单独保留。
保留 10s/15m 产品意图、off、fixed-delay/no-jitter、fresh/1m/5m backoff 的成本安全目标，但改为有限/可版本化 schedule policy，不再用 tick modulo 作为 authority。
每账户 failure 隔离；一个 provider typed failure 不污染其他 AccountScope 的 observation/projection，也不把 catch continuation 当作 transaction completion。
selectedChanges: 把 pending scan 的 Git-derived order ids 迁为 durable OrderProjection/OrderRef；parent/TP/SL、localSymbol、client/perm identity 和 scope 随事件持久化。
listing leaf 只有在 provider 声明 namespace/pagination/absence/freshness 时发布；Complete(empty)、Partial、Unavailable、Unauthorized、TransportFailure 分立，空数组不制造 NoNewOrders。

durable scheduler root 持有 job handles；claim 后再调用 provider observation。`stop` 顺序为 AdmissionClosing→WorkersDraining→JobsPersisted/Interrupted→WriterDrained→CapabilityLayersClosed→SchedulerClosed，并等待在途 worker。
InProcessRetainedLedger 只作为 worker restart fixture；UTA process-kill/reopen 使用 test-owned DurableMockVenue independent ledger，二者都不宣称 live venue native guarantees。
effectAndStateOwnership: ObservationJob/checkpoint/remote observation 属于 data/account-observation owner；如果 observation 关联已 started controlled effect，只引用其 dispatch/recovery identity，不创建第二 transaction authority。
DurableScheduler 管理 notBefore、single-flight/coalescing、lease/epoch 和 resource budget；EffectJob dispatch 另由 LTX-DISPATCH 受控 wrapper 管理。
provider adapter 持有 listing/lookup/native order status，返回 schema-validated evidence；Mock control panel 只能注入 simulator actor facts。

公共 Candle/News/Instrument stream 的 cursor/asOf/coverage/backpressure/replay/finality 和 cancellation 使用 DataDeliveryPolicy；ordinary live data 可直接读取而不 journaling 全部事实，只有被 effect 捕获的 evidence/control checkpoint 进入 transaction。
failuresAndRecovery: Observation provider unavailable/partial/stale 使 job Deferred/OperatorRequired 或保留 cursor gap；不得把 unsupported、empty、null 或 strict throw 变成 complete absence。
known order 的 DispatchStarted 后进程 crash 进入 ObserveUnknown/RecoveryRequired；poller retry 不能直接重新 place。普通观察 stream close/cancel 只释放 data resource。
lease expiry 递增 epoch，旧 worker late write 被拒绝；poller shutdown failure 保留 durable evidence，不用 process.exit 当作工作完成。
provider status null、listing gap、manual TWS order、mock order id 或 missing execution identity 只产生 StillWorking/Unknown/OperatorRequired，直到 scoped evidence 足够。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: poller specs、MockBroker mark/fill 和 E01 仅证明进程内行为；不证明 durable scheduler、SQLite recovery、listing completeness、native freshness、execution identity 或 idempotency。
IBKR reqOpenOrders clientId limit、adapter rate budget、coalescing horizon、heartbeat SLA、retention/pagination/absence 以及 native provider guarantees 仍需实证；任何 provider fallback 都不能升级这些保证。
migrationCutover: 先建立 durable observation projection/job store，迁移 pending/external identities 与 source snapshots；旧 poller 只作为 behavior evidence，不与新 scheduler 双跑。
main 保存 root scheduler handle，并在 shutdown 前关闭 admission、drain workers；只有 recovery scanner 生效后，才移除 direct setInterval/tickCount/running authority。
把 observation result route/CLI/AI projection 接到 capability tree；effect-linked unknown 交给 recovery owner，普通 data failure 交给 data owner。

sections.category: 受控效果、持久决定与恢复
sections.title: Optional order effect、sizing、protection、mutation 与 recovery
currentBehavior: MAP-42D6C92810：Cancellation can call the native endpoint with no symbol when orderSymbolCache misses, then reports success as terminal Cancelled without observing the order. The cache is process-local and the legacy result has only a string error/synthetic state.

MAP-FF6EBB6D62：For a market order with no totalQuantity, placeOrder fetches a ticker, divides cashQty by ticker.last, and forwards a JS number; the test does not cover the implementation’s alternate use of lmtPrice. An order with neither field returns a legacy error before createOrder.

MAP-C05B75E8A4：placeOrder returns a successful legacy result with no execution object, but its `orderState` is derived from the mocked native status and can therefore be Filled when status is closed. The test does not prove that a fill projection waits for later sync.

MAP-DA97124E26：The Bybit override performs the four symbol-scoped endpoint attempts and throws only after all fail; CcxtBroker catches that and returns null. convertCcxtOrder maps any returned TP/SL prices into an optional legacy object, so one price yields a partial attachment with no scope/namespace evidence.

MAP-C28BF69053：The default policy tries the regular namespace before the stop namespace and throws a generic not-found error only when both calls fail. The broker catches every exception, so transport, permission, malformed response, and complete absence all become null.

MAP-030151E268：placeOrder resolves the CCXT symbol, forwards MKT as market with no price and LMT as limit with `lmtPrice`, converts amount/price to JS numbers at the call, and returns a string error for unresolved identity. It performs no durable prepare/dispatch transition.

MAP-7EAA877DA1：Modification depends on process-local cache and performs an unjournaled original-order fetch immediately before edit. Missing fields inherit SDK values, and a successful edit response is returned as success with mapped status but no version or observation record.

MAP-9A09519EAE：The patch representation conflates property absence, IBKR UNSET_DECIMAL, and explicit values; source forwards stop/trailing/TIF params into an untyped object. A zero Decimal is forwarded, while undefined/UNSET values are omitted; no expiry/session/relation or trailing capability is validated.

MAP-269CE6D072：The method performs an unjournaled read-then-create race. A caller can request more than the observed absolute quantity; derivative close adds `{reduceOnly:true}`, spot close omits it, and a missing match returns a string error.

MAP-C61E0A3515：getPositions multiplies `abs(contracts)` by `contractSize` with Decimal, but mark/entry/PnL are read from native JS numbers and default missing values to zero. closePosition adds a boolean `reduceOnly` param for CRYPTO_PERP/FUT and sends both amount and price through number conversion.

MAP-3ABAAAB00D：Arbitrary orderType strings fall through to lowercase, while placeOrder handles STP/STP LMT specially (requiring auxPrice), maps side via lowercase cast, and rejects TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT with an error string. No TIF/session/relation/attachment ADT is checked here.
MAP-DD87586D0B：placeOrder resolves symbol, sizes from totalQuantity or cashQty/reference price, rejects absent sizing, and refuses attached TP/SL unless a venue override exists.

MAP-D8B89D3086：The method builds untyped TP/SL/trigger params, maps MKT/LMT/STP/STP LMT, refuses TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT, calls override/direct createOrder, caches id-to-symbol, and returns legacy result/error text.
MAP-B3682B35F1：cancelOrder resolves symbol from an in-memory cache, invokes override/default cancellation, and returns synthetic Cancelled state or error text.
MAP-5444AEA948：modifyOrder requires cached symbol, fetches original, combines amount/price/type/side and stop/trailing/TIF params, then calls editOrder directly.

MAP-8BB5475313：Close is an unjournaled read followed by a nested placeOrder. It defaults to the observed position quantity, accepts an arbitrary requested Decimal, matches by a potentially ambiguous fallback, omits reduceOnly for spot, and hard-codes reduceOnly for derivatives before native number conversion.

MAP-03894C09ED：The converter maps known market rows to legacy Contract/OpenOrder, seeds the cache for truthy native ids, stringifies optional average/TP/SL, and creates OrderState. Unknown market and malformed/missing fields are collapsed to null/default values; unknown status becomes Submitted via makeOrderState.
abstractExpression: 订单 mutation 是 optional controlled-effect leaf，不是统一的 BrokerActionTypeMap。它以 Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> 保留 recipe、receipt/control-result 与各 stage failure 的关联；place、modify、cancel、close、protection、sizing 与 venue lookup 保留各自 native sequencing、refusal、raw extraParams 和 namespace evidence。Decision/Evolution 纯函数先产生不可变 PreparedPlan；单 writer 的 fresh Start 才产生一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant，private dispatch 消费一次；ack、observation、Unknown 与 RecoveryRequired 不被 synthetic status 覆盖。

MAP-42D6C92810：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep known-symbol forwarding and visible native errors.；Keep a compatibility Cancelled view only after a confirmed observation, not directly from Ack.；Remove cache-miss undefined-symbol success as an authority path.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The cache-miss and synthetic-cancel defect is reframed as a controlled effect leaf under the host contract; durable identity and outcome evidence are required only for this mutation, not for unrelated CCXT reads.

MAP-FF6EBB6D62：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep 500/50,000 => 0.01 sizing and missing-sizing refusal.；Keep lmtPrice as a possible reference only if the target contract explicitly allows a limit-priced notional path; do not infer that the source spec tested it.；Keep Decimal arithmetic and reject invalid/non-positive price rather than fabricate zero.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The tested market notional arithmetic remains a sizing rule for this effect leaf, but the host contract require each provider to declare legal sizing combinations; the source test does not justify a global non-market prohibition.

MAP-C05B75E8A4：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep no execution payload in the immediate legacy place result.；Keep later synchronization as the source of fill completion.；Change `closed` in an Ack from terminal authority to evidence requiring observation.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The distinction between create acknowledgement and later fill observation is retained and made the output contract of this effect leaf; the host contract prevents an SDK status from being a global order-state authority.

MAP-DA97124E26：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep Bybit regular/conditional open and closed fallback order.；Keep TP-only, SL-only, both, and no-attachment distinctions.；Keep nullable result only in a legacy display adapter; do not turn endpoint failure into absence.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Bybit’s four lookup paths and partial TP/SL evidence remain provider-native behavior, while the host contract require a typed namespace leaf and keep client-id idempotency unavailable until independently proven.

MAP-C28BF69053：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep regular-before-stop ordering and symbol forwarding.；Keep null only as an explicit legacy mapping of typed NotFound.；Do not treat a transport failure as a missing order.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The regular-then-conditional fallback remains a default provider leaf where declared, but the host contract require per-attempt outcomes and do not promote this helper into a universal order API.

MAP-030151E268：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep exact MKT/LMT type/side/symbol/amount/price mapping for valid requests.；Keep unresolved contract refusal before createOrder.；Keep override extension only behind typed native gateway.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The exact valid MKT/LMT forwarding behavior remains a provider order leaf, while the host contract move identity, unit validation, capability admission, and acknowledgement handling into composed boundaries rather than IBroker-wide behavior.

MAP-7EAA877DA1：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep omitted-field inheritance from the original order.；Keep cache-miss refusal intent, strengthened to durable identity failure.；Keep returned native id opaque; do not parse it.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Omitted-field inheritance remains a useful modify semantic, but the host contract binds it to a durable scoped snapshot/version leaf and does not require every provider to implement modification.

MAP-9A09519EAE：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep original-value fallback for omitted fields and explicit zero as a value subject to domain validation.；Keep lower-case CCXT TIF encoding only in the native codec.；Do not preserve legacy forwarding of unverified trailing/protection as accepted execution.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The source’s stop/trailing/TIF parameter evidence is retained as exact native extensions; the host contract make each extension schema- and capability-declared, so absence is structural and no Cartesian order model is imposed.
