通过 `ReviewRequest`/Alice bridge 将 ReturnToAgent、Keep、Discard、Rearm、Revise、RequestSubmission 编码为 allowed command ADT；未发送 Discard 可退休本地计划，sent/unknown 只能 recovery。
HTTP start/dispatch 只接受 fresh control CAS 后签发 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，禁止从 persisted approval 复用 grant。
为 no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 固定 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision` policy；timeout 与 AI response 以同一 control revision/CAS 竞争，禁止 timeout 后 auto-exec。

effectAndStateOwnership.HTTP: 仅 transport/interpreter；保存 request correlation 和 redacted diagnostics。
effectAndStateOwnership.AliceBridge: 认证后 durable-admit stable ReviewRequest key，再向 WorkspaceConversationControl 投递；不代替 UTA writer。
effectAndStateOwnership.TradingGit: 迁移期可作为现有 persistence implementation；长期不直接暴露为 HTTP authority。

failuresAndRecovery: 401 未认证、verifier unavailable、403 scope/policy denied、409 revision/command conflict、422 schema/domain rejection、503 unavailable、504 deadline/unknown 的分类必须由 typed ADT 驱动。
commit/push storage failure 不返回 200；DispatchStarted 后 HTTP disconnect/timeout 不能自动重发；需要 observation/recovery route。
read-only review 中 Keep 生成 durable suspended control handle；Discard 只退休未发计划；Rearm/Revise 生成新 epoch/revision 并重新检查。
Stage errors、admission failures、dispatch receipts/control results 分别解码但保持同一 Controlled association；lost grant/response 走 observation/recovery，不把 durable authorization 当作 replay token。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: HTTP wallet/order tests 已实测 status/body/phase/precision/pending hash obligations；不证明 auth, generated projection, CAS persistence or foreign protocol implementation。
当前 source 未提供 UTA↔Alice service credential issuer/verifier；该缺口只能作为 deployment/runtime gate，不把 route-local crypto 或 body identity写进设计。
migrationCutover: 把 wallet/stage/one-shot route 输入提升为 construction-bound controlled schemas，先实现 Draft/Prepare/Review，再连接 writer Dispatch/Observe。
引入 auth middleware 与 correlation/error codec；将 status mappings 从字符串 substring 改为 typed envelope，保留原有 externally observed HTTP statuses。
最后删除 direct TradingGit mutation、legacy raw handlers 与独立 one-shot map；由 final descriptor tree 生成 help/route/invoke。

sections.category: 外层协议、AI 与决策交接
sections.title: HTTP simulator/admin tree：隔离的 MockBroker 控制能力
currentBehavior: routes-simulator 通过 instanceof MockBroker 解析 `/utas` 与 `/uta/:id/state`，直接调用 setMarkPrice/tickPrice/fillOrder/cancelPendingOrder/externalDeposit/externalWithdraw/externalTrade；price/fill body schema 接受 simulator wire `{price?, qty?}`，Zod 的 numericString 接受 string/number 并统一转为 String，随后将 fill body 传给 fillOrder。
simulator tests 验证 real MockBroker 与非 Mock object 的筛选、mark/tick/fill/cancel、wallet deposit/withdraw/trade、partial/full fills 与 exact average-cost/cash changes；route 本身没有独立 auth/admin scope。
UTA lifecycle Mock E2E 覆盖 immediate/deferred、pending external fill、partial/full close、cancel、history、TPSL 与 Decimal precision。
abstractExpression: 模拟控制是独立的 `Admin/Simulator` capability tree，前提为 authenticated simulator principal + explicit mock provider instance + AccountScope + simulator policy；它不是生产 provider catalog 的隐式 universal leaf。

控制输入采用 exact ADT：`SetMarkPrice{nativeKey, price}`、`TickPrice{nativeKey, deltaPercent}`、`Fill{orderId, price?: Decimal, qty?: Quantity}`、`CancelPending{orderId}`、`ExternalDeposit`、`ExternalWithdraw`、`ExternalTrade`；simulator published wire schema 保留 `qty` 这一字段名，省略 `qty` 表示填充剩余 totalQuantity。若 host canonical record 使用 `quantity`，只在 schema-bound boundary 做 pure `qty→quantity` parse，再在旧 native boundary re-encode `{qty}`；不得把 `quantity` 误传给只读取 `opts.qty` 的旧方法。输出带 generation/sequence/state projection/receipt。
Mock immediate/deferred execution 仍使用受控 effect protocol：DispatchStarted/ack/observation 与 unknown recovery 不因内存实现而消失；external stimulus 单独标记 actor/provenance，不是 UTA dispatch。
preservedContract: 保留 MockBroker 的 matching threshold、mark/tick price、manual `fillOrder`/cancel、wallet-source cash/position、external trade、partial fill、average cost、history；fill simulator wire 保留 `{price?, qty?}`，省略 `qty` 仍按 pending order 的剩余 totalQuantity 全量填充，提供的 qty 必须为正且不超过 totalQuantity，price/qty 保留 Decimal 转换与默认价格语义。HTTP simulator 没有 TPSL command，Mock `placeOrder` 的 optional tpsl 仅按 provider implementation 记录/忽略。
保留 immediate 与 deferred mode 的不同观察时序、pending order 与 sync/reconcile；保留 Decimal exactness 与 full close 恢复 cash 的可观察结果。
模拟 controls 只在明确 mock/admin scope 下可用，不让其成为 live effect 或 HTTP general route。
selectedChanges: 将 `/simulator` endpoints 从 production trading route 分离为 authenticated admin capability tree；catalog 只在 MockBroker instance 宣布时暴露，拒绝 arbitrary provider cast/instanceof 作为 wire contract。
为每个 stimulus 提供 schema、scope、generation/sequence、actor/provenance 与 typed failure；state snapshot 是 query projection，不是 command success 的替代。
把 immediate/deferred mode 与 pending observation 声明在 provider descriptor，模拟可复现但不得证明 live idempotency/finality/atomicity。

所有 simulator errors 通过 same boundary ADT；未知 order/quantity/price/currency、invalid 或超量 qty 与 stale generation 不静默成功。published schema 的 `qty` 解析为 exact `Quantity`；若内部 canonical 字段写作 `quantity`，adapter 必须是 pure schema-bound `qty→quantity`，调用旧 `MockBroker.fillOrder` 时再明确编码为 `{qty}`，绝不把 `quantity` 当作旧 native input。

Simulator admin tree 只声明 `Fill`→`MockBroker.fillOrder`、`CancelPending` 等实际 controls；不增加 TPSL execution command。Mock `placeOrder` 的 tpsl forwarding 只能作为 verification evidence，不能被 HTTP simulator capability 宣称。

effectAndStateOwnership.SimulatorAdmin: 认证和调用显式 simulator controls，读取 projection；不持有 live credentials。
effectAndStateOwnership.MockBroker: 拥有 simulated matching/wallet/position state、generation/sequence 与 native-like observations。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTA: 仍拥有 account scope、controlled journal 与 deferred activation；external stimulus 进入 observed fact channel。

failuresAndRecovery: unknown mock instance、not-a-MockBroker、stale generation、invalid Decimal/price/quantity、missing pending order 都是 typed failure。
内存 Mock process crash 后只可依据持久化 test fixture/recovery contract 判断；不能把 restart 后空 state 当作 live cancellation或clean baseline。
simulator stream cancellation释放模拟资源，不取消持久化 UTA wait 或 live unknown attempt。

`fillOrder` 的 pending/order/qty/price 错误按 simulator typed failure 返回；省略 qty 的 full fill 与提供 qty 的 partial fill 都保留 actual validation（qty > 0 且不超过 totalQuantity）；TPSL 不在 simulator HTTP control surface，不能由其返回执行成功。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: simulator.spec 与 uta-lifecycle E2E 已观察上述 mutation、precision、partial/fill/history/TPSL behavior；不证明当前 ad hoc HTTP route 的 auth/isolation 或 live guarantees。
Mock/IBKR sentinel evidence 仅覆盖已测 fixtures；完整 NativeSentinelProfile 与 provider/account versions 仍需 evidence。
migrationCutover: 建立 simulator/admin descriptor namespace 与 explicit mock account scope，迁移现有 routes/tests 的 controls 和 response schemas。
为 state projection 增加 generation/sequence/provenance/coverage，并将 direct MockBroker mutation 隐藏在 installed interpreter。
删除生产 route 对 instanceof/raw JSON/ad hoc error 的依赖；保留 lifecycle fixtures 作为 verification-support，不将测试路径升级为 live capability。

sections.category: 外层协议、AI 与决策交接
sections.title: 补充数据 consumer：bars、reference、news 与 CLI/quant 入口
currentBehavior: bars consumer 以 barId/source/interval 组合 identity，聚合 vendor/UTA reads、记录 freshness/quality/delayed warning；OhlcvBar 仍有开放 index signature，provider richness/finality/coverage 不完整。
reference service 提供 board-shaped low-frequency facts（provider/asOf/cache/origin/stale），与交易账户事实不同；quant tool `searchBars`/`calculateQuant` 明确 barId/source/capability 并传播 delayed warning。
News RSS collector/store/archive 以 feed identity、GUID/link/hash 去重，定时 poll 并容忍单 feed errors；web route 仅有限 lookback/filter。native IBKR historical/news primitives 存在，但当前 news consumer 未使用。
abstractExpression: 将 bars/reference/news/NewsGroup 各自注册为 Public 或声明-specific data capabilities；公共 consumer 不借用 UTA account identity。
`Candle` exact base + provider extension 保留 WAP/barCount/update/provisional/closed/unknown/revision/correction；`News` 与 `NewsGroup` 保留 observed/published/source/coverage/membership/retraction。
quant/CLI/web route 都从 data descriptor tree 生成 query schema/help；finite pull 返回 coverage/asOf/freshness/cursor，push 返回 nonterminal control frames 与 terminal ADT。
preservedContract: 保留 barId/source/interval/timezone/session/adjustment、quality/freshness/delayed warning、reference stale/cache origin、RSS dedup/archive/lookback/filter 与 provider-native historical fields。
保留单 feed failure、partial historical support、missing/unknown finality，不以 feed drop 或 no native endpoint 推导 complete absence。
保留 quant 对 source/bar capability 的显式选择；数据输入不能调用 transaction recipe 或获得 trading authority。
普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 直接读取；journal 只持久化 explicit capture、受控 effect evidence 与 deferred predicate checkpoint，不把全部行情 frame 写入 control WAL。
selectedChanges: 去掉 OhlcvBar 开放 index bag，使用 exact extension schema 和 Decimal strings；provider richness 不可由 generic normalization 丢弃。
为 data leaves 增加 completeness/finality/correction/replay/coverage schema，并区分 public/account scope、finite pull/stream lifecycle。
将 RSS/native news/reference/quant/web routes 接入同一 generated declaration projection，但不合并成 `NewsGroup` command namespace。
对 IBKR/Longbridge/LeverUp historical absence、native news unused 等事实保持 provider evidence boundary；未观察 complete pagination/coverage 时返回 Partial/Unavailable。
Coverage 的全局变体严格只有 `Complete | Partial | Unavailable`；未知值/质量/单字段存在性是 payload/reason（例如 UnknownNativeSentinel 或 quality reason），不得增设新的 global coverage variant。
保留已验证的 same-currency FX `Identity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display value；只删除 unknown=1 fabrication，不把所有 1:1、默认值或合法零值一概删除。

effectAndStateOwnership.PublicDataProviders: 拥有 source identity、native rich fields、coverage/finality/replay evidence。
effectAndStateOwnership.Bars/Reference/NewsStores: 拥有各自 cache/archive/projection、dedup、cursor/freshness；不写 trading control journal。
effectAndStateOwnership.Quant/CLI/Web: 只消费 generated data leaves，传播 exact coverage/failure/warnings。

failuresAndRecovery: per-source query failure 与 coverage 在 aggregate 中保留；feed error/drop、stale reference、historical unavailable 不静默 complete。
push correction/retraction/gap/item-error 是 nonterminal；stream owner restart/loss 只在 provider replay/continuity evidence 下恢复。
News persistence conflict/corrupt record 与 HTTP schema failure 进入 typed data/projection failure，不污染 order effect state。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 本节仅扩展原始 map 之外的 source-backed consumer entry points；它不增加 MAP ID，也不重写既有调查 JSON。
source 证明当前 bars/reference/news/quant/web/native historical paths 与缺口；provider completeness, finality, correction/retraction/replay remain empirical。
migrationCutover: 为每类 data unit 注册 construction-bound schema/descriptor/coverage policy，迁移 bars/reference/news/quant/web adapters。
保留现有 archive/cache/dedup stores，但增加 source/asOf/revision/coverage/finality fields 与 bounded failure projections。
删除 open JSON fallback 与 empty-as-complete behavior；未声明 native capability 从 tree 缺席，provider-specific unknown 显式保留。

sections.category: 外层协议、AI 与决策交接
sections.title: 补充 provider/CLI/MCP consumer：开放 provider vocabulary 与生成解释器
currentBehavior: CLI_EXPORTS 是手写 command map，schema 多只约束 input；z.toJSONSchema 对不可表示内容 fallback `{}`；invoke 通过 unchecked internals 与 raw command name 转发。
cli-commands 同时维护 UTA account/contract/order/position/git/market/sim 和 Alice RSS/search-bars 等 map；MCP exporter 只生成通用 text/content，不能表达完整 capability contract。
provider registry 是 same-process module loader，IBroker 是闭合 mandatory method interface，native provider richness、stubs 与 generic Unsupported pressure 被投影到统一 surface；schemas barrel 当前为空。
abstractExpression: CLI/MCP/AI 都是 `Projection(final Definition, AdmissionCatalog) -> Help | Describe | Invoke | Subscribe` 的 outer interpreter；不拥有独立 command map、recipe、permission 或 provider switch。

provider declaration 使用 restricted structural schema algebra + construction-bound Constraint/evaluator/digest；runtime foreign provider 以 certified opaque document/slot binding 进入 catalog，不能 retroactively add TS union member。

foreign boundary 提供 versioned handshake/discover/bind/call/subscribe/credit/cancel/terminal，descriptor schema/metadata/executable interpretation 一起认证；provider business vocabulary open，kernel control ADT exhaustive。
output/error/effect/delivery/scope/resource/availability/fingerprint 从同一 declaration 派生，禁止 schema 与 independent metadata drift；unknown runtime document 可渲染但不 cast。
preservedContract: 保留现有 CLI/MCP consumers 的 discover/help/invoke/subscribe intent、provider-specific command names/fields、RSS/search-bars/market tools 与 native diagnostics。
保留 same-process registry 作为一种 trusted local interpretation path；保留 IBroker adapters 在迁移期的 exact native methods，不把未实现方法强制填成 global Unsupported。
保留 generated AI/CLI 的 provenance/correlation and redacted errors；不保留 raw action/path arbitrary dispatch。
selectedChanges: 将 CLI_EXPORTS/cli-commands/MCP exporter 改为最终 descriptor/catalog projection：named help、JSON Schema、invoke/subscribe path 和 output/error/delivery metadata 自动派生。
把 runtime schemas barrel、foreign handshake 与 capability certification 补为 construction-bound boundary；schema slot 绑定 provider/revision/digest 后再解析 input/output/failure。
将 IBroker closed interface 拆为 provider declarations/installed interpretations；缺 native capability 的 leaf 从 provider tree 缺席，避免四方法/global ActionContractMap。
unknown runtime provider/document 只能走 encoded generic projection and typed boundary failure；它不会凭 schema shape 互换 capability 或跨 slot。
每个 provider 自己声明 exact schema/enum/extension；不得从 closed IBroker 或候选文档盲目继承 enum，也不得把历史 route 名称当作公共 vocabulary。
descriptor/command identity 使用 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 full domain-separated digests；provider configuration fingerprint 不能代替包含 schema slots、delivery、requirements、interpretation 的目标 digest。

effectAndStateOwnership.CLI/MCP/AI: 渲染/调用最终 definitions，维护 CLI session/help/provenance；不执行 opaque recipe。
effectAndStateOwnership.Registry/Loader: 加载并验证 provider declaration/interpretation/version/digest；foreign loader 由 UTA trusted tree 监督。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTA: 拥有 current admission authorization、credential/effect requirements、writer and recovery；提供 Effect services R 但不制造 PermissionWitness。

failuresAndRecovery: schema export/parse failure、unknown provider document、binding slot/revision/digest mismatch、foreign load/handshake/transport/output error 都是 typed boundary failures。
CLI process stop/pipe break 不代表 controlled effect cancelled；DispatchStarted/Unknown 仍由 UTA recovery owner 处理。
registry interpretation unavailable 对新调用是 unavailable；历史 attempt 只能 exact resolver/recovery，不可用 current loader reprepare。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: provider investigation 已证明 Zod 4 local input-only schema、手写 CLI map、empty schema barrel、same-process registry、closed IBroker 与 native richness/stubs；不证明 target declaration/evaluator/foreign protocol implementation。
CLI/MCP runtime generation、AI display of dynamic document、remote error decoding 与 credential isolation 必须由 executable specimen/runtime gate 证明。
migrationCutover: 建立 descriptor/catalog projection API，再逐项迁移 CLI_EXPORTS、cli-commands、MCP exporter；保留 user-facing names only as generated declaration metadata。
把 provider declarations 与 implementations construction-bind，增加 schema slot/digest certification；删除 `z.toJSONSchema` fallback `{}` 和 unchecked command internals。
为 foreign/local provider paths 增加 handshake/discover/invoke/stream/cancel/terminal protocol；移除 global map/four-method requirement，保留 provider-native unsupported absence。

sections.category: 外层协议、AI 与决策交接
sections.title: 补充 trigger→ReturnToAgent：Workspace、Session、headless、Inbox 的精确分工
currentBehavior: EventLog 是 durable append-only history + process-local subscription，不是 task dispatcher；event-system 文档将自动化路由到 Workspace Issues/headless/Inbox，而不是 event bus。
Workspace Issues 的 when 只表达 at/every/cron timing；scanner 触发时机，prompt 仍需检查条件。ConversationControl 根据 exact resumeId/owner/workspace 重建 target，缺失/删除的 native session 会 unavailable。

headless task registry 把 task log/resumeId 写盘，boot 时 leftover running→interrupted；comment delivery 有 pending/replied/failed 与 deterministic reply ID；Inbox 是 server-stamped user notification record，不是 AI command queue，当前 connector dedup 不足。
abstractExpression: A7 的 public relation 是 `DeferredInvocation<SourceBinding, Checkpoint, PredicateVersion, IntentRevision, FutureBoundary, Disposition, DecisionChannel>`。纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary) -> {checkpoint, NoActivation | Candidate | Gap}` 在 writer transaction 中与 event consumption/next outbox 一起提交；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 live activation owner，多个 source 在 owner 内组合。

UTA durable outbox/control 先生成 stable `ReviewRequest{requestId, intentRevision, exactTerms, source/predicate evidence, reasons, validity, authorization state, recipient, allowedCommands}`；authenticated Alice bridge 以 `(requestId, deliveryGeneration)` durable-admit，再调用 exact `WorkspaceConversationControl`。

`ReturnToAgent` 是 configured `RequestDecision` strategy：它不直接 dispatch broker。Alice 对 exact/reconstructed product Session 做责任归属；Workspace 是持久 context/desk，Issue 是用户可见 projection（除非明确另有 authority）；headless task 在 spawn 前写入 stable task/resume link；Inbox 只是用户通知 projection。

Session/Workspace/headless/Inbox 不拥有 UTA effect authority：Session `resumeId` 是 responsible AI target，native agentSessionId/PID 是 backend metadata；headless retry 查询同一 admission；Inbox delivery 不等于 review command/venue completion。
preservedContract: 保留旧 HeldIntent/TriggerBinding/review/control records 的 durable fields 作为 DeferredInvocation storage projections：source identity/continuity、baseline、predicate revision、future/expiry、intent revision、recipient、allowed response。
保留 Workspace owner/reconstruction、exact resume/unavailable semantics、headless task attribution、Issue comment idempotent reply、Inbox user notification 与 product EventLog history。
保留 ReturnToAgent zero-dispatch semantics；Keep 返回 queryable suspended control handle，Rearm/new future boundary/new epoch，Revise 是新 intent revision，Discard 只限未发送。
selectedChanges: 事实可选择 evidence/request transition 但不能 authorize dispatch；predicate checkpoint 即使 nonmatching event 也持久化，missing baseline/continuity gap 不能制造 crossing，correction/retraction 维护 checkpoint/evidence。

writer atomically consumes trusted event identity + invocation epoch at most once, commits checkpoint and next outbox; outbox send/receipt uses durable status and unknown recovery，scheduler lease expiry 不准重发 old possibly-sent request。
Alice bridge 负责 stable request admission、WorkspaceConversationControl delivery、headless attribution、Inbox/Issue projection；UTA 负责 durable review/outbox/control identity。
responsible AI response 必须 decode 到 `Keep | Discard | Rearm | Revise | RequestSubmission` 等 allowed schema，再由 UTA 重查 review id/revision/scope/policy/CAS；绝不解析自由文本作为 permission。
ReviewRequest 的 no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 必须冻结为 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision`；response 与 timeout 在同一 control CAS 竞争，禁止自动执行 fallback。

effectAndStateOwnership.UTA: 拥有 DeferredInvocation intent revision、checkpoint、source binding、predicate version、outbox、ReviewRequest identity、activation owner、dispatch/recovery。
effectAndStateOwnership.AliceBridge: 拥有 authenticated admission record、deliveryGeneration、WorkspaceConversationControl exact/reconstructed routing、headless attribution。
effectAndStateOwnership.Workspace/Session: Workspace 持久化 product context；Session resumeId 指定 responsible AI conversation；两者都不授予 UTA writer authority。
effectAndStateOwnership.Headless/Inbox/Issue: Headless 记录 task/resume/worker lifecycle；Issue/Inbox 是用户可见 delivery projections；delivery/reply receipt 与 venue outcome 分开。

failuresAndRecovery: source gap/correction/retraction、missing baseline、predicate evaluator unavailable、stale future boundary、duplicate event identity、stale epoch 进入 `Gap`/checkpoint invalidation/RecoveryRequired，不触发 fake activation。

Alice admission duplicate 查询同一 stable request；Workspace resume unavailable 则 exact policy 返回 unavailable/ask user/reconstructed target，不创建任意新 agent；headless crash 标记 Interrupted，不能声称 delivery/dispatch complete。
Keep/expiry/lease/approval 是不同 clocks；停止 CLI 或保留 draft 不取消 sent/unknown venue work。Inbox pending/replied/failed 只证明 delivery projection，不证明 responsible AI command 或 effect terminal。
新的 review admission 只产生一次 durable request identity；若后续 controlled Start 成功才获得 one-use DispatchGrant，重复 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted evidence，不能由保存的 approval 重新发 grant。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: source 已证明 EventLog/history、Issue timing/scanner、ConversationControl exact/reconstructed resolution、headless task logs、comment delivery states、Inbox notification roles；不证明已有 UTA review outbox↔Alice bridge。
trigger supplemental investigation 明确要求 authenticated bridge、stable request key、one activation owner、pure checkpoint and ReturnToAgent strategy；这些是 host design obligations，非现有 native capability。
EventLog subscription、Issue scanner 和 Inbox connector 不可升级为 durable trigger bus/delivery authority without implementation evidence。
migrationCutover: 将 waiting order/TriggerBinding/review records 映射为 DeferredInvocation storage projection，增加 checkpoint/predicate/version/epoch/activation owner/outbox identity。
实现 UTA outbox→authenticated Alice durable admission→WorkspaceConversationControl→headless/Inbox/Issue projections；retry 使用同一 request/delivery/task identity。
实现 pure advance + single writer checkpoint transaction，禁止 source fact 直接 dispatch；将 ReturnToAgent/Keep/Rearm/Revise/RequestSubmission 接入 typed response schema。
保留 EventLog、Issue scheduler、headless registry、Inbox 为各自 owner；不要创建新的 global event bus 或把 delivery projection 当作 venue/effect authority。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: 跨组不变量与证据边界
sections.currentBehavior: 恢复的 crossGroupContracts、additionalFindings、composition/data/trigger/provider investigations 共同指出：旧 UTA/IBroker/Git/registry 以 SDK superset、默认 scope、静默过滤和字符串错误把不同语义压成一个 facade；source experiments 又显示 remote side effect 后 snapshot/persist failure 与 guard cooldown consumption 的真实风险。
sections.abstractExpression: 本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。
preservedContract: 所有 source-specific unknown、read-only review、keyless/public boundary、native field richness、decimal/FX/valuation uncertainty、callback generation、sync/history/snapshot、simulator and Guardian boundaries 均保留为 observable obligations。
ReturnToAgent 只作为 configured RequestDecision strategy；trigger/source/event 本身不授权 dispatch；数据流不承担交易 WAL/lock/compensation。

CoreAccount: K01: Each CoreAccount capability is a declaration that supplies its own exact input/output/error schemas, semantic unit, handler and resource needs; data readers and controlled effects compose separately, and adding a provider leaf must not edit a kernel switch.

CoreAccount: K02: The UTA-facing fixed CapabilityDescriptor envelope is shared, but provider trees remain open-ended. CoreAccount must not introduce a global ActionContractMap or require every provider to implement empty broker handlers; the source IBroker/global switch is retained only as currentBehavior evidence.

CoreAccount: K03: Zod/JSON-schema declarations are the source for validation, static types, metadata and CLI projections. Native order, instrument and error fields survive as exact provider extensions; SDK Contract/Order values are adapter-bound and never journaled.

CoreAccount: K04: Order, Candle, Instrument and related units are composable contracts, not a closed order-combination catalogue. Quantity/notional, protection, TIF and relation choices are provider-declared HOF/schema combinations; AccountScope is required for account/order effects only, while public data carries explicit Public or schema-declared context.

CoreAccount: K05: Account/position/order/catalog reads are pull data or resource-scoped push streams with explicit freshness, cursor, coverage, backpressure and recovery evidence. They do not use prepare/approve/compensate, effect locks or per-frame WAL.

CoreAccount: K06: Generated CLI/help/describe views must come from the same declared capability tree. Pull returns finite schema data and push returns lifecycle-aware frames; CLI cancellation releases its read resource without cancelling an already accepted trading effect.

CoreAccount: K07: Broker adapters may retain native SDK/protocol/process boundaries. Only the selected declared leaf handler crosses that boundary; load/input/output/delivery errors and post-dispatch Unknown remain distinct, and method presence never proves idempotency or atomicity.

CoreAccount: K08: Durable intent, approval, dispatch, WAL/CAS/idempotency, reconciliation and compensation apply only to controlled trading effects. Data-cache or observation failure cannot trigger transaction compensation; native guarantees remain evidence-qualified.

CoreAccount: K09: A trigger/event source is not authority. If CoreAccount later participates in a trigger binding, activation must carry frozen intent/revision, scope and policy evidence and pass the normal execution authorization path.

CoreAccount: K10: ReturnToAgent is a durable unsent-order review branch with stable ReviewRequest/outbox identity and explicit retain/rearm/revise/discard/request-submission commands; it creates no broker dispatch and does not claim AI delivery.

CoreAccount: K11: Existing source facts, durability boundaries, unknown/precision/absence obligations and open native questions remain evidence. Reframing removes obsolete universal-SDK conclusions without declaring sibling ownership or empirical gaps solved.

CoreAccount: K12: CoreAccount verificationCases are future falsifiers only: prove declaration-derived type/validator/metadata changes, public-vs-account scope, data pull/push separation, native schema validation, unknown barriers and ReturnToAgent zero-dispatch behavior; no runtime proof was run here.

ProtocolModels: AccountScope is required on account-bound controlled effects, order/position observations, conflict keys and account-authenticated market observations; public Candle/Instrument/News data uses an explicit PublicMarket source variant or a provider-declared scope and never receives a default account. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:642-688, :700-724, :759-790 and git.ts:256-305.

ProtocolModels: CapabilityDescriptor is the fixed UTA-facing envelope (identity/path, schema versions/fingerprint, input/result/error schemas, delivery/effect/resource metadata, provenance and availability); provider capability trees are open, leaves may be absent, and an existing leaf can be unavailable without becoming structural absence. There is no global ActionContractMap or mandatory full Broker SDK. Evidence: broker.ts:475-620.

ProtocolModels: Order is a semantic unit and controlled-effect input composed by provider declarations/HOFs. Units versus Notional, amount versus percent, timing and protection remain local validated relations; native MOC/LOC/REL/OPG or other fields survive as exact provider extensions. No provider is required to accept another provider’s leaf, and native atomicity is never inferred from shape. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637, :703-724 and cited IBKR/Alpaca/Longbridge/CCXT sources.

ProtocolModels: RuntimeHealth is a closed process observation ADT; broker reach, capability availability, authorization and transaction admission are separate. Health observations never grant dispatch permission. Evidence: broker.ts:366-426.

ProtocolModels: Pull results are finite data projections and push streams have explicit frame/lifecycle/cursor/backpressure contracts. Complete/Partial/Unavailable and freshness/finality remain explicit; data reads and caches do not use prepare/approve/compensate or per-frame transaction WAL. Evidence: broker.ts:322-364, :428-450.

ProtocolModels: JournalWriter/events/attempts are authority only for controlled effects; Git/history/manager and market-data outputs are rebuildable projections. DispatchStarted is durable before remote mutation, and response/storage loss remains Unknown/RecoveryRequired. Evidence: TradingGit.ts:141-185, :160-180, :171-180.

ProtocolModels: InstrumentId/InstrumentDescriptor/ScopedOrderRef and PositionObservation are normalized identities/facts; native Contract/Order/Decimal stay adapter-local. A string aliceId, symbol or branded string alone cannot prove equality. Evidence: contract-ext.ts:4-22, :25-31 and broker.ts:10-12.

ProtocolModels: Protocol failures are route/leaf/action-associated ADTs with redacted evidence and typed recovery (ProtocolViolation, QueryFailure, CapabilityFailure, BrokerRejection, DispatchUnknown, StorageUnavailable); WireBrokerError and Error.message are not a universal contract. Evidence: broker.ts:44-79 and errors.ts:10-18.

Identity: InstrumentIdentityContract: InstrumentId is only a nominal type; adapters construct it from an evidence-backed venue/listing/native-key tuple, persist a uniqueness-checked alias mapping scoped by venue/listing and by account only where the identity is account-bound, and surface unresolved or conflicting mappings. Display symbol, `aliceId`, conId, and SDK Contract are not interchangeable.

Identity: ScopeContract: public Candle/News/Instrument/catalog facts use explicit `Public` scope and never receive a fabricated account or subaccount; account positions, account-bound search targets, and executable order facts carry an explicit `AccountScope`. Read/keyless capability is not promoted to transaction authority.

Identity: NativeSentinelContract: IBKR UNSET_DECIMAL/UNSET_DOUBLE/UNSET_INTEGER handling remains adapter-local; OrderSpec, OrderSnapshot, protocol, journal, and projections use explicit absent/typed values and never SDK objects or sentinel numbers.

Identity: PositionObservationContract: broker-reported pair, incomplete known component, or derived valuation must preserve multiplier, currency, InstrumentId, AccountScope, freshness, and observation provenance; one-sided upstream valuation is retained as Incomplete and only a selected Prepare whose effect explicitly requires complete valuation rejects it.

Identity: CatalogSearchContract: normalizer, ranker, account-query fan-out, and protocol must share deterministic score/tie/source-precedence/dedup/page/truncation/source-failure semantics; duplicate canonical IDs require equality evidence and partial-source failure cannot be silently resolved.

Identity: TransactionEntryContract: HTTP/UI form routes, TradingGit projection, transaction-kernel, journal-store, and durable-scheduler must cut over together from executeOneShotOrder to Draft/Prepare/Approve/Queue; Git commit/push is not broker execution authority.

Identity: NativeInstrumentContract: the currently observed IBKR SecType values and structural rules remain in brokers/ibkr codecs, while the UTA-facing Instrument descriptor carries evidence-backed identity/context and precise provider extensions. Other providers may expose their own native kinds; only exact, declared mappings yield shared semantics or execution capability, and absence is reported as capability unavailable rather than by a universal handler or closed global taxonomy.

Catalog: Fixed outer metadata: each provider declaration exposes protocol version, stable capability identity/command path, schema version/fingerprint, exact input/result/domain-error schemas, delivery, effect category, permissions/resources, provenance and scoped availability evidence. Provider trees and native extensions remain open; structural absence is preserved.

Catalog: Schema/HOF source of truth: provider declarations compose exact input/output/error schemas and semantic units without a central closed action table or handwritten Cartesian order variants. Provider-local registration/layer functions may use any language, SDK or process.

Catalog: Scope semantics: AccountScope is required for account-owned facts and controlled trading effects; public Candle/Instrument/News/search readers use Public/data scope or their exact provider-declared scope. The Catalog never fabricates a default account or subaccount.

Catalog: Pack provenance: src/core/broker-packs.ts remains the manifest/pointer/package-identity gate. Installed release precedence is retained; broken installed content does not silently fall through to workspace or Mock. Descriptor decoding is separate from provider execution.

Catalog: Identity: AccountId, AccountScope, ConnectionGeneration and LegacyUtaIdAlias/IdentityBinding remain durable account concerns. Preset labels, engine tags, credential hashes and display symbols never substitute for observed scope or stable identity.

Catalog: Environment and availability: mode/port/network labels are TradingEnvironmentHint only. Authenticated provider evidence and current resource/permission state produce availability; unknown or mismatched evidence does not become writable capability.

Catalog: Data/effect boundary: Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup pulls are finite results and pushes are resource-scoped streams with explicit cursor, end, error and gap semantics. Data readers, caches and streams do not use order approval, compensation, locks or per-frame WAL.

Catalog: Controlled effect boundary: only a provider-declared trading/effect leaf is wrapped by prepare/approve/dispatch/recovery. Existing scope/unit validation, durable intent, WAL/CAS/lease, dispatch identity, reconcile-before-retry and Unknown handling remain there; native idempotency, atomicity and reversibility require provider evidence.

Catalog: Credential/sealed storage: src/core/config.ts:704-746 remains the owner-only sealed configuration boundary. SecretRefs cross into provider effects, while secret material stays out of protocol payloads, descriptor metadata, plans, digests, journals and logs.

Catalog: Instrument/search: SearchPattern preserves source symbol and rule version; only observed venue listings create canonical Instrument associations. Completeness is Complete/Partial/Unavailable, never guessed from a heuristic or skipped provider failure.

Catalog: FX: multi-currency provider leaves declare an FxRequirement; an effect-provided, provenance-bearing FxObservation is required only for those leaves. Currency-independent data/read leaves remain available without an FX service.

Catalog: Simulator: SimulatorInstanceId and AccountScope are durable identity; simulated market/order state may remain ephemeral. Reset/restart yields explicit generation/recovery evidence and never fabricates a fill or remints identity.

Catalog: Wire and CLI: public/HTTP/CLI projections are derived from the same capability tree. Decode unknown once, preserve exact leaf schemas, distinguish pull output from push frames, and do not treat schema success as readiness or authorization.
Catalog: CCXT tools and other callers consume declared provider capability ports, not brokerEngine reflection. Availability and completeness are provider-specific and structured.

Catalog: Verification: K12 scenarios prove declaration-derived schema/type/metadata/CLI changes, structural absence, boundary rejection, pull/push lifecycle, provider output validation and controlled-effect recovery without claiming native guarantees that remain unobserved.
selectedChanges: 用固定的 CapabilityDescriptor 外壳绑定 identity/path、schema slots、delivery、effect/resources、provenance 与 availability；provider tree 保持开放，unsupported leaf 保持结构性缺失。
把 AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId、Principal、DispatchIdentity 分成不可互换的 identity，并只对账户事实/受控效果要求 scope。
把 Pull 的 Complete|Partial|Unavailable 与 Push 的 item-error/gap/snapshot-end、Completed|Failed|Cancelled 分开；普通 live query 保留 asOf/coverage/provenance，不把全量 frame 写成交易 WAL。
把 Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract> 的 recipe、receipt/control-result、stage-error、admission R/P 与 execution R/P 保持同一关联；受控发送前写入 durable intent/attempt。
让 fresh Start transition 产生一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant；duplicate/query Start 只返回 AlreadyStarted，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 永远不等于 grant。
为 no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 冻结 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision；timeout 与 response 使用同一 control CAS，永不自动执行 fallback。
把 `LegacyUtaIdAlias` 限制为已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；把旧 Git/字符串错误/IBKR sentinel/descriptor callback 迁移到 provider-local codecs 与历史 resolver。
用 RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 的完整、分域、版本化 digest 绑定 definition/command/plan；未验证 provider idempotency、atomicity、finality、absence 与 recovery 保持 evidence gap。
对 legacy Git row 执行 positive no-callback 分类；marker 缺失不构成 NoStart，缺 native/attempt identity 的 post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay。
sections.effectAndStateOwnership: 公共 schema/wire/CLI 由同一声明派生；外部 provider 可为 in-process SDK 或 supervised foreign process，均以 versioned handshake/descriptor/typed boundary 接入。UTA writer owns durable control/outbox/authority；Alice 仅 owner delivery/admission，不替代 execution authority。
failuresAndRecovery: 所有未决事实保持 empirical-evidence boundary；unknown after send 进入 recovery，不 reprepare；历史 definition removed/revised 仅在 not-started 且 durable retire 后可改用新 revision。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 本组没有声称已完成 runtime verification；K12 verificationCases 是 future falsifiers，主集成器需运行 schema-derived CLI、foreign process、durable-effect、stream 和 trigger specimens。
migrationCutover: binding/question appendix 用于逐项组装最终书；不得用本章节替代原始 source records，也不得把 provider-specific findings 重写成新的业务实体或统一 action map。

sections.title: CCXT provider pack 边界与遗留能力容纳方法
currentBehavior: source architecture currently has a legacy CcxtBroker implementing IBroker and routing optional helpers through exchangeOverrides; tests combine real CCXT construction, keyless public reads, local mocks, and venue-specific overrides.

source data and account paths contain nullable/catch-all conversions, permissive empty/zero/current-time fallbacks, and provider-local sequential routes; these remain migration facts, not hidden guarantees.
assigned CCXT source does not read exchange.has; future availability sampling must inspect a versioned exchange instance rather than infer support from method presence or registry membership.
abstractExpression: 本章节把 CcxtCore 与 CcxtVenues 作为同一个 CCXT provider pack 的迁移边界来容纳，而不是再造 universal CCXT broker interface。每个 capability leaf 在构造时绑定 semantic unit、精确 input/success/failure schema、requirements、delivery、interpretation revision 与 provider identity；pack 只组合声明，不把 legacy CcxtBroker、exchangeOverrides 或四方法 action map 提升为内核代数。

A1：Use exact semantic units Order, Candle, Instrument, News/NewsGroup where present; attach AccountScope only where a fact/capability requires it, and keep provider/source identity distinct from canonical identity.

A2：Use a restricted structural schema algebra. Construction binds Constraint<Value, Configuration, Failure>, deterministic evaluator artifact and digest; extensions lift the same constraint. Foreign runtime documents bind provider instance, capability, revision, semantic/schema digest and schema slot; equal JSON shape is insufficient. Provider vocabulary remains open; never blindly inherit candidate-document enum sets.

A3：Resource provisioning, permission witness, schema compatibility and native guarantee are separate. Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract> retains receipt/control-result/stage-error associations. withTransaction accepts only an opaque non-public mutation recipe; query/stream invokers cannot accept it.

A4：Current CCXT leaves are finite Pull. Kernel Coverage is exactly Complete|Partial|Unavailable; unknown value/quality is payload/reason, not a new global coverage variant. Any future Push must represent Start, Update/Correction/Retraction/Gap, SnapshotEnd, recoverable item error and one terminal Completed/Failed/Cancelled; native snapshot-end is not automatically subscription terminal, and crash does not promise last stdout frame.

A5：Decision/Evolution stay pure. Prepared plan freezes exact historical interpretation, native request form, identity, scope, schema/capability revision and idempotency evidence. Target canonicalization is RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 with full domain-separated digests, but this shard does not claim that narrow specimens implement it. After DispatchStarted/Unknown, missing interpretation requires RecoveryRequired and never reprepare/current-code dispatch.

A6：Only declared controlled effects reach the writer/interpreter. A fresh Start transition yields one-use process-bound DispatchGrant; duplicate/query Start returns AlreadyStarted evidence and never a replayable grant; persisted authorization is not a grant. Ack, observation, compensation and Unknown are explicit; data reads do not become transactions or order WAL.

A7：Deferred invocation has one not-started intent revision and one live activation owner. Pure advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary) yields NoActivation/Candidate/Gap; facts cannot authorize dispatch, and writer atomically commits checkpoint/event/outbox. No-reply, expiry and delivery-unavailable policies are frozen as SuspendControl, CloseWithoutDispatch or EscalateDecision; timeout races response under the same control CAS and never auto-executes.

A8：Provider vocabulary remains open and venue-local. No global BrokerActionTypeMap, four-method requirement, Cartesian order types, speculative dual-read/shim compatibility phase, or universal ReturnToAgent default is introduced. Migration uses offline parity/import followed by a single-authority cutover.
preservedContract: Preserve the real/keyless CCXT constructor and public-history evidence path, but classify it as PublicReadOnly and keep the CCXT_E2E gate as selection evidence rather than proof of private authority or realtime quality.

Preserve CcxtBroker/CcxtMarket/legacy DTOs and override registry only at the provider compatibility boundary; the core never stores raw SDK objects as its schema, and no speculative dual-read/shim phase is added without a shipped boundary.

Preserve exact venue behavior: Bitget Classic six namespace route and merge key, Bybit category sweep and four lookup paths, Hyperliquid last→close reference and derived mark, and default-vs-override distinctions.

Preserve read-only review and empirical uncertainty. Native availability, idempotency, finality, retention, pagination, and endpoint semantics stay Unknown/requires-provider-evidence until recorded provider observations bind them.

Preserve source-proven legitimate zero values, verified same-currency FxIdentity, and explicitly policy-approved Estimated display values; remove unknown=1/unknown=0 fabrication rather than deleting every default or every 1:1 policy.
selectedChanges: 按章节把 120 个 expectedId 映射到 13 个详细 accommodation sections，并在 binding appendix 中逐一给出 preserve 或 adjust-prior-candidate 裁决。

将 all source/input boundaries 解码为精确 schema/Result variants；移除 unknown value/quality 被 zero 或 local now 冒充的 fallback、global action map 与 coupled method gate，但保留 schema 明确的合法零值、same-currency identity 和 policy-approved display estimate。

把 account, permission, writer effect, observation, data cache, control journal 与 deferred invocation 分离；ordinary live data 可按 asOf/coverage 读取，不为每个事实写 full-feed WAL；只持久化 explicit capture、control evidence 与 activation checkpoint。
Controlled effect 先走 admission/authorization 与 writer CAS；只有新鲜 Start 才产生一次性 DispatchGrant。No-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 必须在注册时冻结为 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision。
把 44 个原始问题字符串逐字保留，并根据 closure 维持 requires-provider-evidence 或 resolved-by-host-contract；不把设计记录升级为 runtime evidence。
不添加 speculative dual-read/shim/compatibility phase：先做 offline parity/import，再一次性切换 single authority。
Restored cross-group contracts are consumed as concrete source constraints and re-expressed by the A1-A8 laws; their historical K labels are not emitted as binding/question rule identifiers.
effectAndStateOwnership: Connection interpreter owns endpoint, credentials reference, sandbox/demo guards, proxy and load/refresh network effects; credential values remain outside this artifact and are supplied through approved secret/reference boundaries.

Provider leaf interpreter owns native request encoding, route sequencing, response decoding, provider error evidence and source timestamps. Writer owns only declared controlled effects and atomic journal/outbox/checkpoint writes.

Catalog/data/account observations may be read live with asOf/coverage and may be cached or durably recorded with explicit capture/provenance, but they are not order WAL and do not authorize dispatch. Ordinary frame throughput does not share account/order locks.

A7 owner owns one live activation and its durable checkpoint; RecoveryRequired/OutcomeUnknown retains original bytes, identities, and ownership until observation/reconciliation resolves it. DispatchGrant is process-bound and one-use, not durable authorization.
failuresAndRecovery: Unknown, unavailable, malformed, no-account, permission denied, stale, route failure and native protocol violations remain distinct domain failures where the source gives enough evidence; Kernel Coverage remains only Complete|Partial|Unavailable.

A crash or broken pipe after dispatch does not imply a terminal frame or absence; preserve prepared bytes and dispatch-start uncertainty, retain the conflict lock, and reconcile through the declared observation capability. Losing a grant/response after commit leads to observation, never replay.
Provider-specific failures (Bitget namespace rejection, Bybit category failure/conditional-path absence, Hyperliquid quote unavailability) do not trigger a universal fallback or blind resend.
Control no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable is resolved only by its frozen policy; timeout and response compete under the same control CAS, with no auto-exec fallback.
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: CcxtCore closure keeps six empirical prerequisites; CcxtVenues keeps 36 empirical prerequisites plus two host/integration resolutions. The questions appendix is the exact retained set of 44 originals.

No assigned source currently proves exchange.has availability, native id stability, order idempotency, finality/retention, full listing coverage, stream quality, or private permission. A future specimen must bind venue, environment, SDK revision, provider capability revision, scope, request, source timestamps, observedAt and outcome evidence.
RFC8785/JCS/UTF-8/SHA-256 full domain-separated digest is a selected host target, not evidence that the narrow CCXT specimens already implement it.
migrationCutover: First add provider-bound schema/Constraint definitions and adapters; then migrate public/catalog/data/account leaves; then migrate optional controlled effects and venue-local overrides. Do not make raw CcxtBroker or registry types part of the core algebra.

For every existing caller, replace implicit defaults with explicit availability/failure variants and preserve native route evidence. PreparedPlanRecord stores exact interpretation/request bytes and selected identity; post-start uncertainty goes to recovery, never current-code reprepare.

Offline parity/import compares old adapter projections against the declared provider leaves without introducing a speculative dual-read/shim phase; once parity evidence is accepted, perform a single-authority cutover and remove obsolete compatibility ownership.

The integrated book and specimens consume this chapter only after every assigned map binding and question closure is represented; this artifact itself records no runtime claim beyond the restored source evidence boundary.

sections.title: 启动、authority cutover、simulator fixture 与实证闸门
sections.currentBehavior: UTA startup 先读取 config、restore JSON state、建立 brokers、启动 snapshot/order timers、绑定 loopback HTTP，并以简单 ok/startedAt/UTA count health 提供服务；构造函数 fire-and-forget connect，shutdown 丢失 poller handle 后直接 process.exit。E2E setup 使用 singleton raw broker 初始化，只过滤 paper/sandbox/demo；package/tsup/Docker evidence 尚未包含选定的 SQLite native stack。Simulator 直接操纵进程内 MockBroker；S7 external stimulus 与普通 effect scenario 共用旧 fixture。
sections.abstractExpression: Composition root 依次拥有 OwningHome→OpeningDatabase→Migrating→VerifyingJournal→RebuildingExecution→AcquiringConnections→ClassifyingRecovery→Ready；各 provider capability availability、公共 data availability 与 controlled-effect readiness 相互独立。StorageStackStatus 未验证时，controlled UTA 不 Ready/dispatch，也不退回 JSON/alternate driver。测试提供 PollingVerticalSliceFixture：UTA authority SQLite 与独立 DurableMockVenue ledger 分开，声明 effect mutation、finite pull、push stream leaves；runtime fixture 的 pure fold/classify 与真实 crash cuts 分开标示。
preservedContract: 单一本地 UTA home/authority 保留；外部 provider effect endpoint、data facts/streams、telemetry/backup 都是 scoped external roles，不引入必需的 Redis/Postgres/workflow engine。
paper/sandbox safety、AccountScope/environment/session/entitlement evidence、complete baseline 和 cleanup 仍是 controlled acceptance 的前置条件；public data 可以独立报告 availability。
Simulator 的 mark/fill/cancel stimuli、InProcessRetainedLedger 和 DurableMockVenue 作为明确的 test-owned seam 保留，但不升级为 native venue guarantees。
首次 migration/recovery、read-only projection、backup/restore、corruption、packaging/ABI、single/double owner 等均以具名 status/evidence 表示，不以 manifest/hash/count 代表通过。
selectedChanges: 启动先验证 declaration/schema/DB/Journals/checkpoints，再扫描非终态 transaction/job/lease/attempt，建立 RecoveryCase/ObservationJob；之后才开放 controlled admission。

按 Source/Docker/PackagedDesktop × OS/arch/Node ABI/SQLite/native artifact/provider bridge 执行 storage acceptance；锁定 semver/digest/load/open/migrate/pragma/crash/restore/relocation/corruption/read-only/double-owner evidence。
shutdown root 保存 scheduler/layer handles，并按 orderly sequence 关闭 admission、drain/interrupt workers、persist jobs、drain writer、close provider layers/DB；不以 process.exit 掩盖 in-flight unknown。
验收场景将 S7 external stimulus 与 UTA effect path 分离；effect tests 使用独立 durable venue，data tests 使用已声明的 pull/push 或 observation owner。
effectAndStateOwnership: Composition root 持有 Layer wiring、supervised fibers、lifecycle 与 readiness；JournalStore 持有受控 authority；provider process 在可信 credential boundary 下持有 native execution/data protocols。
测试用 MockVenue 持有其 ledger 与 native test identity；UTA journal 永不将其作为 authority 读写，data caches/streams 也不写入 effect WAL。
Packaging/home metadata 描述部署而非 rollback/fencing/exactly-once；restore quarantine 与显式 authority cutover 仍由 writer 负责。
Observability/projection sink 可报告 queue/unknown/freshness，但不能授权、结算或 retry mutations。
failuresAndRecovery: 启动时 StorageFailure/CorruptJournal/MigrationRequired/NativeStackUnverified 会阻断受影响的 controlled authority；无关 public data/lite capability 独立报告 availability。
Credential/session/baseline/entitlement gap 返回 Blocked/NotApplicable/OperatorRequired；不得因 endpoint reachability、paper label、mock success 或 SDK method presence 而 dispatch。
Restore/clone 进入 RestoreQuarantine→ObservationOnly；不能靠复制 UUID/sequence 解决 double-owner 或 stale home。
Fixture setup/teardown failure 会使 vertical slice 失败并保留 journal/venue evidence；不接受 in-memory fake 作为 durable integration proof。

Legacy import 不得从缺少 DispatchStarted 推断 NoEffectsApplied：旧 TradingGit 只有在 executeOperation 之后才产生/持久化 completed push record。staging/pending 残留同样可能表示 broker callback 已执行，随后 snapshot/persistence 失败，如 E01 所示。缺少 native/attempt identity 的 completed 或 ambiguous post-push record 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，除非 positive terminal evidence 解析出历史记录；只有明确的 source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback，才允许 no-start retirement，且任何 legacy record 都不得 native replay。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 当前 startup、e2e setup、manifest 与 simulator 仅证明现有进程行为；本设计切片未执行 native SQLite dependency/version/ABI、durable writer、foreign bridge、真实 provider、AI delivery 或 venue conformance。
验证 artifacts 仅证明 pure schema/trigger examples 与 local fixtures；不建立上述 production runtime guarantees。
TradingGit.ts:119-249 与 E01 证明 callback-before-persistence，但不提供历史 DispatchStarted marker；因此 no-start classification 必须依据 positive source/evidence，而非 marker absence。
migrationCutover: Authority cutover 顺序为：盘点 legacy files/config/external liabilities → 冻结受影响 admission → 携 provenance 迁移/replay → 分类 unknown/recovery，并在任何 no-start retirement 前要求 positive no-callback evidence → 启用新 writer/readers → 验证 projections → 删除 fallback/direct dispatch → 保留 legacy exports 为只读。
任何实现都不得删除或改写既有 investigation records；第一个 executable slice 必须锁定 runtime dependencies，并在声称 Ready 前保留 raw migration evidence。

DispatchStarted 之后，historical resolver 必须精确且 immutable；若 compiler/observer/compensator 不可用，则保持 RecoveryRequired。对 legacy record，缺少新的 DispatchStarted marker 不是 no-start evidence，因为旧 TradingGit 只在 executeOperation 之后持久化 completed push state，且 staging/pending 残留也可能来自 callback 后的 snapshot/persistence failure。只有 positive source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback，才可进行 NoEffectsApplied/no-start retirement；缺少 native/attempt identity 的 completed 或 ambiguous post-push record 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired（或仅凭 positive terminal evidence 形成 resolved historical record），并且永不 native replay。

sections.title: MockBroker：测试 Layer、生命周期与故障注入
sections.currentBehavior: MockBroker class 同时持有 legacy facade、native translation、mutable ledger、queries、simulator controls、CallRecord 与 method/count failure injector；factory/Partial/override 可直接安装 arbitrary state。init/close 只改 promise/call log，restart/worker/lease/remote unknown 不存在。
sections.abstractExpression: Mock 不是全局 IBroker conformance，而是 provider-scoped declaration fixtures。`MockLayer` 为 Public/Account/Instrument scopes 提供 typed leaves；若要验证 durable semantics，另建独立 `DurableMockVenue` 与 JournalWriter/CAS/remote ledger。`CallRecord`、FailurePlan、InitialLedger、RemoteObservationFixture 都是 test support，不能冒充 native guarantees。
preservedContract: 保留 deterministic fixture、call trace、failure planning 与 pure reducer 的测试价值。
保留每个 scenario 的 explicit scope、identity、seed、revision、source/sequence；不依赖 process-global mutable singleton。
保留 Mock 可模拟 accepted/working/fill/cancel/external fact，但每种 outcome 由 typed fixture schema 表达。
selectedChanges: 将 factory config、Layer resources、fixture state、simulator controls 分离；`fromConfig` 不再构造承载所有 authority 的 class。
CallRecord 改 typed test observation（method/capability/input digest/time/effect identity），不把 unknown args 或 Date.now 当 authority。
FailurePlan 用 phase-tagged variants（prepare/admission/DispatchStarted/ack/observe/crash），可模拟 Unknown；关闭 fixture 释放其资源，但不取消 durable effect。
setter arbitrary positions/orders 改为 versioned InitialLedger/RemoteObservationFixture；只允许经过 schema/reducer 构造 impossible state。
barrel 迁移到 declarations/layers/fixtures；legacy facade 不与新 tree 并存为双 authority。
effectAndStateOwnership: Mock public/account reads 与 simulator fact feed 不自动启用 transaction；只有 `DurableMockVenue` mutation leaf 接受 withTransaction recipe。
仅 controlled mock effect 使用 UTA writer/journal/CAS/idempotency/recovery；test instrumentation 只观察，fixture resource 不制造 permission witness。
permission witness 与 injected service R 仍独立，fixture 不能用 resource presence 假造授权。
failuresAndRecovery: fixture load/schema/identity/phase errors typed；simulated crash after DispatchStarted always emits Unknown/recovery evidence。
data read failure 不触发 compensation；effect recovery 只由 durable remote observation resolve。

migrationCutover: 先采用 typed fixture layers 驱动现有 behavior tests，再为需要 crash proof 的场景引入 independent durable harness。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: MockBroker：外部事实、估值与独立 durable venue harness
sections.currentBehavior: simulator setters 直接改 mark/positions/orders/cash；manual fill 会缩短原 order quantity；external deposit/withdraw/trade bypass Alice pipeline 并可 SELL 无仓开 short；account override 完全遮住 live state；history/snapshot 是 wall-clock/ad hoc arrays；`_applyFill` 以 mutable maps 做 WAC/short/oversell。
sections.abstractExpression: 外部事实用 tagged source schemas：`PriceFact`、`FillFact`、`CancellationFact`、`BalanceTransferFact`、`ExternalExecutionFact`，每个带 source/sequence/as-of/scope/identity。纯 `Decision<State,Command,Event,ExternalEffect,Failure>`/`Evolution` reducers 只消费已构造事实；`AccountProjection` 的 `coverage` 仍输出 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`，估值质量另以 `ValuationStatus=Complete|Incomplete|DerivedUnavailable` payload/reason 表达。需验证 crash/restart 时使用 independent `DurableMockVenue`/remote ledger 与 `JournalWriter`，不把 simulator map 当本地/远程唯一账本。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。
preservedContract: 保留 simulator 可注入 mark/tick/fill/cancel/deposit/withdraw/external trade 的覆盖能力。
保留 Alice-origin 与 OutsideAlice-origin 的区别：external short policy 可允许外部 SELL 无仓，Alice SELL 无 exposure 仍拒绝。
保留 WAC、multiplier、long/short、mixed-book、oversell pure behavior，并保留 missing FX/mark 的不完整性。
保留已验证同币种 `FxIdentity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display projection；只移除 unknown=1/伪造完整估值，不删除真实的一比一关系。
selectedChanges: 所有 control API 产出 versioned fact/evidence，按 source identity/sequence 去重；不直接隐写 decision-bearing state。
manual partial fill 保持 original request 与 cumulative/leaves；cancel/fill 是 distinct event variants，不能通过删除 map row 表示。
account override 改为 typed `RemoteObservationFixture`/scenario input，带 scope/as-of/source，不能永久遮挡 cash/positions reconciliation。
external events 进入 data/reconciliation projection；只有显式 controlled command + permission 才能产生交易 effect。
pure reducer 对 missing mark/FX/multiplier 返回 incomplete/unknown；不得使用 default 100/1 或将 failed calculation 清零。
估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated display；未知 FX/mark/multiplier 不用 1 或 0 冒充完整，但已验证的一比一关系可保留。
effectAndStateOwnership: Simulator fact source、Mock public data、remote ledger、UTA writer 四者独立；fact ingestion 不自动成为 authorization。
deferred activation 若消费 facts，仅由 versioned pure `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` 产生 Candidate/Gap/NoActivation；one activation owner 与 durable checkpoint 防止重复花费同一 intent。
stream-like fact delivery 若实现，item-error/snapshot-end 是 nonterminal，terminal 只能 Completed/Failed/Cancelled；不要承诺 crash 后 final frame。
若数据触发 deferred invocation，使用纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` 与 durable checkpoint；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 activation owner，事件证据不能越级授权。
failuresAndRecovery: duplicate/late/correction/retraction/gap/unknown source facts 保留证据并更新 checkpoint；不能由单个 tick 越过 missing baseline。
crash after DispatchStarted 由 remote observation/RecoveryRequired 解决；停止 simulator 或 UI snapshot 不取消未知 venue work。
valuation failure 返回 explicit incomplete; compensation only per declared effect policy。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: Mock simulator facts are controlled evidence, not native market guarantees; durable venue implementation、idempotency/remote absence/replay/finality still require separate acceptance。
external bypass behavior tests Alice-vs-external policy only; it does not authorize broad provider shorting.
migrationCutover: 先把 setters/seed/failure controls 改成 typed fact source 与 pure reducers，再增加 optional durable remote harness for crash specimens。
删除 ad hoc snapshot/override/map mutation as sole authority；UI/CLI 只能投影 versioned observations and control commands。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: Live discovery：环境、账户、provider identity 与 admission catalog
currentBehavior: E2E setup 从配置选取第一个 provider/account，检查 preset-derived isPaper、engine-specific credential fields、disabled、IBKR TCP reachability，并以 module-global Promise 初始化；initWithTimeout race 30 秒后忽略 late result。
各 provider suite 通过 id substring/preset 选择 account，保存 generic IBroker；Alpaca/Bybit/Hyperliquid/OKX/IBKR 再以 native search/clock/equity/position 读取验证，部分 suite 缺 provider 时 skip。
preset catalog 只提供 engine/config fingerprint 与 paper hints；这些字段、credential presence、TCP reachability 或数组顺序都不能单独证明 intended account、capability availability 或 auth。
abstractExpression: `RuntimeAccountDescriptor` 显式包含 provider instance/venue/environment/account identity、endpoint and credential-binding evidence、readiness epoch/generation、scope、capability availability、source/observation timestamp；`AdmissionCatalog` 再按 principal 过滤可调用 leaves。

Discovery sequence 是 `load -> credential binding check -> transport reachability -> handshake -> descriptor discovery -> schema/digest certification -> readiness epoch`；每一步返回 typed outcome，不将 skip/log/comment 作为 authority。
Admission catalog 的当前 binding 与 historical resolver 分离：当前 revision/digest/availability 只决定新 call；旧 running/unknown attempt 保留原 interpreter identity，缺失即 RecoveryRequired，不得以当前 catalog reprepare。
preservedContract: 保留每 provider 的 environment/paper/testnet/live intent、account/subaccount、endpoint/readiness、native identity、market-clock session 与 credential failure 的差异。
保留 provider 缺失/disabled/no credentials/TCP fail/init timeout 的显式 unavailable/skip evidence；skip 不能被转成 passing capability。
保留 ready epoch、reconnect、late init/callback generation 与 account selection 的安全要求；不再用 first-match/substring 当 identity proof。
selectedChanges: 用 stable provider/account identity 与 declared selector 替换 first-account/id-substring；每次 discovery 产出 scope-bound descriptor 和 capability availability evidence。
把 isPaper/credential presence/TCP probe 作为 hints/preconditions，不作为 venue guarantee；handshake、catalog schema/digest、market session 和 account evidence 都要进入 acceptance record。
将 module-global cached Promise 改为 scoped discovery generation/owner；late initialization不能覆盖新 generation，disconnect/reconnect生成新 epoch。
admission 只从当前 catalog 选择 structurally supported + authorized + available leaf；unsupported leaf/empty namespace 缺席，loaded-but-disconnected 可描述为 unavailable。

effectAndStateOwnership.LiveHarness: 只编排真实环境/account preconditions、observation、cleanup 与 evidence；不成为新的 broker abstraction。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTA/Guardian: 拥有 credential binding、provider process、readiness/reconnect generation、admission catalog 与 writer permissions。
effectAndStateOwnership.ProviderAdapter: 提供 venue/native identity、capability declaration、availability and empirical evidence。
effectAndStateOwnership.EvidenceSink: 记录 run/account/provider/revision/correlation/provenance，不能授予 effect authority。

failuresAndRecovery: discovery failures 按 `CredentialUnavailable`、`TransportUnreachable`、`HandshakeFailure`、`SchemaCertificationFailure`、`CapabilityUnavailable`、`ReadinessExpired` 分类；不把 skipped/timeout 当 pass。
readiness epoch 过期时新调用重新 admit；已 DispatchStarted/Unknown 的 attempt 仍按原 attempt recovery，停止 harness/CLI 不取消 venue work。
账户 selector ambiguity、provider catalog Partial/Unavailable、TWS timeout 与 account-mode refusal 保留 source/provider evidence，不强行归一为 generic Unsupported。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: setup 与各 E2E source 已证明 first selection、preset/credential/TCP/init timeout、generic IBroker、conditional skip 与 provider-specific reads；不证明 descriptor catalog/foreign handshake/auth verifier。
当前 suite 的 direct native calls 是 acceptance stimuli/evidence，不能反向定义 host abstraction；每个 provider 的 capability, pagination, native identity and finality remains empirical。
migrationCutover: 定义 RuntimeAccountDescriptor、readiness epoch 与 provider-instance identity，迁移 setup/filterByProvider/account resolution；禁止 first-match/substring-only admission。
将 discovery/handshake/catalog certification 和 runtime evidence 写入 per-run envelope；将 skip/unavailable 作为 typed result。
把 live E2E 直接 native access 改为 descriptor-bound read/control leaves，保留 native diagnostic 仅作为 provider evidence channel。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: Live controlled effects：provider-native differences、ack/fill 与 unknown recovery
currentBehavior: Alpaca E2E 直接构造 native Contract/Order，检查 market/limit orderId、quote、position/close；UTA Alpaca 还 stage/push attached TP/SL 并可选读取 bracket legs。
Bybit 直接访问 `(broker as any).exchange` 做 raw conditional order/trigger；TPSL 使用 JS Number/Math.round，parent-linked legs/native trigger identity 未被稳定 schema 证明。

Hyperliquid 使用 0.001 BTC perp、把 USDC 归一为 USD 并在 wait 后读取 order/position；OKX 合成 spot position、处理 Cash mode 51010/51205/缺位与 dust；IBKR 以 conId/Contract 搜索，TWS snapshot timeout 可能导致 quote unavailable，IBKR TPSL 在测试中被忽略。
abstractExpression: 每个 provider effect leaf 保留完整 Order extension（quantity/notional、parent/OCA/protection、session/venue、native request identity）并绑定自己的 `Prepared/NativeAck/Observation/Recovery/Compensation` schemas；没有 provider evidence 的 bracket/idempotency/atomicity 不进入 common guarantee。

controlled effect 状态严格区分 `Prepared -> AdmissionAccepted -> DispatchStarted -> Ack(working|rejected) -> Observation(fill|cancel|replacement|exposure) -> Terminal/Recovery`；Ack 不是 Fill，direct native request 也必须标记 ExternalStimulus 与 provenance。

provider-native values 使用 exact Decimal/presence/sentinel schemas：Hyperliquid stablecoin conversion 需 account-mode policy；OKX spot/perp namespace/dust/account errors；IBKR conId/TWS quote and optional history；Alpaca leg identity；Bybit trigger/TP/SL identity。
preservedContract: 保留 Alpaca UUID/order states/attached legs、Bybit conditional trigger and TPSL parameters、Hyperliquid Pyth/USDC/minimum-notional context、OKX spot/perp/cash/dust behavior、IBKR conId/TWS/session/protection differences。
保留 operation-owned delta cleanup、partial close、cancel、position and order observations、unknown native outcomes 与 provider raw diagnostics 的证据价值。
保留 direct provider E2E as external observation/probe where needed, but no longer let casts/raw exchange become Alice API or authorization path。
selectedChanges: 将 native effects 声明为 provider capability leaves，catalog 仅在 required fields/capability evidence/permission present 时暴露；unsupported branches absent，不返回 universal Unsupported method。
所有 quantity/price/FX/protection values 在 Prepare 时 freeze exact encoded form；Number/rounding、currency normalization、dust threshold、sentinel decoding 属 provider policy/evidence，不在 common core 默认。
S7 等 direct external provider actions 显式标记 `ExternalStimulus`，由 UTA observation/takeover/cancel 管理，不能伪装为 UTA DispatchStarted。
DispatchStarted 后 ack/fill/query/cleanup failure 均保留 attempt/native identity；未知不允许 scheduler/HTTP retry 重新生成 request。

effectAndStateOwnership.UTAWriter: 准备和授权 exact plan，记录 dispatch/receipt/unknown/recovery、reservation 与 operation-owned cleanup policy。
effectAndStateOwnership.ProviderAdapter: 执行 native request、解码 ack/observation/domain failure、提供 capability/sentinel/account-mode evidence。
effectAndStateOwnership.LiveHarness: 调用 descriptor-bound controlled leaves，观察 provider/account state，执行独立 cleanup 并记录证据。
effectAndStateOwnership.ExternalActor: direct exchange/native stimulus 具独立 actor/provenance/native id；UTA 只可 observe/takeover/cancel，不重写发生过的事实。

failuresAndRecovery: 未映射 provider code、missing trigger/native identity、native sentinel ambiguity、quote timeout、account mode refusal、currency policy unavailable 都是 typed unavailable/unknown/recovery，不是 passing skip。
Bracket confirmation 要求 declared capability + parent-linked leg observation；trigger takeover/cancel 在 cache invalidation 后无 stable identity 时阻止并保留 Unknown。
Hyperliquid Ack 不证明 fill/latency；OKX 51010 只能按 observed account-mode evidence 分类，其他 code remains rejection/Unknown；IBKR TWS timeout 不满足 FreshQuote。
cleanup 只处理 operation-owned delta，ResidualPolicy 未知时保留 residual/RecoveryRequired；不得 universal dust percentage。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: E2E 已观察 provider-specific order/position/quote/close/cancel/TPSL/spot-perp behaviors；源码未证明所有 account modes、pagination、native identity persistence、latency/finality 或 concurrent cleanup。
Live question closures 保留 Bybit legs/trigger identity、Hyperliquid latency/currency、OKX dust/error/namespace、IBKR TWS timeout 等 requires-provider-evidence 分支。
这些 acceptance observations 只能证明对应 provider/account/revision；不能扩张为 kernel-wide native guarantees。
migrationCutover: 将每个 provider E2E direct call 替换为 descriptor-bound read/control leaf，native diagnostic 留在 provider evidence adapter；保留 source-native request/response in sealed execution/audit projections。
为 protection, trigger, currency, sentinel, market-data freshness, account-mode and cleanup policies 增加 versioned schemas/evidence; 未知保持 unavailable/recovery。
实现 DispatchStarted/ack/observation/recovery protocol 与 operation-owned cleanup；在 live acceptance 完整执行前不得宣称 controlled effect 已完成。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: Live evidence sink：运行 provenance、redaction 与外部诊断
currentBehavior: live-paper-evidence 定义 compact ContractEvidence/LivePaperEvidence，使用 wall-clock/pid/env runId、git commit、paper=true、broker=ibkr，并把 native Contract fields 写入 ignored JSONL。
recordLivePaperEvidence 直接 append JSON.stringify；未定义 concurrent sequence/idempotence/conflict、schema version、redaction limits 或 final sink failure semantics。
raw CCXT diagnostic 打印 normalized order fields、raw info、open/closed order、spot/perp market IDs、symbol/id、since filter 与 best-effort close；这些是外部 evidence，不是受控 authority。
abstractExpression: `EvidenceEnvelope` 固定 run/session/task/correlation、provider instance/account/environment/readiness epoch、capability/revision/schema digest、phase、source/native identity、operation/effect provenance、selected input/derived/ack/observation references、coverage与timestamp。

`EvidenceSink.append(runKey, sequence, digest, redactedRecord) -> Result<Receipt, Conflict|Unavailable>`：同 sequence+same digest 幂等，same sequence+different payload 冲突；并发 allocation/ordering 是 sink contract，不由普通 JSONL append 假定。
Audit projection 与 sealed execution/replay bytes 使用不同 schema/permissions；diagnostics 只存 bounded metadata，secret/credential/raw body/native message 不跨 descriptor 或 evidence boundary。
preservedContract: 保留 paper/live/testnet environment、provider/account identity、native Contract conId/symbol/localSymbol/type/exchange/currency、runId、git commit、phase、ack/observation 与 diagnostic provenance。
保留 raw provider response 作为受限 provider evidence（必要时 sealed/privileged），但普通 Alice/HTTP/AI view 仅看 redacted bounded projection。
保留 ignored/local evidence sink 与 per-run artifacts；其存在不改变 authoritative journal state 或 grant dispatch permission。
selectedChanges: 所有 evidence record 用 construction-bound schema/version/digest 写入；record 只引用或密封 exact payload，不将 Number-normalized/raw secret data 当作普遍语义。
为 sink 增加 per-run/owner sequence allocation、idempotent same-digest、divergent conflict、atomic append/manifest 与 incomplete run state；并发 ordering 未证实时 evidence projection unavailable。
按 本 accommodation 限制 ProtocolViolation diagnostics：identity/phase/status/content-type/byte-count/最多16 issue code/path、path≤128、JSON≤4096、truncation；禁止 raw body/params/headers/native error/raw digest。
direct provider probe 记录 `ExternalStimulus` actor/provenance/native id，和 UTA controlled attempt 分开，防止 diagnostic output 冒充 UTA receipt。

effectAndStateOwnership.EvidenceSink: 写入 per-run evidence/sequence/conflict state并返回 sink receipt；不变更 UTA decision/effect state。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTAJournal: 保存 authoritative command/attempt/selected evidence/minimal predicate checkpoint；只在 writer transaction 中更新。
effectAndStateOwnership.Alice/HTTP/AI: 读取 redacted projection、correlation与provenance；不得读取/重放 sealed secret-bearing payload。
effectAndStateOwnership.ProviderDiagnostic: 提供 raw/native observation evidence；不能成为公共 schema 或 authority。

failuresAndRecovery: sink unavailable/conflict/corrupt sequence 使 evidence projection failed/unavailable，不把 record 当作 effect success；authoritative JournalWriter 状态保持原 verdict。
partial run、process crash、broken pipe 标记 evidence incomplete；不能承诺 final output frame 已写入。
redaction/schema validation failure 是 ProtocolViolation/RedactionFailure；不得 fallback raw text 或 raw-body digest。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: 当前 source 只证明 compact interfaces、native field copy、JSONL append 与 raw diagnostic logging；不证明 concurrent ordering、idempotence、redaction enforcement、provider completeness。
C2F022975E closure 明确要求 sequence/conflict concurrency evidence；Bybit/Hyperliquid/OKX/IBKR closures 保留各自 native unknown。
本节不把 test artifact、git commit 或 `paper:true` 当作真实环境/账户/cleanup 的充分证明。
migrationCutover: 定义 EvidenceEnvelope、sealed payload reference、redacted view 与 sink receipt schema，迁移 live-paper-evidence 与 raw diagnostics。
实现 per-run concurrent sequence/conflict handling，再把 sink result 接到 acceptance gate；sink failure 不修改 UTA authoritative outcome。
将 evidence references 接入 descriptor-bound observation/RecoveryCase 与 HTTP/AI projections，删除 unbounded logging/raw JSON fallback。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: Live harness simulation：Mock immediate/deferred 与真实状态边界
currentBehavior: Mock E2E 每 test fresh broker、quotes/cash，覆盖 immediate market push、deferred pending fill、external fill、partial/full close、cancel、reverse history、TPSL spy 与 precise fractional quantities。
模拟路径可以直接在内存 MockBroker 变更 position/cash/order state，再由 UTA sync/query 观察；测试通过 source-level spies/casts 验证参数传递。
live-paper docs 将模拟/纸面 acceptance 与 live provider cleanup 并列描述，但当前模拟成功不提供 venue latency/finality/idempotence 证据。

保留 simulation round/state generation、sync/reconcile 与 operation-owned cleanup checks；保留 test fixture 的 deterministic setup。
保留 simulated read-only review/controlled path，但避免将 in-memory state 当作 persisted durable recovery。
selectedChanges: 将 Mock test controls 与 Live harness 分离；每个 simulation run 绑定 explicit instance/scope/generation/sequence 和 descriptor digest。

effectAndStateOwnership.MockBroker: 拥有模拟撮合、wallet/position/order state 与 stimulus application。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTA: 拥有 scoped controlled plan/decision journal、deferred activation/checkpoint 与 query projection。
effectAndStateOwnership.Harness: 拥有 deterministic setup/stimulus/evidence/cleanup orchestration；不拥有生产 credentials 或 live authority。

failuresAndRecovery: Deferred pending after process restart 若没有 durable state 只返回 RecoveryRequired/fixture unavailable；不能从空 Mock state 推断 order gone。
External fill/withdraw/trade 必须有 actor/provenance/sequence；unknown observation 不由 in-memory snapshot 强制结案。
simulation stream cancellation/resource release 不取消 durable wait 或 live effect。
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: Mock tests/E2E 已观察 exact lifecycle and precision transitions；这些是 host behavior specimens，非 live venue proof。
docs/uta-live-testing S1-S14 acceptance 约束 future runtime gate；本 wave 未执行这些 live/runtime checks。
migrationCutover: 把现有 Mock E2E 输入/预期翻成 simulation descriptor fixtures 与 typed stimulus/observation records。

sections.category: 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收
sections.title: Live/paper acceptance：S1–S14 作为未来 implementation gate
currentBehavior: 文档定义 S1–S14：read-state/identity、order lifecycle、hanger/recovery、amendment、attached TP/SL、standalone stop、external S7、restart、partial close、notional/units、error ergonomics、staging undo、hub/leaf、derivative signs/units。

abstractExpression: 每个 acceptance scenario 是 `ScenarioManifest`：provider/account/environment selector、required descriptor/capability digest、preconditions、baseline identity/snapshot、typed operations、evidence obligations、operation-owned cleanup policy、final-baseline predicate。
验证顺序为 admission→baseline→prepare/approve/dispatch→ack/observation/recovery→cleanup→final baseline/evidence；scenario 的 pass predicate 不能由日志/skip/数量计数替代。
cleanup 与 effect policy 绑定 operation-owned delta、ResidualPolicy、provider/account threshold/evidence；未知 sent/venue state 保持 RecoveryRequired，不被 harness stop 或 test timeout 取消。
preservedContract: 保留 S1–S14 每项具体字段、顺序、fatal/optional distinction、provider-native identities、unit/sign/currency/precision、read-only and staged undo expectations。
保留 isolated-paper cleanup：只回收本次 operation-owned exposure/delta，记录 provider/account residual policy，完成后再次读取 baseline；不使用 universal dust/percentage。
保留 direct external stimulus、hub/leaf parent linkage、restart/recovery、error ergonomics 和 evidence sink requirements。
selectedChanges: 把每个 scenario 的 preconditions 和 required capability evidence 写入 typed manifest；没有 descriptor admission、scope/auth/readiness 或 provider evidence 时显式 unavailable，而非 skip-pass。
将 scenario operations 统一到 descriptor-bound query/control/deferred leaves；direct native probe 仅是 ExternalStimulus evidence，必须进入 UTA observation/takeover path。
为每次 run 建立 before/after baseline、dispatch/ack/fill/cancel/cleanup evidence；cleanup failure、unknown、sink conflict 都阻止 green acceptance。
将 S5/S7/S13 等特殊 gate 写入 provider/account policy；不把 single abstract branch 扩张到未声明的 legs, trigger identity, account mode or native history。

effectAndStateOwnership.ScenarioRunner: 执行 manifest、观测/记录 evidence、触发 cleanup；不解释 authority 或重试 unknown send。
effectAndStateOwnership.UTA: 执行 auth/scope/admission/writer/controlled/deferred/recovery；拥有 durable activation/outbox/attempt identity。
effectAndStateOwnership.Provider: 提供 declared capability/native evidence/observation/finality and residual policy。
effectAndStateOwnership.EvidenceSink: 保证 run evidence schema/sequence/conflict；不替代 final state or journal authority。

failuresAndRecovery: precondition fail、capability unavailable、scope/auth fail、provider mode refusal、quote timeout、missing legs/identity、sink unavailable、cleanup residual unknown 都是 explicit failure/unavailable，不是 skip-pass。
process restart/response loss after DispatchStarted leads observation/recovery; no reprepare/no blind resend; before-start no-start plan may be retired and a fresh approved revision prepared。
final baseline requires no unresolved owned exposure or explicit durable recovery owner; provider/account residual beyond policy leaves scenario blocked.
empiricalEvidenceBoundary: S1–S14 是 repository acceptance obligations；本 wave 未启动 Web/HTTP/live runtime，也没有把 restored source tests 当成执行证据。
live question closures retain provider-specific empirical requirements for Bybit, Hyperliquid, OKX, IBKR and concurrent evidence sink ordering。
未来 runtime verification 必须报告实际 environment/account/provider/revision, observed outputs, downstream state and evidence artifacts; no count/score substitutes.
migrationCutover: 逐项将 S1–S14 转为 typed ScenarioManifest + descriptor/capability preconditions，明确 gate failure/unavailable/recovery semantics。
加入 isolated-paper operation ledger, baseline/final-state queries, evidence sink sequence/conflict and provider/account residual policies。
只有真实 runner 完整执行 admission→operation→observation→cleanup→baseline 并保留 artifacts 后，才可将对应 scenario 标为 accepted；当前 artifact 只完成设计 accommodation。

bindings.rationale: 旧字段/行为：Every test enters through the real UTA constructor and treats TradingGit staging plus SDK Operation as the observable seam.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Retain the vertical intent of constructing a real account around a mock interpreter.；迁移后果：Replace createUTA with a harness that opens a file-backed SQLite/journal fixture and an explicit MockBroker layer; reopen the same fixture for crash/restart scenarios.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1-23。
