旧字段/行为：Single implicit broker stages without a selector; a warmed multi-wallet broker refuses missing/unknown/wrong selectors and appends [sub:spot] to a commit message, then clears the tracker between cycles.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；保留后果：Retain caller convenience when discovery proves exactly one wallet by resolving it to an explicit sub-account id; preserve instrument-consistency refusal and cycle isolation.；迁移后果：Persist SubAccountRef discovery with connection identity and freshness.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:85-153。

questions.question: Whether each venue satisfies realtime historical quality is unavailable from this static/gated test; require recorded source observations before stronger advertising.
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：Capabilities are available pre-init and account-wide; they do not vary by instrument/catalog, wallet scope, sandbox/demo, credential authority or runtime health. The method advertises no TP/SL/trailing/TIF/relation/future/option support.；本节关系：把 quote、bars、funding、orderbook、clock 与 capability observation 作为独立 finite Pull leaf，保留 source/observed time、asOf、精确数值与 Coverage 三值；unknown value/quality 是 payload/reason，普通 live read 不写 full-feed WAL。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep exact static compatibility arrays and historicalBars shape at the edge.；Keep unsupported trailing/options/futures/attachments/relations as explicit refusals.；Do not present e2e/static labels as runtime proof.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Static capability output is compatibility metadata only, while the host contract require scope/environment/availability evidence and keep historical quality independent of write capability.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Keep static/pre-init/e2e historical quality as HistoricalQuality.Unknown internally and expose the existing shape only as compatibility metadata for the public data leaf. A recorded observation must bind venue, endpoint, public data context (or an explicitly declared account context), instrument, interval, source timestamps, observedAt, and freshness criteria before HistoricalQuality.Proven can satisfy a stronger quality or finality gate; static arrays never become write permission or a global action map.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1290-1296 returns static CRYPTO/CRYPTO_PERP, MKT/LMT, and historicalBars=realtime, while CcxtBroker.spec.ts:1679-1688 checks only the static arrays and does not observe venue quality. Composition contract K11-K12 require runtime evidence before advertising native/finality guarantees.

questions.question: 各 venue 的 native market id 是否稳定且与 unified symbol 是否一一对应需按连接 conformance 采样；在未证明前 catalog 只接受明确 identity evidence。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：测试 helper 允许 Partial<CcxtMarket>，把 id 默认成 symbol、active 默认 true，再直接把对象交给三个 translator；测试没有 native response 解码、连接 identity 或 AccountScope。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 保留 spot、swap、future、option translator fixture 的覆盖意图和 exact native symbol 断言。；改变只在边界：malformed/unknown 输入显式失败，且 native id、symbol 与 AccountScope 不再被 fixture cast 隐式混合。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：fixture 以 Partial<CcxtMarket> 强转是本条的核心风险；目标改为 provider market leaf 的声明源与边界解码，同时保留 native identity 证据，不要求全局 broker 类型。；闭环处置：保留该连接 conformance 前置条件。未取得指定 venue、environment、SDK version 的样本与重复观察证据前，provider market leaf 只接受明确 nativeId/nativeSymbol identity evidence；InstrumentId 不因 display/unified symbol 被证明而生成稳定性保证。缺稳定性证据时该 market 可作为带 evidence 的查询事实，但依赖稳定 native identity 的 action/lookup leaf 保持 unavailable；不得跨 venue 猜测、重写或合并 key。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.spec.ts:1-24 的 makeMarket 将 id 默认成 symbol、active 默认成 true，并以 Partial<CcxtMarket> 强转；ccxt-contracts.ts:55-111 只消费传入的 market row，未提供任何真实 venue id 稳定性或 id↔symbol 一一对应证明。Catalog/CcxtCore 设计也把 native key 保留为 venue-specific evidence，而非从统一 symbol 推导的事实。

questions.question: 各 venue 对 option/future 的 expiry 与 contractSize 是否始终提供需在对应 broker conformance 中实测；未有证据时该 market capability 保持 unavailable。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：测试把 CCXT unified symbol 放进 Contract.localSymbol，断言 spot 为 CRYPTO、swap 为 CRYPTO_PERP，并验证 USDT/USDC settlement 区分；future 的毫秒 expiry 转 UTC YYYYMMDD，contractSize 转 multiplier。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 USDT 与 USDC 结算的 perp 必须仍是两个不同 InstrumentId。；future expiry 仍按 UTC 日生成，contractSize 仍影响 multiplier；新模型把这些变成有单位的值而不是 Contract 字段。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：source 断言的 settlement、UTC expiry 与 multiplier 仍是有价值的市场事实，但 IBKR Contract 投影应改成可组合 Instrument metadata leaf，避免把账户或 SDK 类别当统一 authority。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue conformance。Future/Option 行必须分别取得 expiry、contractSize（以及 Option 的 strike/right）和版本化 native evidence；未取得时返回 MissingDerivativeMetadata/CapabilityUnavailable，保存已知 market identity 但不生成可交易 derivative Instrument，不把旧的 multiplier='1' fallback 当事实。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.spec.ts:26-77 只用带 expiry/contractSize 的 fixture 验证 future，ccxt-contracts.ts:77-108 通过 unknown cast 读取字段，并在缺 contractSize 时写入 multiplier='1'；这些 source facts 不覆盖各 venue 的真实字段可用性。

questions.question: CCXT 4.5.38 各 exchange 实际返回的 type vocabulary 需在 native response conformance 中采样；未采样值都应走 Unknown。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：测试只固定四个已知 type 映射为 CRYPTO、CRYPTO_PERP、FUT、OPT；没有断言 unknown type 的行为，而实现对未知值默认返回 CRYPTO。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 四个已知 CCXT type 的现有映射保持不变。；未知值由旧的宽松默认改为显式拒绝，这是为防止错误分类而不是扩大或收缩已知能力。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：unknown type 被旧 switch 默认成 CRYPTO；provider schema 只声明已采样映射并保留未知 native extension，避免制造一个封闭的全局市场枚举。；闭环处置：保留 native vocabulary 采样。provider market leaf 对未采样、空或新增 type 产生 UnknownMarketKind(rawType,path)/NativeProtocolViolation，不生成 CRYPTO Instrument；只有带 exchange、SDK version 和 payload evidence 的明确映射才能扩展该 provider leaf 的 semantic projection 与 availability。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.ts:24-32 仅定义 spot/swap/future/option 四个 switch 分支，default 返回 CRYPTO；ccxt-contracts.spec.ts:105-112 只覆盖四个已知字符串，没有真实 CCXT 4.5.38 各 exchange response vocabulary 样本。

questions.question: 各 CCXT venue 的 timeframes 在 sandbox/live 与 SDK version 间差异需连接层启动时实测并纳入 capability fingerprint。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：CCXT_TIMEFRAME 是覆盖 1m、5m、15m、30m、1h、4h、1d、1w 的静态 Record；注释要求调用时再与 exchange.timeframes 校验，但该校验不在此纯表中。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 现有八个 normalized interval 的 token 保留。；每个 venue 仍可按自身 timeframes 过滤；不会因 target codec 而假设统一支持。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：八个 timeframe token 与按 exchange.timeframes 校验的证据边界可保留；重写只把它作为 provider data leaf 的 availability，不把静态表当跨 venue 保证。；闭环处置：保留启动 conformance。连接层必须以 venue、environment、SDK version、exchange.timeframes 快照构造 VenueTimeframeCapability 并纳入 fingerprint；证据缺失或 interval 不在已确认集合时返回 UnsupportedInterval，不能向同一 native endpoint 重试并把 SDK rejection 当普通 transport success。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.ts:14-22 的 CCXT_TIMEFRAME 只是八个 normalized token table，并明确注释 support varies per exchange；它没有 sandbox/live、SDK version 或启动时 exchange.timeframes 的实测结果。

questions.question: 各 venue 的完整 status vocabulary、closed 与 fill 的最终一致性语义和 order-id retention horizon 需由 broker conformance 实测后纳入 capability。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：ccxtTypeToSecType 对未知 market type 返回 CRYPTO；mapOrderStatus 将 closed/open/canceled/cancelled/expired/rejected 分别映射到 Filled/Submitted/Cancelled/Inactive，其余（含 undefined）也映射 Submitted；makeOrderState 只写 legacy `OrderState.status`。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 closed/open/canceled/cancelled/expired/rejected 的已知语义继续可见，但由 typed status 与 fill evidence 表达。；OrderState 作为旧边界的 view 可以暂时由 target OrderObservation 映射生成，不能再作为 authority。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：legacy status/fill 映射属于订单效果的观察语义，必须脱离 IBKR-shaped status；target 保留 effect outcome/WAL 纪律，同时允许每个 provider 扩展 native status。；闭环处置：保留 broker conformance。未确认 status/finality/retention 前，OrderObservation 使用 Unknown 与独立 filled/remaining evidence；Ack 或 closed 字样不能单独产生 Filled，DispatchStarted 后的未知结果进入 Observe/Reconciliation/RecoveryRequired，不能依据未知 retention horizon 盲重发或把查无订单当未执行。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.ts:36-45 的 mapOrderStatus 把 closed 直接映射 Filled、未知/undefined 映射 Submitted，且 expired/rejected 压成 Inactive；source 没有各 venue 状态全集、closed/fill 最终一致性或订单保留时长证据。

questions.question: CCXT markets 对各衍生类型的 contractSize/expiry 可用性需逐 venue 实测；缺证据的市场 capability 必须保持 unavailable。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：marketToContract 读取 market.base/quote/type/settle，把 unified symbol 写到 localSymbol；通过 unknown cast 取 expiry/contractSize/strike/optionType，FUT/OPT 的 expiry 转 UTC，contractSize 缺失时 multiplier fallback 为 `'1'`，最后调用 buildContract/assertContract。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 wire symbol 的唯一性、settlement 后缀、UTC expiry 日和 contractSize 语义保留。；现有 buildContract 的 universal/per-secType validation 目的保留，但由 domain constructor 在更早边界承担。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：unknown cast 与 multiplier=1 fallback 是 derivative decoder 缺陷；目标用 provider schema/HOF 构造有条件的 Instrument，不把 translator 分支变成通用 action model。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue 字段 conformance。Native decoder 先校验完整 derivative metadata；缺 contractSize/expiry 的 Future/Option 保留 raw-safe evidence 并返回 MissingDerivativeMetadata/CapabilityUnavailable，不生成半成品 Instrument、不使用 multiplier='1'，也不由 translator 分支推导新的 FOP capability。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.ts:55-111 对 expiry、contractSize、strike、optionType 使用 unknown cast，且缺 contractSize 时 multiplier fallback 为 '1'；ccxt-contracts.spec.ts 的 derivative fixture 不能证明各 venue 的覆盖率或可靠性。

questions.question: quote preference 是否适合所有交易辖区需要产品/venue policy 决策；在未决定前只能由调用方显式提供。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：resolveContractSync 把 query.symbol 大写作 base，遍历 markets，跳过 active=false 或缺 base/quote 的 row，按映射后的 secType 与可选 currency 过滤；currency 缺失时只接受 USDT/USD/USDC，并返回裸 symbol 数组。独立的 CcxtBroker.searchContracts 还按 active/base/quote、swap>future>spot>option、USDT>USD>USDC 与 exact/fuzzy rank 组织搜索结果，并写入 derivativeSecTypes。；本节关系：把 venue market vocabulary、native key、canonical symbol、derivative metadata、timeframe 与 quote policy 放入 provider-bound schema slot；不从 candidate docs 盲继承 enum，未知/缺字段显式不可用而不默认成另一 kind。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 inactive rows 与缺 base/quote 的 skeletal rows 继续不可作为候选。；旧 USDT/USD/USDC preference 只能在调用方显式选择匹配的 VersionedVenuePolicy 时用于搜索/展示；默认 ExplicitOnly，不成为 universal currency allowlist 或执行选择。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：USDT/USD/USDC 偏好是当前 resolver 的 presentation policy；保留 ExplicitOnly/VersionedVenuePolicy 决策，并把排序放在声明的 capability leaf 中而非 universal currency rule。；闭环处置：采用具名 `QuoteSelectionPolicy = ExplicitOnly | VersionedVenuePolicy(policyId)`。默认且无须额外配置的是 ExplicitOnly：quote/settlement 候选不唯一时返回 Ambiguous；只有调用方明示、且 policyId 与 venue/catalog version evidence 匹配的 VersionedVenuePolicy 才能排序候选。旧 USDT/USD/USDC preference 不再由 resolver 隐式补入，也不授予 dispatch。；边界证据：ccxt-contracts.ts:146-180 的 resolveContractSync 在缺 currency 时隐式只选 USDT/USD/USDC；CcxtVenues 现有 target 已要求显式 quote/settlement policy，Catalog sibling design 也把 quote preference 定位为版本化 query policy 而非 universal currency rule。

questions.question: 各 CCXT venue 的 order-book timestamp/sequence 可靠性需实测，sequence 缺失时 freshness policy 必须降低而不能伪造连续性。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：order-book 工具测试通过 `aliceId` 调用 UTA.contractFromAliceId，再 spy broker.getOrderBook；成功结果只检查 localSymbol、source 与 bids 长度，错误通过 result.error 的字符串正则判断。；本节关系：把 AI tool、funding 与 orderbook 分成独立 declared data leaf，保留 aliceId/source route 与 exact depth/parameter；输入输出和 failure 在边界解码，缺少另一方法不隐藏本 leaf。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 保留 aliceId/native-key 解析后的目标 instrument 与 source 字段。；保留 bid/ask level 的结果语义与 limit 约束；新增的 freshness/authorization 是安全 envelope，不改变合法数据。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：订单簿是数据读取能力而非交易 action；保留 depth、level、freshness 与 public/private 分离，并将错误交给独立 query leaf。；闭环处置：保留 order-book conformance。Native decoder 必须保留 provider timestamp/sequence 的 presence、source 和 asOf；sequence 缺失或未验证时只允许显式 degraded freshness，不能伪造连续性、把 local now 当 observedAt，或让 partial/stale book 满足交易 precondition。；边界证据：ccxt-tools.spec.ts:71-127 的 order-book fixture 只断言 bids/source/localSymbol；CcxtBroker.ts:1330-1375 在缺 timestamp 时使用 Date.now，source 没有各 venue timestamp/sequence 可靠性的证据。

questions.question: funding rate 的 native precision/settlement timestamp reliability 需按 venue conformance 确认。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：funding 工具测试只断言 aliceId 解析后得到 source 与数值；实现的 broker view 还会把缺失 fundingRate 变成 0、缺 timestamp 变成当前时间，next/previous 时间与 scope/freshness 未在 tool contract 验证。；本节关系：把 AI tool、funding 与 orderbook 分成独立 declared data leaf，保留 aliceId/source route 与 exact depth/parameter；输入输出和 failure 在边界解码，缺少另一方法不隐藏本 leaf。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 保留 fundingRate、optional previousFundingRate/nextFundingTime 和 source 的信息语义；缺 optional next/previous 仍可表示 absent。；保留 native account/instrument hint 的入口意图，但 adapter 不向 tool 暴露 Contract 或无证据的 timestamp/rate defaults。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：funding rate 的 precision/timestamp 仍必须实证；该条改为 provider data schema 与 availability 证据，不扩散订单审批或补偿状态。；闭环处置：保留 funding conformance。只有经过 venue/version schema 与 precision/timestamp evidence 校验的有限 Decimal rate 才能成为 FundingObservation；缺 rate/time 或可靠性未确认时返回 FundingPayloadInvalid/FundingUnavailable，freshness 降级且不填 0/now。；边界证据：ccxt-tools.spec.ts:129-150 只检查 fundingRate 数字/source；CcxtBroker.ts:1330-1351 将缺 fundingRate 变成 0、缺 timestamp 变成 Date.now，未证明各 venue precision 或 settlement timestamp 可靠性。

questions.question: funding rate 的 native precision/settlement timestamp reliability 需按 venue conformance 固定；未确认时 freshness 降级。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：getFundingRate 只用 Zod 检查 aliceId/source 字符串，解析 legacy Contract；解析异常被转成 `{error: message}`，broker rejection 不在 try/catch 中而直接逸出，成功结果以 source 加 raw broker fields spread 返回。；本节关系：把 AI tool、funding 与 orderbook 分成独立 declared data leaf，保留 aliceId/source route 与 exact depth/parameter；输入输出和 failure 在边界解码，缺少另一方法不隐藏本 leaf。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 仍支持 `accountId|nativeKey` 形式的来源提示，并返回来源标识。；仍保留 next/previous funding fields；不再把缺字段默认为无证据的成功值。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：tool 当前只捕获 selector 错误并让 broker rejection 逸出；目标让 funding leaf 拥有精确 input/output/error schema，保留 keyless public route 的独立 availability。；闭环处置：保留该 native reliability 前置条件，并沿用 A023 的安全规则：tool 通过 typed FundingObservation/QueryFailure 暴露 provider precision、observedAt、source 和 freshness；未确认的 precision/timestamp 只能返回 degraded/Unavailable，禁止合成 rate、now 或把 broker rejection 作为成功响应。；边界证据：ccxt-tools.ts:41-66 只解码 aliceId/source、调用 broker.getFundingRate 并 spread raw result；同一 source path 没有 precision、settlement timestamp 或各 venue reliability evidence，且 rejection 可逸出 tool。

questions.question: 各 venue 的 depth limit、序列号与 timestamp freshness 需实测后进入 capability；不支持的深度返回 UnsupportedDepth。

questions.question: Bybit 各 path 的错误码与 definitive absence payload、订单 retention horizon 需真实 conformance 固定。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：Bybit override 依次调用 fetchOpenOrder(id,symbol)、同 endpoint 加 stop:true、fetchClosedOrder、同 endpoint 加 stop:true；每次 catch 所有异常，最终以 generic `Order ... not found` 结束。；本节关系：把 Bybit category listing 与四 path order lookup 作为 provider-local leaves，显式记录 category/path/stop 参数、顺序、dedupe 与覆盖；单 category/path 的成功或缺失不升级为全局 absence。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 四路 endpoint 顺序与 conditional `stop:true` 参数保留。；找到任一路 order 即返回，不因其他路径不可达而覆盖 Found。；generic not-found 改为有证据的 NotFound，避免扩大 not-found 语义。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：四路 lookup 顺序和 stop:true 是 Bybit-native lookup behavior；target 保留它并把每路错误/absence 留在 provider leaf，不能用 catch-all not-found。；闭环处置：保留四路 conformance。每个 path 只有明确 absence payload 才是 DefinitiveAbsent；permission、timeout、schema error 或 retention 不明时保留 Rejected/TransportUnknown/ProtocolViolation，并让 requested ID 返回 Unavailable/Unknown。只有四路均有明确 absence evidence 才构造 NotFoundWithEvidence，不能把 catch-all 或 mutation outcome 互相替代。；边界证据：bybit.ts:1-31 依次调用 open regular、open conditional、closed regular、closed conditional 并 catch 所有异常为 generic not-found；source 没有每路 error code、definitive absence payload 或 retention horizon evidence。

questions.question: broker pack 的 SDK version compatibility/runtime loading policy 需与最终 package boundary 一起锁定。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：registry module 以注释约定 defaultImpl + per-exchange override，顶层 import Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid objects；所有扩展通过同一 legacy CcxtBroker registry 组合。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 default-plus-override 的扩展意图和 Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid 独立模块保留，但每个差异变成具名 typed handler。；未覆盖方法只有在 capability 明确声明默认语义时才可用，不能把 raw fallback 当 universal support。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：registry/pack loading 是 composition boundary，不应以 override object 或完整 handler 集合推断能力；target 只加载 declared provider leaves 并保留 manifest/version evidence。；闭环处置：采用已收敛的 `BrokerPackLoadingPolicy = InstalledImmutableRelease | ExplicitWorkspaceDev | PackLoadFailure`。production 只从 manifest-bound installed immutable pack 加载，workspace source 仅在显式 dev policy 下允许，broken release 不 fallback；manifest 校验 API/engine/package/locked CCXT version，加载失败保持 provider leaves unavailable。Prepared effect plans 绑定 pack manifest/content/version evidence，普通 data leaves 不因此获得交易能力。；边界证据：packages/uta-broker-ccxt/package.json:2-22 将 CCXT broker pack 作为 private ESM package 并声明 ccxt ^4.5.38；pnpm-lock.yaml:316-318,2501-2503 将当前 workspace resolution 固定为 4.5.38，提供当前 source version baseline 但不提供 native venue guarantees。Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K01-K03,K07-K08` 的 capability-leaf/pack boundary 与 MAP-5CC2CA6EF1 的目标字段是当前设计证据，不引用会变化的 sibling design 行号。

questions.question: 每个 CCXT venue 的 native idempotency/compensation/attached-order evidence 需逐项 conformance；未证实 handler 维持 unavailable。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：CcxtExchangeOverrides 是 optional method bag；hooks 接收 raw Exchange、string/number 与 Record params，返回 raw CCXT orders/positions/balances；strict flags、walletTypes 与 TP/SL support 都是 optional fields。defaultImpl convention 允许修改输入、后处理结果或完全替换。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 各 venue 仍可覆盖实际差异 method；Bitget namespaces、Bybit category/path、TP/SL refusal 与 raw default intent 保留为具名 handlers。；完整订单语义 的 notional, TRAIL LIMIT/offset/initial stop, GTD/session, parent/OCA, attached TP/SL 等不得静默丢弃；无 native evidence 维持 CapabilityUnavailable。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：raw hook bag 混淆了 optional extension、读取和写入；target 改成开放的 provider capability tree，叶子各自声明 schema/error/availability，交易包装仅包写效果。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue capability-leaf conformance。每个 provider-declared action/attachment/compensation leaf 只有 documented native evidence 才可标记 Available；未声明的 action/parameter variant 在该 leaf schema 中不存在且没有 command，已声明 leaf 未证实时才保持 CapabilityUnavailable。用户语义字段在已接受 schema 中不能静默丢失；DispatchStarted 后 Unknown 只能 Observe/RecoveryRequired，不由 optional hook 自动 compensation 或第二次 mutation。；边界证据：overrides.ts:31-144 是 optional raw hook bag，虽含 attached TP/SL、cancel/place/list hooks，却没有每个 venue/version 的 native idempotency、compensation 或 attached-order proof；存在 hook 不等于 capability。

questions.question: 各 exchange regular/conditional endpoint 的 absence/error distinction 与 lookup retention 需实测；没有证据时保守为 Unknown。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：defaultFetchBalance(params undefined) 调用 unscoped `exchange.fetchBalance()`，有 params 才原样传递；defaultFetchOrderById 先 regular fetchOrder，再 catch 后若 symbol 存在以 `stop:true` 再试，任一路失败都抛 generic `Order ... not found`。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 已证明 unified account 的 unscoped balance compatibility 可保留；separate wallet route 必须显式。；regular -> conditional `stop:true` 顺序可在具体 venue capability 证明后保留，不是 CCXT universal guarantee。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：default balance 与 lookup 的 fallback 规则必须按 operation 和 venue evidence 选择；target 分离 data observation leaf 与 effect recovery，不把 unscoped/raw helper 变成 universal policy。；闭环处置：保留 per-exchange lookup conformance。每一路仅在 definitive absence evidence 下构造 DefinitiveAbsent；permission/transport/schema/retention 未知时保持 Unknown/Unavailable，持久化 path evidence 与 lookup descriptor，不把 regular failure 自动解释为 conditional absence。；边界证据：overrides.ts:146-167 的 defaultFetchOrderById 先 regular 后 stop:true，并 catch 任意异常再抛 generic not-found；source 没有各 exchange 的 error/absence payload precedence 或 order retention evidence。

questions.question: 各 CCXT venue 如何证明 cancel endpoint unsupported-before-send 与 idempotency horizon 需 live evidence。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：取消先调用 cancelOrder(id,symbol)，捕获任意错误后若有 symbol 再调用 stop:true；fallback 成功即返回，否则抛出第一次错误。没有记录两次尝试的 dispatch identity 或远端状态。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 regular cancel 与 conditional stop:true endpoint 的 venue-specific possibility 保留。；cancel成功仍只表示请求处理，不宣称订单已撤；target 增加观察闭环。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：regular 到 conditional cancel fallback 的 dispatch uncertainty 是交易效果问题；保留 WAL/observe-before-retry，只在 provider capability leaf 证明 unsupported-before-send 时 fallback。；闭环处置：保留 live cancel conformance。只有明确 unsupported-before-send 且 conditional semantics/idempotency 安全的 evidence 才允许 fallback；timeout、request-start 或 horizon 未知时记录 DispatchStarted/Unknown，先 ObserveOrder/RecoveryRequired，不发送第二个 cancel mutation。；边界证据：overrides.ts:169-183 的 defaultCancelOrderById 在任意 regular error 后立即以 stop:true 重试；source 没有 endpoint unsupported-before-send 分类、request dispatch evidence 或 idempotency horizon。

questions.question: CCXT venue 是否提供稳定 client order id 与 retention/idempotency scope 需逐 venue 实测；无证据时 Unknown recovery 更保守。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：defaultPlaceOrder 直接把 symbol、string type、buy/sell、number amount、optional price 与 Record params 传给 createOrder，返回 raw CcxtOrder；没有 durable intent/dispatch identity/ack versus observation distinction。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 defaultPlaceOrder 的普通 market/limit native call 仍可作为 provider adapter implementation，但 cashQty/notional 的 quote conversion 必须把该 provider 的 quote identity、rounding/lot policy 和实际 units 固定进 plan。；保留 source 接受的 stop/TP/SL input 与明确拒绝 TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT、未验证 attached TP/SL 的安全意图；target 由 provider leaf schema 表达是否支持，不伪造跨 provider 支持。；provider leaf 未声明的 relations/TIF/session/trailing variant 不出现在 input schema 或 command；已声明且接受的 provider-native fields 不因 CCXT 不能表达而静默丢弃。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：createOrder 的 raw params 需要 provider-declared order schema/HOF 组合，而不是全局订单组合全集/动作表；target 仅把 durable transaction wrapper 放在受控效果边界。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue client-identity conformance。provider order leaf 只能声明并接受其精确 native fields/relations；未声明的 trailing/protection/relation variant 不出现在 schema 或 command，已声明但未取得稳定 client id、lookup/retention 和 idempotency scope 证据时，remote timeout/response loss 只进入 Unknown/RecoveryRequired/observe，绝不重发 createOrder；已接受的字段不得因 CCXT 限制而静默丢弃。；边界证据：overrides.ts:185-196 的 defaultPlaceOrder 直接把 raw symbol/type/side/amount/price/params 交给 createOrder；没有 client order id、retention 或 idempotency evidence，raw Ack 也不区分 fill/outcome。

questions.question: 各 venue positions 是否全账户、是否分页、mark/PnL 是否权威需实测；未有 evidence 不能标 Complete。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：defaultFetchPositions 没有参数/selector/schema，直接执行 exchange.fetchPositions() 并把 raw position rows 返回；没有 AccountScope、observation timestamp、完整性或 query failure。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 default route 仍可供 venue 明确证明统一 positions endpoint 的 adapter 使用。；原始 venue position semantics 在 adapter-specific decoder 保留；不把所有 exchange 强制成同一种字段假设。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：positions 是 scope-bound data listing；target 保留 row/schema/coverage evidence 与 Partial/Unavailable，不引入订单 approval/compensation。；闭环处置：保留 venue positions conformance。没有 scope、pagination、row schema、mark/PnL provenance 的完整 evidence 时，PositionListing 只能 Partial/Unavailable，保留已知 quantity/instrument/signed facts，不写 zero exposure，不执行 absence/Complete projection，也不把 mark/PnL 未证实地当 accounting precondition。；边界证据：overrides.ts:198-201 的 defaultFetchPositions 无 scope/selector/schema，直接返回 raw fetchPositions rows；source 没有各 venue 全账户范围、分页边界或 mark/PnL authority evidence。

questions.question: OKX 实测证据的 SDK/endpoint/account version 与 retention horizon 需记录；其他 venue 必须逐一 probe。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：defaultFetchAllOpenOrders 只调用一次 exchange.fetchOpenOrders()；注释记录 live OKX pending endpoint 返回 spot+swap，但明确 CCXT 没有跨 venue completeness semantics，category-scoped venue 需 override。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 OKX 单次 endpoint 的已实测覆盖可继续作为 OKX-specific policy，但不是全局默认 guarantee。；category-scoped venue 仍由独立 override 执行。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：OKX 单次 open-order 证据只能绑定具体 adapter/version/account；target 保留 per-venue coverage leaf 与逐订单 observe，不把 default helper 当跨 provider guarantee。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue probe。OKX policy 只有连同 SDK/endpoint/account version、scope、cursor/absence coverage 与 retention evidence 才可声明 Complete；其他 venue 默认 Partial/Unavailable，不能从 OKX comment 推广 guarantee，缺席仍需 per-order observe。；边界证据：overrides.ts:203-213 的注释只把单次 unscoped fetchOpenOrders 覆盖绑定到 OKX live comment，并明确 CCXT 不提供跨 venue completeness semantics；source 没有完整 OKX evidence record，也没有其他 venue probes。

questions.question: 每个注册 venue 的 account-family、jurisdiction、idempotency、coverage 与 optional wallet 事实需 live conformance 固定；未证实能力保持 unavailable。
questions.rationale: 旧行为/证据：registry 在 Binance override 中声明 spot 与 derivatives（walletTypes future+delivery，delivery 注释 tolerated-on-failure），并以四个 exchange key 注册 Binance、Bitget、Bybit、Hyperliquid；没有 SDK/account-family/jurisdiction/version/capability context。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 现有四个 exchange registrations 与 Binance future+delivery merge 意图保留；Binance delivery tolerated-on-failure 仅在显式 optional policy 下保留。；Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid modules 继续独立，不把 venue-specific behavior 塞进 kernel switch；family 未证明时保持 unavailable。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：string registry 与 Binance wallet merge 是 source facts；target 改为 versioned registration/capability descriptors，保留 optional delivery 与各 venue family，禁止 registry presence 代替 leaf availability。；闭环处置：保留 registration conformance。Typed VenueAccountRegistration 必须为每个 venue/version/environment/family/scope 写入 live evidence；registry presence 仅允许装配 adapter，未证实的 read/action/optional-wallet capability 保持 Unavailable/Partial。Binance delivery 的 tolerated-on-failure 只能是显式 OptionalNamespace，不能把四个 exchange keys、默认 family 或缺失 wallet 当完整账户/安全重试证明。；边界证据：overrides.ts:215-234 的 registry 是 string-keyed Record，实际四个 exchange keys，Binance value 另含 future/delivery wallet definitions；source 没有 per registration family/jurisdiction/idempotency/coverage/entitlement live facts。

questions.question: Exact authentication header/credential reference and correlation header names are not present in this source; Main must choose them at the protocol boundary.

questions.question: The wire representation of TransportPrincipal and the auth mechanism is not specified in the current files.

questions.question: Exact final route list is a shared Main/protocol decision; current architecture lists ten transaction routes but not every query projection name.

questions.question: Whether cancellation is represented as TransportCancelled or a shared interruption variant is not established in the current protocol.
questions.rationale: 旧事实：RequestOpts accepts arbitrary JSON and stringifies every query value; AbortSignal is the only structured control input.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C11 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:31-35: the source exposes only AbortSignal, while C11 fixes the public Promise/AbortSignal shape, AsyncIterable push, and local cancellation/deadline variants.。当前 host decision：C11 resolves cancellation representation: public Alice HTTP is Promise<Result<Output, Failure>> plus AbortSignal; local cancellation/deadline failures are Cancelled and DeadlineExceeded, transport loss is TransportUnavailable, and malformed envelopes are ProtocolViolation. questions.question: The exact failure tag names in the shared package are not yet implemented; they must align with Main’s transaction/query failure ADTs.

questions.question: Auth/correlation header names remain a shared protocol decision.

questions.question: Redaction limits and exact evidence fields require coordination with observability design.

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1108-1114: the reconcile helper exists only because GitCommit requires stateAfter and intentionally avoids recursive broker reads; replacing Git requires an event payload that carries real observed facts rather than reintroducing recursive query writes.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1108-1114: the reconcile helper exists only because GitCommit requires stateAfter and intentionally avoids recursive broker reads; replacing Git requires an event payload that carries real observed facts rather than reintroducing recursive query writes.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

findings.sourceFinding: Scope boundary finding: account/order observations and controlled effects carry AccountScope; public Candle/News/Instrument-like leaves use Public or their declared context and never synthesize accountId/subAccountId.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：Scope boundary finding: account/order observations and controlled effects carry AccountScope; public Candle/News/Instrument-like leaves use Public or their declared context and never synthesize accountId/subAccountId.；具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition finding: the fixed descriptor envelope is the only UTA-facing common surface. Provider-specific trees, schemas, errors, native fields and handlers remain adapter-owned; the historical UTA IBroker switch is not a target contract.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：Composition finding: the fixed descriptor envelope is the only UTA-facing common surface. Provider-specific trees, schemas, errors, native fields and handlers remain adapter-owned; the historical UTA IBroker switch is not a target contract.；具体目标关系（跨组不变量与证据边界）：本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。。

findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:546-560 is the current public projection choke point: place/observe and modify operations call OrderHelper.toWire before status/commit views, so its replacement must be integrated with this projection rather than only broker dispatch.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

findings.sourceFinding: K01: Each CoreAccount capability is a declaration that supplies its own exact input/output/error schemas, semantic unit, handler and resource needs; data readers and controlled effects compose separately, and adding a provider leaf must not edit a kernel switch.

findings.sourceFinding: K02: The UTA-facing fixed CapabilityDescriptor envelope is shared, but provider trees remain open-ended. findings.sourceFinding: K03: Zod/JSON-schema declarations are the source for validation, static types, metadata and CLI projections. Native order, instrument and error fields survive as exact provider extensions; SDK Contract/Order values are adapter-bound and never journaled.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：K03: Zod/JSON-schema declarations are the source for validation, static types, metadata and CLI projections. Native order, instrument and error fields survive as exact provider extensions; SDK Contract/Order values are adapter-bound and never journaled.；具体目标关系（Native sentinel、Contract discipline 与精确身份）：Native codec 是 provider-local construction-bound declaration：所有 Decimal/Double/Integer sentinel、presence（包括 false/0/empty）、SecType raw value、kind-specific requirements 和 extension fields 都有精确 encoded schema。InstrumentDescriptor 由 evidence-backed native/listing tuple 建立；UnknownNativeSecType(raw)、InvalidContract、MissingKindField 保留，而不是在 coercion 中静默降级。。

findings.sourceFinding: K04: Order, Candle, Instrument and related units are composable contracts, not a closed order-combination catalogue. Quantity/notional, protection, TIF and relation choices are provider-declared HOF/schema combinations; AccountScope is required for account/order effects only, while public data carries explicit Public or schema-declared context.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：K04: Order, Candle, Instrument and related units are composable contracts, not a closed order-combination catalogue. Quantity/notional, protection, TIF and relation choices are provider-declared HOF/schema combinations; AccountScope is required for account/order effects only, while public data carries explicit Public or schema-declared context.；具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit<Schema>，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。。

findings.sourceFinding: K05: Account/position/order/catalog reads are pull data or resource-scoped push streams with explicit freshness, cursor, coverage, backpressure and recovery evidence. They do not use prepare/approve/compensate, effect locks or per-frame WAL.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：K05: Account/position/order/catalog reads are pull data or resource-scoped push streams with explicit freshness, cursor, coverage, backpressure and recovery evidence. They do not use prepare/approve/compensate, effect locks or per-frame WAL.；具体目标关系（订单同步、持仓估值与模拟状态）：读取统一为带 scope/as-of/freshness/cursor/coverage 的 Pull Result 或 resource-scoped Push Stream。Stream 的 item-error、gap、snapshot-end 是非 terminal；Completed/Failed/Cancelled 互斥且失败后不可完成。PositionObservation、valuation estimate、FillObservation、order lifecycle 和 simulated state 分开建模；ReconcileBalance 是 valuationOnly/accounting estimate，不是 synthetic FillObservation 或 remote execution claim。 Coverage 只取 Complete|Partial|Unavailable；未知值/quality 放在 payload/reason，不增加全局 variant。普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 读取，不需把全部 frame 写入 journal；仅持久化显式 capture、control evidence 与 predicate checkpoint。保留已验证的 same-currency FX identity，并允许显式 policy-approved Estimated display value；删除 unknown=1 或类似伪造，不删除有证据的 1:1/default。。

findings.sourceFinding: K08: Durable intent, approval, dispatch, WAL/CAS/idempotency, reconciliation and compensation apply only to controlled trading effects. Data-cache or observation failure cannot trigger transaction compensation; native guarantees remain evidence-qualified.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：K08: Durable intent, approval, dispatch, WAL/CAS/idempotency, reconciliation and compensation apply only to controlled trading effects. Data-cache or observation failure cannot trigger transaction compensation; native guarantees remain evidence-qualified.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

findings.sourceFinding: K11: Existing source facts, durability boundaries, unknown/precision/absence obligations and open native questions remain evidence. Reframing removes obsolete universal-SDK conclusions without declaring sibling ownership or empirical gaps solved.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：K11: Existing source facts, durability boundaries, unknown/precision/absence obligations and open native questions remain evidence. Reframing removes obsolete universal-SDK conclusions without declaring sibling ownership or empirical gaps solved.；具体目标关系（跨组不变量与证据边界）：本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。。

Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:642-688, :700-724, :759-790 and git.ts:256-305.；具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。。

findings.sourceFinding: CapabilityDescriptor is the fixed UTA-facing envelope (identity/path, schema versions/fingerprint, input/result/error schemas, delivery/effect/resource metadata, provenance and availability); provider capability trees are open, leaves may be absent, and an existing leaf can be unavailable without becoming structural absence. There is no global ActionContractMap or mandatory full Broker SDK. Evidence: broker.ts:475-620.

There is no global ActionContractMap or mandatory full Broker SDK. Evidence: broker.ts:475-620.；具体目标关系（IBroker 兼容面的拆分与 scoped provider port）：固定 UTA-facing `CapabilityDescriptor` envelope（identity/path、schema version/fingerprint、exact slots、delivery/effect/resource/provenance/availability），provider capability tree 保持开放。每个 leaf 自己声明 `Input/Success/Failure/Delivery`，仅需要账户事实或受控效果的 leaf 才绑定 AccountScope；查询、流、Layer/resource 和 private native interpreter 分离。。

findings.sourceFinding: Order is a semantic unit and controlled-effect input composed by provider declarations/HOFs. Units versus Notional, amount versus percent, timing and protection remain local validated relations; native MOC/LOC/REL/OPG or other fields survive as exact provider extensions. No provider is required to accept another provider’s leaf, and native atomicity is never inferred from shape. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637, :703-724 and cited IBKR/Alpaca/Longbridge/CCXT sources.

Units versus Notional, amount versus percent, timing and protection remain local validated relations; native MOC/LOC/REL/OPG or other fields survive as exact provider extensions. No provider is required to accept another provider’s leaf, and native atomicity is never inferred from shape. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637, :703-724 and cited IBKR/Alpaca/Longbridge/CCXT sources.；具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit<Schema>，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。。

findings.sourceFinding: RuntimeHealth is a closed process observation ADT; broker reach, capability availability, authorization and transaction admission are separate. Health observations never grant dispatch permission. Evidence: broker.ts:366-426.

findings.sourceFinding: Pull results are finite data projections and push streams have explicit frame/lifecycle/cursor/backpressure contracts. Complete/Partial/Unavailable and freshness/finality remain explicit; data reads and caches do not use prepare/approve/compensate or per-frame transaction WAL. Evidence: broker.ts:322-364, :428-450.

Evidence: broker.ts:322-364, :428-450.；具体目标关系（行情单位、历史与管理层投影）：用同一 schema-bound semantic units 衔接 Pull/Push：Candle base + provider extension 明确 interval/timezone/session/adjustment/finality/revision；Instrument/ListingResult 保留 source/scope/coverage；history 是 order lifecycle projection，管理层只聚合带 provenance 的 valuation/account rows。所有 decimal/money/quantity 都是 exact validated encoded values，wire 不含 Date/SDK 对象。 `Coverage = Complete|Partial|Unavailable` 是 host 的封闭 ADT；unknown currency/value/quality 仍作为 variant payload 的 reason。普通 live read 可声明 asOf/coverage 而不 journaling 全部事实；只记录显式 capture、control evidence/checkpoint。保留 same-currency FX identity 和 policy-approved Estimated display，禁止 unknown=1 fabrication。。

findings.sourceFinding: JournalWriter/events/attempts are authority only for controlled effects; Git/history/manager and market-data outputs are rebuildable projections. DispatchStarted is durable before remote mutation, and response/storage loss remains Unknown/RecoveryRequired. Evidence: TradingGit.ts:141-185, :160-180, :171-180.

Evidence: TradingGit.ts:141-185, :160-180, :171-180.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

findings.sourceFinding: Data/effect boundary: Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup pulls are finite results and pushes are resource-scoped streams with explicit cursor, end, error and gap semantics. Data readers, caches and streams do not use order approval, compensation, locks or per-frame WAL.

findings.sourceFinding: Verification: K12 scenarios prove declaration-derived schema/type/metadata/CLI changes, structural absence, boundary rejection, pull/push lifecycle, provider output validation and controlled-effect recovery without claiming native guarantees that remain unobserved.
findings.rationale: 旧事实保留：Verification: K12 scenarios prove declaration-derived schema/type/metadata/CLI changes, structural absence, boundary rejection, pull/push lifecycle, provider output validation and controlled-effect recovery without claiming native guarantees that remain unobserved.；具体目标关系（跨组不变量与证据边界）：本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。。

Current relation in LSTATE-SUPERVISOR-GUARDIAN: Keep Guardian as the existing process-control protocol and Supervisor as policy; keep pure RestartDecision separate from effectful RestartTriggerInterpreter/probe/Guardian-client IO; preserve request correlation/escalation while UTA retains durable transaction/recovery authority. This contract is a coordination obligation, not a new business entity or provider guarantee; empirical/native portions remain evidence-bound. Original structural-audit row is unchanged at local://uta-design-book-rebuild/legacy-structural-audit.json (pack=state, kind=crossGroupContracts).

findings.sourceFinding: Source architecture fact (not a target requirement): `CcxtBroker` currently implements the legacy `IBroker<CcxtBrokerMeta>` and routes several operations through the process-wide `exchangeOverrides` registry/default helpers. The corrected target treats this class/registry as migration input and composes independent provider leaves; it does not require a universal IBroker or global action switch.
findings.rationale: 把 IBroker class 与 process-wide exchangeOverrides 作为迁移输入，目标由 provider leaf 自己声明可用操作与 schema，不建立 universal IBroker/action switch。

findings.sourceFinding: Source boundary fact: `CcxtBroker.spec.ts:48-49` is import/contract-extension glue. Future tests should exercise declared schema/codec leaves and compatibility projections without treating raw SDK mocks as runtime proof.
findings.rationale: 把 spec import/contract-extension glue 移到 adapter/protocol boundary；domain codec 只消费已认证 slot，raw SDK mock 不再冒充 runtime evidence。

findings.sourceFinding: Source boundary fact: `CcxtBroker.ts:156-162` defines `CcxtBrokerMeta` and class self-registration. The target registration point may publish typed Ccxt provider metadata and leaf declarations, but no production module or new export is claimed by this design.
findings.rationale: 把 class metadata/self-registration 作为 pack loading evidence；注册只使 provider definition 可发现，不授予 operation、permission、idempotency 或 native guarantee。

findings.sourceFinding: Public/account scope rule: public Candle/Instrument/News-like data does not receive a fabricated AccountScope. AccountScope is required for account, position, order, and controlled-effect facts; a concrete data schema may choose `Public` or explicit `Account(AccountScope)`.
findings.rationale: 保留 Public 与 AccountScope 的分离：账户 PnL/position observation 显式声明 scope，public market leaf 不构造账户字段或 private authority。

findings.sourceFinding: CCXT has no evidenced push stream in the assigned files. Any future stream adapter must declare frame/control schemas, lifecycle, cursor/replay and backpressure under K05 rather than treating polling pulls as push or transactionizing each frame.
findings.rationale: 把 future stream 作为待实证 provider leaf；当前 source 只证明 finite pull，不能把 realtime label 当作 push quality/finality。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/ccxt-contracts.ts:77-85,96-108: marketToContract 通过 unknown cast 读取 CcxtMarket 未声明的 expiry/contractSize/strike/optionType；expiry 可缺失而 FUT/OPT contractSize 缺失会 fallback `'1'`，必须由 native schema 与 derivative constructor 先拒绝/标记不完整，不能把 fallback multiplier 当事实。
findings.rationale: marketToContract 的 unknown cast 与 contractSize=1 fallback 改为 native schema 解码和 derivative metadata failure/Unavailable，不把 fallback multiplier 写入 Instrument。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/ccxt-contracts.ts:118-122: contractToCcxt 接受 exchangeName 但函数体不使用它；catalog lookup 必须将 VenueIdentity 纳入 key，防止同 symbol 在不同 exchange 间误命中。
findings.rationale: contractToCcxt 未使用 exchangeName 的旧签名不能丢掉 venue identity；catalog key 必须包含 VenueIdentity 与 native key，防止同 symbol 跨 exchange 误命中。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/ccxt-tools.ts:25-30: resolveCcxtOne 要求一个 broker 同时存在 getFundingRate 与 getOrderBook 才可入选；capability selection 应按 operation 独立，不能因无关 tool 缺失隐藏可用 query。
findings.rationale: tool 的 raw input/output 保留 aliceId/source，但 funding/orderbook 各自成为独立 leaf，禁止用“两个方法都存在”的 coupled gate 隐藏单项 capability。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/ccxt-tools.ts:61-64,89-93: 工具只捕获 contractFromAliceId 错误，broker query rejection 会直接逸出；application MarketDataService 必须把 native/network/auth/stale/partial failure 映射为 typed QueryFailure。
findings.rationale: 工具层只捕获 contract resolution 的旧行为改为精确 domain/network/provider errors；unexpected error 进入明确 failure 或 RecoveryRequired，而非静默空值。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:419-486: searchContracts 只取 active、base/quote 完整且 quote 属 USDT/USD/USDC 的 markets，按 swap>future>spot>option 与 USDT>USD>USDC 排序，并为结果 mutate derivativeSecTypes；该 preference 不是 universal catalog identity，也不能代替 per-market metadata/capability。
findings.rationale: search 的 filter/rank/derivative annotation 保留为纯 catalog policy，结果携带 coverage/as-of/identity evidence，不宣称全量或账户权限。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:509-626: placeOrder 会为 cashQty fetchTicker、拒绝未验证 attached TP/SL 与 TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT、直接把 extraParams 交给 createOrder，并在 catch 中返回字符串；目标必须把 notional/reference quote、unsupported fields、dispatch identity 与 outcome 分开。
findings.rationale: place 的 cashQty、TP/SL refusal、TRAIL refusal 与 raw extraParams 必须是 provider effect schema 的显式 variant；没有 hook 时能力 unavailable，不能以默认 createOrder 伪造保护语义。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:730-768: 无 override 时合成一个 unified default sub-account；省略 selector 时 scopedSubAccounts 返回全部 scopes，未知 id 才抛 CONFIG；目标 AccountDirectory 必须把 discovery/default/aggregate semantics 类型化，不能把 synthetic default 当事实。
findings.rationale: subaccount implicit default/aggregate 改为显式 AccountScope 与 aggregation policy；网络可达和 route 成功不等于 permission/data entitlement。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:932-938,1099-1102,1178-1204: keyless getAccount 返回零值 USD account，getOrders/getOpenOrders 返回 []；private readiness/absence 不能沿用这些 compatibility values，public market-data capability 必须单独声明。
findings.rationale: keyless zeros/[] 改为 PublicReadOnly/PrivateUnavailable 或精确 empty observation；source-provided zero 是合法事实时保留其 provenance，不能把缺少权限伪装成 funded zero。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1112-1129,1132-1167: getOrder 没有 symbol hint 时返回 null，且把 lookup/convert 的全部错误 catch 为 null；convertCcxtOrder 还以 amount=0、buy 等 fallback 生成 Order view，目标 observer 必须区分 missing descriptor、definitive absence、protocol failure 与 Unknown。
findings.rationale: getOrder catch-null 与 converter defaults 改为 scoped absence/Unknown/Malformed 结果，保留 native request/path evidence，禁止用 null 触发盲重发。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1290-1295: 静态 capability 只声明 CRYPTO/CRYPTO_PERP 与 MKT/LMT，虽 translator 可映射 FUT/OPT；交易 capability 必须以 market/account/action evidence 派生，不能由 translator 支持推断。
findings.rationale: static caps 只保留为 provider-declared capability observation；它们不能从常量推导真实 venue availability、limits 或 mutation authority。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1330-1375: getFundingRate 将缺 fundingRate 变为 0、缺 timestamp 变为 Date.now，getOrderBook 将缺 level price/amount 变为 0、缺 timestamp 变为 Date.now；typed market-data decoder 必须拒绝/降级这些无证据 defaults。
findings.rationale: funding/orderbook zero/Date.now fallback 改为 schema failure、missing timestamp 或 stale evidence；source-provided legitimate zero 与 explicit observation time 仍按 schema 保留。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/overrides.ts:146-213: default balance/order/position/open-order helpers 均使用 unscoped/raw Exchange calls，regular/conditional 与 OKX coverage 只具 venue-specific comments；每个 route、scope、pagination、absence evidence 需独立 policy，不能推广 default。
findings.rationale: override/default raw helper 保留为 provider interpreter seam，但其 unscoped native rows 必须在边界解码并带 scope/namespace/coverage；hook 存在不等于 permission 或 effect availability。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/hyperliquid.ts:20-41,43-53: market explicit price 会跳过 ticker fetch，missing mark 用 abs(notional)/abs(contracts) 仅在 contracts 非零时浅复制写回；prepare 必须解释 explicit price，position decoder 必须保留 signed facts 与 derived/MarkUnavailable provenance。
findings.rationale: Hyperliquid 的 last→close reference 与 derived mark 只在 Hyperliquid leaf 中声明，冻结 quote/provenance/units；不外推到其他 CCXT venue。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bitget.ts:17-30: helper 顺序 fetch namespace、跳过无 id row、以 symbol:id 合并；缺 id 不是 safe absence，必须成为 ProtocolViolation/Partial 并持久化 namespace coverage。
findings.rationale: Bitget missing-id row 的 skip 与 `${symbol}:${id}` merge key 只属于 Classic listing leaf；按 native namespace/identity 表示缺失，不把不完整行当作成功或全局唯一。

findings.sourceFinding: K01/K02 provider composition: CcxtCore exposes a provider pack whose fixed UTA-facing CapabilityDescriptor envelope is computed from each declared connection, catalog, market-data, account-observation, order-observation, or controlled-effect leaf. The source CcxtBroker IBroker class and exchange override switch remain migration evidence only; the target has no universal SDK or mandatory handler.
findings.rationale: 把 CcxtBroker/override switch 留在迁移证据，当前 foundation 只组合 provider leaves 与固定 outer descriptor；不建立 universal IBroker 或 global action map。

findings.sourceFinding: K03 schema boundary: CCXT native rows/config/replies enter through provider-declared schemas and codecs. Static CcxtMarket/FundingRate/OrderBook/legacy Contract types are compatibility projections; exact native extensions, units, error variants, and schema fingerprints stay with the leaf.
findings.rationale: 把 CcxtMarket/FundingRate/OrderBook/legacy Contract 的静态 shape 留作 adapter projection，construction-bound schema 同时派生 validator、metadata、slot 与 digest。

findings.sourceFinding: K04 semantic units: Instrument, Candle, and other data units are account-independent unless their concrete operation declares Account context. Order effects compose provider-declared sizing, kind, duration, relations, protection, and native fields; legal combinations are not global and no Cartesian order variant list is required.
findings.rationale: 把 Order/Candle/Instrument 的 semantic unit 与 provider HOF/schema 关系落到 core foundation；合法组合由声明决定，不生成 Cartesian order variants，AccountScope 只在所需事实/效果上出现。

findings.sourceFinding: K05 data delivery: CCXT quote, bar, funding, order-book, session, catalog, account, position, and listing reads are finite pull observations (no CCXT push source is evidenced here). Public reads use `dataContext: Public`; account reads carry explicit AccountScope. Their caches/projections have observation completeness and resource lifecycles, not order prepare/approve/compensate or per-frame WAL.
findings.rationale: 把 CCXT reads 归入 finite Pull/data observation；`Complete|Partial|Unavailable` 是唯一 Coverage，value/quality unknown 是 payload/reason，ordinary data 不进入 order WAL。

findings.sourceFinding: K06 outer projection: `index.ts` and provider tools project declared leaves into describe/help/call schemas. Public data tools do not invent an account selector; account/order tools resolve an explicit scope, and no raw Exchange/SDK DTO crosses the public boundary.
findings.rationale: 把 index/tools 当作同一 provider tree 的 generated projection；public leaf 不伪造 account selector，account/order leaf 使用 explicit scope，raw SDK DTO 不跨 public boundary。

findings.sourceFinding: K07 heterogeneous bridge: the CCXT adapter preserves venue-native endpoints, options, namespace parameters and override sequencing behind typed provider leaves. Endpoint presence never implies idempotency, atomicity, or compensation; native protocol failures remain distinct from input/domain/output failures.
findings.rationale: 把 native endpoint/options/namespace/override sequencing 留在 selected provider interpreter；foreign/protocol failures 与 input/domain/output failures 分离，method presence 不证明 idempotency/atomicity。

findings.sourceFinding: K08 controlled effects: only provider-declared order-effect leaves use the transaction writer for prepared intent, approval, dispatch, acknowledgement, observation, and recovery. CCXT create/edit/cancel/close source methods are not authority; data-query failures never trigger order compensation.
findings.rationale: 把只有 provider-declared effect leaf 才能获得 writer/admission/dispatch/observation/recovery 的关系落在 core controlled-effect section；source create/edit/cancel/close 不构成 authority。

findings.sourceFinding: K09/K10 trigger boundary: CcxtCore supplies data observations and any declared effect result; trigger binding, activation, ReturnToAgent review/outbox, and agent delivery belong to their owning groups. A public candle event is evidence, not approval, and no CcxtCore leaf dispatches on an event by itself.
findings.rationale: 把 CcxtCore 的 data observations/effect results 与 trigger owner 分离；public Candle event 仅是 evidence，不能由 CCXT leaf 自行 dispatch，ReturnToAgent 不是 universal default。

findings.sourceFinding: K11 evidence reuse: the 74 MAP entries preserve current CCXT source behavior, exact venue facts, compatibility defects, and six unresolved empirical obligations. The revised target does not claim that mocked/gated tests prove native quality, idempotency, persistence, or runtime capability.
findings.rationale: 把 74 MAP 的 source facts 与六项 empirical obligations 继续作为 evidence；mock/gated tests 不升级为 native quality、idempotency、persistence 或 runtime capability proof。

findings.sourceFinding: K12 acceptance: experiments must separately falsify public pull schema/provenance, catalog identity, namespace completeness, and each enabled controlled effect. Adding a provider field must change its descriptor-derived type/validation/help; absent native capability must remove the leaf, not manufacture an Unsupported method.
findings.rationale: 把 acceptance 约束为 declaration-derived type/validator/help、catalog identity、namespace completeness 与 each enabled effect 的 falsifiers；absent native capability 结构缺席而非 Unsupported stub。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K02-K04` (CapabilityDescriptor, schema-first semantic units): CCXT native market leaves decode account-independent `InstrumentId` plus VenueIdentity/native key/quote/settlement/expiry/multiplier metadata; AccountScope is attached only where a private observation or controlled effect requires it (ccxt-contracts.ts:55-111).
findings.rationale: 把 native market decode 绑定 VenueIdentity/native key/metadata；private observation/effect 才附 AccountScope，canonical Instrument 不由 account 或 symbol 伪造。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K01-K03,K08` (declaration source, schema derivation, controlled effects): each CCXT provider declares its own read/data or controlled-effect leaves with exact input/output/domain-error schemas and capability availability. `withTransaction` wraps only effect leaves; prepared payload, ack, observation, unknown recovery and idempotency evidence are not a global operation map (overrides.ts:31-196).
findings.rationale: 把每个 CCXT provider 声明成独立 exact input/output/domain-error leaf；withTransaction 只包 effect leaf，prepared/ack/observation/unknown/idempotency evidence 不进入 global operation map。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K05-K07` (data delivery and heterogeneous boundary): funding, order-book, bars, balances, positions and listings are data capabilities selected per operation. Public market facts use explicit `DataScope.Public`; account facts use `DataScope.Account(AccountScope)` with authorization and readiness. Freshness, structural absence and availability remain distinct; data reads do not require order approval, compensation or per-frame transaction WAL (ccxt-tools.ts:20-95; CcxtBroker.ts:730-768,932-938,1099-1204).
findings.rationale: 把 funding/orderbook/bars/balance/position/listing 的 Public 与 Account scope、freshness、absence、availability 留在 data leaves；不引入 order approval/compensation/per-frame WAL。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K02,K05,K07` (provider capability tree, delivery and errors): Bitget provider leaves preserve ClassicV2 spot/derivatives routes, USDT-FUTURES parameters and six namespace coverage, while family, entitlement and completeness are declared availability evidence rather than mandatory methods (bitget.ts:1-68).
findings.rationale: 把 Bitget ClassicV2 routes、USDT-FUTURES 与 six namespace coverage 留在 Bitget leaf；family/entitlement/completeness 是 availability evidence，不是 mandatory methods。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K02-K05,K07` (provider-native schema and listing evidence): Bybit provider leaves preserve spot/swap category coverage and four lookup paths; each leaf emits exact absence/error evidence and scoped identity, with no catch-all empty/not-found and no requirement that other providers implement those paths (bybit.ts:1-53).
findings.rationale: 把 Bybit spot/swap categories 与 four lookup paths 留在 Bybit leaf；每个 path 产出 scoped identity 和 exact absence/error evidence，不 catch-all empty/not-found，不要求其他 provider 复制。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K04,K07-K08` (semantic units, foreign boundary, controlled effects): Hyperliquid effect leaves may compose the documented reference-quote/IOC behavior only when native evidence enables it; position marks remain data evidence with derived provenance and do not inherit transaction guarantees (hyperliquid.ts:1-53).
findings.rationale: 把 Hyperliquid reference-quote/IOC 只作为 native evidence 可启用的 provider effect；position mark 是 derived data provenance，不继承交易原子性。

findings.sourceFinding: Composition contract `composition-contract.md#K02,K07-K10` (availability, native errors, effect recovery): default helpers and registry are provider implementations, not universal policy. Unscoped balance, conditional fallback, cancel retry, listing completeness, protection relations and idempotency each require the selected leaf’s evidence; unknown remains a named availability/outcome (overrides.ts:146-234; CcxtBroker.ts:1112-1204).
findings.rationale: 把 default helpers/registry 作为 provider implementation；unscoped balance、conditional fallback、cancel retry、listing completeness、protection、idempotency 都须 selected leaf evidence，unknown 保持 named outcome。
