findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：Instrument and native evidence: AccountScope binds account/order facts, remote refs, positions, and account-bound evidence; Public scope or a provider-declared scope binds public Instrument/Candle/News/NewsGroup/quote/catalog data。当前章节关系：versioned EvidenceEnvelope/EvidenceSink 负责 redaction、provenance、sequence/conflict 与 sealed/audit separation。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: Data delivery: account-bound account/position/order observations and public market/catalog/AI-read leaves are finite pull or explicitly declared push resources with freshness/cursor/completeness/error variants; EvidenceSink is a separate redacted append/import capability with sequence/conflict semantics. None uses order approval, compensation, or per-frame transaction WAL; only selected evidence used by an effect is persisted with its declared subject scope and decision (K04-K06, K11; MAP-415093F05F, MAP-47ED37A445, MAP-E136AE0A4B, MAP-C2F022975E).
findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：Data delivery: account-bound account/position/order observations and public market/catalog/AI-read leaves are finite pull or explicitly declared push resources with freshness/cursor/completeness/error variants; EvidenceSink is a separate redacted append/import capability with sequence/conflict semantics。当前章节关系：versioned EvidenceEnvelope/EvidenceSink 负责 redaction、provenance、sequence/conflict 与 sealed/audit separation。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: Controlled effects: account-bound order place/cancel/close/trigger/bracket leaves retain exact provider-native parameters and are wrapped withTransaction only when they can create a trading side effect; no Cartesian Order variant matrix is handwritten across providers. Prepared payload, approval digest, WAL/CAS/idempotency, Ack-versus-observation, leases, and RecoveryCase apply to that effect path, not to public or account read leaves (K01-K04, K08; MAP-7E7AB00B65, MAP-4D4A864108, MAP-F9A4323AA5).
findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：Controlled effects: account-bound order place/cancel/close/trigger/bracket leaves retain exact provider-native parameters and are wrapped withTransaction only when they can create a trading side effect; no Cartesian Order variant matrix is handwritten across providers。当前章节关系：provider-specific Controlled effect leaf 保留 exact native extension、ack/observation/recovery evidence，不宣称跨 provider guarantee。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: Protection and conditional leaves: bracket/trigger capability, parent/leg identity, availability, and observation are explicit provider results. Missing legs or stable identities remain Unknown/Unavailable; no provider extension is silently downgraded to an entry-only claim (K02-K04, K07-K08; MAP-4D4A864108, MAP-E5356E684D, MAP-34BF36C838).
findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：Protection and conditional leaves: bracket/trigger capability, parent/leg identity, availability, and observation are explicit provider results。当前章节关系：RuntimeAccountDescriptor/admission catalog 显式记录 environment/account/readiness/provider instance 与 typed unavailable evidence。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: External stimuli: S7 direct venue probes are separately authorized and recorded with actor/provenance/native identity. They are evidence for UTA observation/takeover, never UTA dispatch or a second generic execution authority (K05, K07, K09; MAP-68FD1B154A, MAP-D16449202E, MAP-B5990574ED, MAP-E4B0D38A44).
findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：External stimuli: S7 direct venue probes are separately authorized and recorded with actor/provenance/native identity。当前章节关系：versioned EvidenceEnvelope/EvidenceSink 负责 redaction、provenance、sequence/conflict 与 sealed/audit separation。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: Evidence and simulation: JSONL/evidence sinks are redacted projections with their own sequence/conflict semantics; MockBroker fixtures are tagged Simulation. Neither file append nor simulated Ack/fill proves JournalWriter durability or native venue guarantees (K03, K05, K07, K11-K12; MAP-424F0FB69C, MAP-C2F022975E, MAP-55F8053385, MAP-81E8AC49C4).
findings.rationale: 旧 source 行为：Evidence and simulation: JSONL/evidence sinks are redacted projections with their own sequence/conflict semantics; MockBroker fixtures are tagged Simulation。当前章节关系：versioned EvidenceEnvelope/EvidenceSink 负责 redaction、provenance、sequence/conflict 与 sealed/audit separation。保留上述字段、顺序、identity、coverage 或 provider evidence 的观察义务；未绑定 raw authority、隐式 fallback 与未声明 side effect 不进入新 leaf。

findings.sourceFinding: src/domain/market-data/bars/types.ts:1-133; src/domain/market-data/bars/bar-service.ts:99-363; src/tool/quant.ts:1-110：bars 由 barId/source/interval identity、vendor/UTA reads、freshness/quality 与 delayed warning 消费，quant searchBars/calculateQuant 显式选择 source/bar capability；当前 OhlcvBar 仍有开放扩展且 coverage/finality/revision 不完整。
findings.rationale: 旧 consumer 依赖 barId/source 与 delayed/quality 结果；新关系是 construction-bound Candle base+provider extension、Decimal/finality/coverage schema 与 Public/account scope，ordinary pull 不获得 transaction authority。

findings.sourceFinding: src/domain/market-data/reference/types.ts:1-133; src/domain/market-data/reference/service.ts:34-178：reference board 是 provider/asOf/cache/origin/stale 的低频事实 projection，与 account/instrument identity 分离。
findings.rationale: 旧 reference board fields 被独立保留；新关系是 declared Public/reference capability 与 explicit asOf/stale/coverage projection，不把 board cache 当作 account order state 或 complete market catalog。

findings.sourceFinding: src/domain/news/types.ts:1-83; src/domain/news/collector/rss.ts:1-139; src/domain/news/store.ts:40-205,267-299; src/domain/news/query/archive.ts:180-312; src/webui/routes/news.ts:1-63：RSS 以 feed/GUID/link/hash 去重、定时 poll、单 feed 错误丢弃并提供 lookback/filter；correction/retraction/coverage 与 native IBKR news consumer 尚未建立。
findings.rationale: 旧 news archive 的 dedup/feed/lookup 行为保留；新关系是 News/NewsGroup exact revision/correction/retraction/membership/coverage schemas 与 finite/stream delivery，feed failure 不再伪装 complete，且不成为 command namespace。

findings.sourceFinding: packages/ibkr/src/client/historical.ts:20-170; packages/ibkr/src/decoder/historical.ts:55-183：native historical request/cancel/keepUpToDate 与 WAP/barCount/update/end-marker 存在，但当前 UTA IbkrBroker 仅暴露 quote/clock，不能由 native presence 推导 UTA capability。
findings.rationale: 旧 native richness 与当前 UTA absence 都是 source fact；新关系是 provider-declared Candle capability，未声明/未证实 leaf 从 admission catalog 缺席或返回 Partial/Unavailable，而不是 universal historical method。

findings.sourceFinding: src/server/cli.ts:212-345; src/server/cli-commands.ts:1-340; src/core/mcp-export.ts:1-145：CLI_EXPORTS/cli-commands 手写命令 map，schema 主要验证 input，JSON Schema 不可表示时 fallback `{}`，MCP 只生成 generic content/text。
findings.rationale: 旧 CLI/MCP 命令、input schema 与 error/provenance 需求保留；新关系是 final descriptor/catalog 的 generated Help/Describe/Invoke/Subscribe，output/error/effect/delivery/schema slot 一起派生，删除 `{}` 与第二 command map。

findings.sourceFinding: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.ts:1-130; services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts:1-48; packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts:1-10; packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts:475-620：provider loader 是 same-process apiVersion/engine/configSchema/createBroker 校验，IBroker 是闭合 interface，schemas barrel 为空，native richness/stubs 由统一 surface 承压。
findings.rationale: 旧 loader checks/native methods 保留为 trusted installed interpretation；新关系是 construction-bound declaration/evaluator/digest 与 foreign handshake/certified opaque document，provider vocabulary open，unsupported leaves absent，不强行补 universal Unsupported。

findings.sourceFinding: src/core/event-log.ts:48-92,127-163; docs/event-system.md:1-75; docs/workspace-issues-and-scheduling.md:25-90,258-300：EventLog 是 append-only history/process-local subscribe，Issue when 仅表达 timing，scanner 不负责 predicate/event dispatch。
findings.rationale: 旧 journal/timing semantics 不变；新关系是 DeferredInvocation 的 pure advance/checkpoint 与 single activation owner，event identity/predicate state/outbox 原子提交，绝不把 EventLog 升级成 global task bus。

findings.sourceFinding: src/workspaces/conversation-control.ts:116-220,270-430; src/workspaces/headless-task-registry.ts:1-253; docs/conversation-provenance.md:142-217：exact/reconstructed resumeId、Workspace target、headless taskId/resume link、SessionOrigin/provenance 分层存在，缺失 native session 会 unavailable，boot leftover running→interrupted。
findings.rationale: 旧 Workspace/Session/headless identity 与 unavailable/interrupted states 保留；新关系要求 Alice bridge 先 durable-admit stable ReviewRequest，再按 exact WorkspaceConversationControl 绑定 responsible Session，headless 在 spawn 前持久化相同 key，不能创建任意 agent loop。

findings.sourceFinding: src/workspaces/issues/comment-delivery.ts:43-217; src/core/inbox-store.ts:1-263：Issue comment delivery 有 pending/replied/failed 与 deterministic reply id；Inbox 是 server-stamped user notification，当前不提供 connector dedup 或 AI command authority。
findings.rationale: 旧 comment/Inbox projection 与 reply idempotence 保留为 delivery evidence；新关系把 Inbox/Issue 与 UTA ReviewRequest、AI allowed command、venue outcome 分开，delivery failure 进入 frozen SuspendControl/CloseWithoutDispatch/EscalateDecision policy。

findings.sourceFinding: docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/source-experiments.md:E01：dispatch 后 snapshot/onCommit failure，pending-hash retry 会重新 dispatch；必须持久化 send/receipt/recovery。
findings.rationale: 旧失败顺序证明可能 send 后 response/persistence loss；新关系以 DispatchStarted/one-use DispatchGrant、AlreadyStarted、OutcomeUnknown 与 observation/recovery 取代 retry re-dispatch。

findings.sourceFinding: docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/source-experiments.md:E02：cooldown 在后续 guard reject 之前改变 state；unknown valuation/null gate 不得 permissive。
findings.rationale: 旧 guard side effect 违反 expected rejection 不变更 earlier state；新关系是 pure Decision/Evolution 与显式 Unknown/valuation failure payload，rejection 不推进 checkpoint 或授权。
